title: Product Designer - Grow & Engage
description:
### **About the Opportunity**



We're looking for a Product Designer to join N26's UX team in our **Grow and Engage** domain. There are a couple of areas within the domain where we're adding design strength, and we'll match you to the right one based on your background and what you're drawn to.



In this role, you'll work in the Grow \& Engage domain—the heart of the customer experience ranging from the acquisition and signup to our premium membership tiers and the daily engagement of our users. You will work in teams delivering the newest and most innovative features serving our customers in the best way possible. You'll design end\-to\-end on important features and flows that millions of customers use every day. You'll report to our Head of UX, and work in a tight cross\-functional team of product, engineering, research, and data partners. We'll back you to grow your craft on work that matters—to customers, to the business, and to your own development as a designer.



We believe our team's diversity is our strength. The more perspectives at the table, the better. Please apply regardless of your identity, experience, or background.

  

***Please note:***


* ***We highly encourage you to attach your most recent portfolio and CV in English to your application.***
* ***Applications without a portfolio will not be considered***

### **About the Work**



The Grow and Engage domain is where we shape how customers get genuine, lasting value from N26\. It covers a broad slice of the core product—the moments that bring customers back to their day\-to\-day banking, the features that build habits and surface real value, and the way our paid tiers turn into something subscribers actively feel.



The work spans the home screen, in\-app discovery, recommendations and AI\-powered insights, the cross\-cutting patterns that pull the whole product together, and our Smart, Go, and Metal subscription tiers—where the opportunity is to weave value through the product rather than bolt it on. You'll have meaningful scope to shape both how we package what we have today and what comes next.



You'll be designing for a fintech product used by millions, in a category where customers' expectations have been shaped by some of the best digital products in the world. The bar is high, and the work matters.


### **In This Role, You Will:**


* **Design end\-to\-end** on important features within your segment, from problem framing through research, exploration, and shipped work.
* **Bring a high bar for craft**—UI and interaction design that delights customers and converts.
* **Frame design problems sharply**: define user needs, success criteria, constraints, and tradeoffs before jumping into solutions.
* **Develop user flows and interactions** that hold up across the connected parts of the product, anticipating how your work affects adjacent areas.
* **Contribute to our design system**—using and improving the patterns the team relies on.
* **Be data\-informed**: plan and run research that blends qualitative and quantitative methods, and proactively seek out the data you need when it isn't on the table.
* **Partner closely** with product, engineering, research, and data to ship work that actually lands—and to take it further once it's live.
* **Use AI tools fluently** as part of your design practice—for exploration, prototyping, synthesis, and to accelerate the parts of the work that benefit from acceleration.

#### **How We Work:**


* We pair tightly with PM and engineering to develop delightful, scalable solutions.
* Hands\-on leadership—managers still design.
* AI is a real, ongoing part of how we work—across design tooling, prototyping, and product. We expect everyone on the team to be fluent and curious here.
* We ship, and we ship often. We learn from what's live as much as from what's in Figma.

### **What You Need to be Successful:**


#### **You're a good fit if you have:**


* A **strong portfolio** showing end\-to\-end product design work on consumer products—ideally mobile.
* Experience taking complex feature work from problem to ship, owning the design throughout.
* Experience working with a design system—using it, contributing to it, and knowing when to push back on it.
* Experience grounding decisions in research and data—and a willingness to seek them out when they're not available.
* Strong written and verbal communication—you can explain your decisions to product, engineering, and leadership.

#### **Traits:**


* **Pride in quality**: You sweat the details—interaction, visual, copy, edge cases—and you treat your craft as something you're actively growing.
* **Systems thinking**: You see the connections between parts of a product, and you design with the wider experience in mind.
* **Problem\-first mindset**: You're rigorous about understanding the real problem, the real user, and the real constraints before committing to a direction.
* **Bias for action**: You move fast, prototype to learn, and resist the pull of polishing in isolation.
* **AI\-curious**: You're active in using AI tools to extend what you can do and reshape your design practice.
* **Generous collaborator**: You give and receive feedback well, and you're invested in making the work better—not just yours.

### **What's in it for You:**


* **Accelerate your career growth** by joining one of Europe's most talked about disruptors.
* **Employee benefits** that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness \& wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
* **Premium banking services**: As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account, as well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
* **Generous time off**: Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
* **Autonomy \& culture**: A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting\-edge technologies—all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences, and family statuses.
* **Relocation support**: A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

### **Who We Are**

We're Camping, a small\-but\-mighty brand storytelling \& video agency based in Barcelona, helping B2B tech companies transform from 'boring' to heartfelt through brand \& video storytelling.


As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Senior Account Manager who can lead client relationships across both our brand strategy projects (positioning, identity, brand architecture) and our B2B video work \- someone strategic enough to partner with client\-side CMOs, and structured enough to keep multi\-workstream delivery on track.


Have we mentioned we have a 4\-day workweek?

**The role**
------------


You'll be the strategic glue between our clients and our creative team. This role combines senior client management with hands\-on project leadership across two types of work: (1\) brand evolution projects \- positioning, verbal \& visual identity, brand architecture \- and (2\) B2B video campaigns. Think of it as being the partner who keeps the relationship strong while making sure brand strategy and creative execution land where they should.


You'll work closely with our Creative Director, Strategist, Designers, and external collaborators (freelance copywriters, strategists). You'll lead briefings, facilitate strategic conversations with clients, coordinate timelines across multi\-workstream projects, and make sure brand work doesn't drift during execution.


While you won't be the brand strategist, you'll be the person who deeply understands brand work, can hold strategic conversations with client\-side CMOs, and can move a brand project from kickoff to delivery while keeping our internal strategists focused on the strategy itself.


This is a full\-time position.

**Core responsibilities**
-------------------------

**Brand Project Leadership:**

* Co\-lead brand evolution projects: Partner with our internal strategist and creative director to facilitate brand positioning, visual \& verbal identity, and brand architecture work for B2B clients. Keep strategic intent intact from brief to delivery.
* Be the client's strategic partner: Run client workshops, presentations, and feedback sessions for brand work. Translate between client stakeholders and our creative/strategy team.
* Manage external collaborators: Coordinate freelance copywriters, strategists, and designers brought in for specific brand initiatives.

### **Project Delivery \& Coordination:**

* Own end\-to\-end project coordination: Manage video project timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder alignment from brief to delivery. Make sure everyone knows what's happening, when, and why.
* Act as video producer: Brief creative teams, coordinate production schedules, manage feedback rounds, and ensure videos meet quality standards and deadlines.
* Be the client's go\-to contact: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, maintaining healthy relationships, responding quickly to questions, and keeping them informed throughout the project lifecycle.
* Manage complex campaigns: Coordinate multi\-workstream campaigns with tight deadlines, keep all moving parts organized, and prevent last\-minute chaos through proactive planning and clear communication.
* Quality assurance \& feedback management: Ensure deliverables meet quality standards, manage client feedback efficiently, and coordinate revision rounds with the creative team.

### **Client Communication \& Collaboration**

* Fast, clear communication: Respond quickly to client questions and requests, provide regular status updates, and keep communication flowing smoothly between clients and the creative team.
* Internal team coordination: Work closely with Creative Director, Strategists, Motion Designers, Editors, and Producers to align on project goals, deadlines, and creative direction.
* Problem\-solving \& adaptability: Handle unexpected challenges smoothly, find solutions when things don't go as planned, and keep projects on track despite obstacles.

### **Project Oversight \& Service Delivery**

* Oversee project execution: Make sure all project deliverables are on time, on quality, and on budget.
* Team Leadership: Coordinate with internal creative teams (Creative Director, Producer, Designer, Post\-production Coordinator) to ensure optimal resource allocation and project delivery.
* Quality Assurance: Maintain high standards of creative output and service delivery, ensuring all work meets client expectations and agency quality benchmarks.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required Experience \& Skills**

* 5\+ years of agency account management experience, with proven ability to own senior client relationships AND coordinate multi\-workstream delivery. We need someone who can do both strategically \- not just project\-track.
* Experience leading brand or rebrand projects: You've coordinated brand positioning, visual identity, or brand architecture work \- either as an AM at a branding agency or running brand projects inside a creative agency. You're comfortable in strategic conversations, not just delivery ones.
* Client relationship skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication abilities, comfortable being the day\-to\-day contact for clients, maintaining healthy relationships, and managing expectations.
* Excellent communication skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication, quick to respond, clear in updates, and able to explain complex project details simply.
* Creative \& brand industry expertise: Deep understanding of creative workflows (brand projects, video production, agency operations), and the ability to translate creative and strategic concepts into business value for clients.
* Tools proficiency: Experience with project management tools (Asana, Monday, ClickUp, etc.) and comfortable learning new systems quickly.
* High level of fluency in English, both written and spoken. Please refrain from applying if you do not possess this proficiency, as it is a mandatory requirement for our international clientele.

### **The Perfect Fit Will Also Have**

* Brand agency or in\-house brand experience: You've worked at a branding agency or led brand work in a creative/marketing agency. You know what "brand architecture" or "verbal identity" mean without needing a glossary.
* Video production exposure: Comfortable coordinating video projects too \- you don't need to be a producer, but you understand the workflow.
* B2B SaaS experience: Familiarity with B2B marketing, SaaS companies, and their unique project needs and timelines.
* Remote Client Management: Proven ability to manage client relationships across different time zones, working effectively with distributed teams and maintaining strong relationships despite geographical distance.
* Tech Industry Knowledge: Understanding of the technology sector, B2B marketing landscape, workflow automation tools, and emerging trends in the developer and IT professional market.
* Performance Marketing Understanding: Experience with performance tracking, campaign analytics, and ability to demonstrate ROI and business impact to clients.
* Open\-Source Community Familiarity: Prior experience working with open\-source communities, developer\-focused products, or technical audiences.

### **Your mindset**

* You're strategic, not just operational: You can hold a 1\-hour conversation with a CMO about brand positioning and walk out with clarity and trust. You don't outsource strategic conversations to others.
* You're a natural coordinator who thrives on keeping projects organized, ensuring everyone is aligned, and making complex deliveries feel smooth and effortless.
* You're detail\-oriented but also keep the big picture in mind—nothing falls through the cracks, but you also understand how each piece connects to the client's goals.
* You communicate clearly and proactively—clients and team members always know where things stand, what's next, and what they need to do.
* You're passionate about creative excellence and can effectively balance client business objectives with creative integrity and innovation.
* You're calm under pressure and adapt quickly when plans change—you find solutions rather than stress, and keep projects moving forward.
* You take ownership and follow through—when you say something will get done, it gets done.

### **Location**


This position is based in Barcelona, Spain. We won't be taking candidates that aren't able to live in Barcelona. For all non\-contract positions, you must have the right to work in Spain.

**Working model**
-----------------

* We're **trialing a 4\-day workweek with Fridays off.** For our team, Taking Friday off is a bonus, and it's conditional to our workload being effectively managed and our commitments being properly attended.
* **Flexible working hours are a given**, as we trust you to manage your schedule effectively.
* We work in a **hybrid model**, with at least two days per week at our office in the Poblenou area.

**Diversity \& Inclusion**
--------------------------


At Camping we believe that diverse teams drive creativity, innovation, and success. We are committed to building an inclusive culture where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, ability, age, religion, or background, feel valued, heard, and empowered to thrive. We celebrate diverse perspectives and actively work to ensure equal opportunity for all applicants and team members.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Immediate incorporation
* **Monthly retainer of 2\.500€**
* **4\-day workweek with Fridays off** (on trial)**, flexible working hours, and a hybrid model** with at least two days per week in our office in the Poblenou area.
* The opportunity to work with a dynamic and growing agency.
* Engage with innovative B2B tech companies on impactful projects.
* Be a key player in shaping our client relationships and team success.

title: Senior Analyst / SME - EDD
description:
**About us:**



BVNK is the stablecoin\-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.



We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130\+ countries, with 40\+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.



Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world\-class team to make it happen.



Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.



By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.



We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.



We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:


* CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026\)
* FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross\-border Payment Companies (2026\)
* Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025\)
* LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025\)


**About this role in the team:**



Following enhancements to our Customer Risk Assessment (CRA) methodology and the implementation of expanded Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) standards, BVNK is expanding its Customer Portfolio Risk (CPR) team.


We are seeking a Senior EDD Analyst / Subject Matter Expert (SME) reporting directly to the Head of Customer Portfolio Risk (CPR). This high\-impact role will lead complex remediation activities, conduct advanced EDD reviews, perform direct customer AML control walkthroughs, and manage specialized regulatory and vertical assessments across onboarding and ongoing monitoring.


As a senior individual contributor and SME, you will handle high\-risk, multi\-layered corporate structures, complex product flows (e.g., Fiat Nested, Embedded Partner Managed), and specialized high\-risk verticals (e.g., Gambling, CFDs/High\-Risk Trading, Virtual Assets).


**Key Areas of Responsibilities:**


##### **1\. Remediation \& Advanced EDD Execution**


* Lead end\-to\-end complex EDD remediation for high\-risk corporate clients under updated risk models.
* Conduct deep\-dive ownership analysis on multi\-layer structures (e.g., 3\+ layers of legal entities, trusts, foundations, offshore/secrecy jurisdictions), identifying Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) to 10% ownership thresholds.
* Verify Source of Funds (SoF) and Source of Wealth (SoW) for entities and UBOs using commercial databases, tax returns, audited financials, and open\-source intelligence (OSINT).
* Execute jurisdiction\-specific EDD requirements across global operations (EU, UK, US, and APAC per local regulatory annexes).

##### **2\. Regulatory \& High\-Risk Vertical Assessments**


* Conduct full Regulatory Assessments for regulated clients (B2B/B2C) and nested/embedded models, including license verification against official registries, equivalence reviews, and scope/permission validation.
* Perform Geographic \& Reverse Solicitation Analyses, including "Initiative Tests" to identify active targeting of non\-licensed jurisdictions using digital, marketing, payment rail, and operational indicators.
* Conduct sector\-specific High\-Risk Vertical Assessments (e,g. Gambling, CFDs \& Leveraged Products, Virtual Assets \&CASPs) in line with BVNK guidance.
* Research regulatory standards and high\-risk verticals to support a risk\-based approach and present strategic recommendations to Second Line Compliance.

##### **3\. AML Control Walkthroughs \& Policy Reviews**


* Lead live AML Control Walkthroughs (video and occasionally in person) with client compliance and operational teams to test and validate their live CDD, payment screening, transaction monitoring, and SAR escalation environments.
* Perform desktop reviews of third\-party AML/CFT, Sanctions, and Transaction Monitoring, policies and procedures and external audit reports to identify material gaps and agree remediation action plans.

##### **4\. Ongoing Portfolio Oversight \& Quality Assurance**


* Manage complex scheduled Annual Periodic Reviews (APRs), Event\-Driven Reviews (EDRs), and Embedded Partner Customer (EPC) reviews for higher\-risk accounts.
* Act as a Checker / Escalation SME, reviewing and approving complex CDD/EDD files, risk rating shifts, account change requests, and nested flow authorisations.
* Conduct advanced transaction pattern analysis comparing 12\-month transaction volumes against expected activity profiles and known risk typologies.
* Serve as a key liaison to the Second Line Compliance, MLROs, and Senior Management for high\-risk client approvals and policy escalations.


**What we need from you:**



Requirements:


* 5\+ years of direct experience in B2B corporate compliance, EDD, and risk assessment within high risk industries
* Recognized Subject Matter Expertise (SME) in evaluating complex corporate entities (holding companies, trusts, foundations, offshore structures).
* Deep understanding of regulatory assessment frameworks, cross\-border licensing rules, and financial crime requirements (FATF, FCA, MGA, FinCEN, MiCA).
* Experience using enterprise compliance case management systems for tracking end\-to\-end review lifecycles.
* Exceptional written risk assessment capabilities—ability to synthesize complex financial, corporate, and transactional data into clear executive summaries.
* High autonomy, strong self\-organization, and ability to manage complex case pipelines in a high\-growth environment.


Nice to Have:


* Exposure to Fintech, Gaming, Crypto/VASP, and/or CFD/Fx industries
* Hands\-on experience executing AML Control Walkthroughs and evaluating third\-party compliance environments.
* Practical exposure to blockchain analytics tools (Chainalysis, TRM, Elliptic) and Travel Rule protocol requirements.
* Strong proficiency in data querying and analytics (Snowflake SQL or similar data environment experience highly regarded).
* Proven ability to engage professionally with C\-level executives, MLROs, and Compliance Directors during client walkthroughs and remediation discussions.


**What you can expect from us:**


* Fair and **competitive salary** at every stage of your growth
* **Flexible working** hours, with hybrid working at its heart
* A **culture** built on passionate, growth\-minded people
* A **flexible approach to holiday**
* Opportunities to travel to our **offices around the world**
* An **open and creative environment** where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets


*At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we'd encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.*

title: Lead Animator
description:
**Company Description** **Join The Game!**


Leader in the development and publishing of games, Gameloft® has established itself as a pioneer in the industry, creating innovative gaming experiences for over 20 years. Gameloft creates games for all digital platforms, from mobile to cross\-platform titles for PC and consoles. Gameloft operates its own established franchises such as Asphalt®, Dragon Mania Legends, Modern Combat and Dungeon Hunter and also partners with major rights holders including LEGO®, Universal, Illumination Entertainment, Hasbro®, Fox Digital Entertainment, Mattel®, Lamborghini®, and Ferrari®. Gameloft distributes its games in over 100 countries and employs 3,000 people worldwide. Every month, 55 million unique users can be reached by advertisers in Gameloft games with Gameloft for brands, a leading B2B offering dedicated to brands and agencies. Gameloft is a Vivendi company.

 **Job Description** **WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON**

**Your main challenge**


Gameloft Barcelona is looking for a **Lead Animator** to lead the animation team working on a new action\-based, multi\-platform IP featuring world\-famous characters from a major licensor.


Your challenge will be to establish and maintain a high animation quality bar while leading and developing the team behind it. You will combine people leadership with strong animation expertise, working closely with Art, Game Design, Programming and external partners to ensure every animation supports the personality of our characters, gameplay readability and the overall player experience.

**What it means on a daily basis**

* **Lead and develop the animation team**, providing regular feedback, mentoring and guidance while supporting the individual growth of animators across different seniority levels.
* **Own the animation quality bar**, ensuring character animation delivers the expected level of movement, weight, acting, storytelling and personality while remaining consistent with the project's artistic direction and licensor expectations.
* **Plan and oversee animation production**, managing priorities, workload and delivery while keeping stakeholders informed and stepping into hands\-on animation work when the team needs additional support.
* **Collaborate closely with Game Design, Programming, Art and Technical Animation** to ensure animations work effectively within gameplay, including topics related to rigging, skinning and game\-engine animation states.
* **Coordinate animation work with external partners**, providing clear briefs, reviews and actionable feedback to ensure outsourced animation integrates consistently with the work produced internally.

**What success will look like**

**Within your first 3 months**, you will have developed a strong understanding of the project's animation direction, characters, production pipeline and team, establishing effective ways of working with the animators and key partner disciplines.

**Within 6 months**, you will be confidently leading animation production and team development, maintaining a consistent quality bar, identifying production or quality risks early and ensuring the team receives the direction and feedback needed to deliver.

**Within 9 months**, you will be a key reference for animation across the project, helping the team operate with increasing autonomy while continuously raising animation quality and strengthening collaboration between Animation, Art, Design, Programming and external partners.

**Who you would be working with**


You will report to the **Studio Art Development Director** and lead a team of **3D Animators and Technical 3D Animators**.


You will work closely with the Studio Art Director, 3D Art Lead, Game Design, Programming and other production disciplines, while also collaborating with external animation partners and the project's licensor.

**Your recruitment journey**


Our recruitment process is designed to give you the opportunity to meet the people you would work with and explore both your animation expertise and leadership experience.

* Recruiter interview
* Hiring team interview
* Animation assessment/test, where applicable
* Final interview

**Where this role can take you**


This role gives you the opportunity to take ownership of animation at project level, developing both your craft and leadership expertise while contributing to a major multi\-platform IP.


You will have the opportunity to grow as an animation leader, influence animation standards and workflows, develop other artists and collaborate closely with senior creative and technical stakeholders across the project.

 **Qualifications** **WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Strong expertise in **3D character animation for games**, with the ability to create and evaluate both realistic and stylized/cartoon animation.
* Excellent understanding of **movement, weight, acting, timing and storytelling**, with the ability to preserve the identity and personality of a character through animation.
* Ability to **establish, communicate and maintain animation quality standards**, translating animation principles into clear visual, written and verbal feedback.
* Strong understanding of **game animation production and real\-time workflows**, including effective collaboration with Technical Animators on rigging, skinning and game\-engine animation states.
* Ability to plan and prioritize animation work, manage production constraints and communicate clearly with stakeholders regarding scope, quality and delivery.
* Professional experience with industry\-standard **3D animation tools and workflows**, particularly character animation pipelines such as Maya and/or 3ds Max.
* Fluent English and the ability to communicate effectively within an international and multidisciplinary development environment.
* A portfolio or showreel demonstrating strong character animation work and relevant game animation experience.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* A supportive people leader who can mentor and develop animators across different levels of seniority.
* Comfortable giving clear, constructive and actionable feedback while maintaining a high creative quality bar.
* Collaborative and able to act as a central point of communication between Animation, Art, Game Design, Programming and external partners.
* Organized and able to manage changing priorities in a dynamic production environment.
* Hands\-on when needed, with a **lead\-by\-example** approach and the ability to balance team leadership with direct creative contribution.

  

**Additional Information** **Why Join the World of Gameloft?**

* Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
* Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
* Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries \& cultures!
* Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
* Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

**Benefits:**

* Permanent contract and full\-time position with excellent social benefits.
* 25 vacation days per year.
* Private medical health insurance.
* Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
* Flexible work\-from\-home hybrid model.
* Free language courses.
* Your birthday off!
* 1 month of remote work.
* Merit\-based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
* Career development opportunities.
* Excellent working conditions, with our office located in the centre of Barcelona.
* ...and Thursday after\-work beers!

**We can’t wait to find our next great talent!**


Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross\-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!


Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months.

**Want to know more?** Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com


If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

title: Senior Strategic Brand Manager
description:
Overview:
**WELCOME TO SITA**

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.


You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don’t just move the world forward—we’re proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work®** by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


SITA is at a pivotal moment. We are investing in our next generation of technology and rebuilding our marketing capability to match.


This role leads the Brand and Design function for SITA. You will own the brand strategy, the visual identity system, and the creative output that represents SITA internally and externally. You will manage the creative director, the brand manager, and the design team, acting as the connective tissue between brand thinking and creative execution. Your job is to set the standard, define where the brand needs to go, and make sure that everything we put into the world looks and feels like a company that leads its industry.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Brand platform**

* Build the strategic brand platform: brand architecture, personality, verbal and visual identity.
* Turn the platform into tools that global, business unit and regional teams can use without waiting for approval.
* Define how the brand evolves, and make the investment case to leadership when it needs to.

**Messaging and verbal identity**

* Own the corporate messaging architecture and tone of voice.
* Give portfolio and business unit the framework their product messaging builds on.
* Review flagship corporate content for message and tone.

**Media \& Advertising*** Own the brand campaign idea and the creative platform that carries it across paid, owned and earned channels.
* Direct advertising production end to end: concept, art direction, copy, film and adaptation across markets.
* Own brand media end to end: strategy, planning, buying, budget and the media agency relationship.
* Own the trade media, sponsorship and industry partnership portfolio
* Work with campaigns so brand and demand media run on one plan, one calendar and one set of audience definitions.

**Design and creative direction**

* Set a design direction that breaks with legacy telco and IT codes.
* Direct flagship work personally: publications, executive presentations, films and event environments.
* Own the creative brief standard, and approve or reject work from internal teams and agencies.

**Brand experience**

* Own how we are experienced at major industry moments: exhibition presence, demo environments and briefing spaces.
* Translate event narratives into space, staging, demo flow and visual system.
* Brief experiential and production partners and hold them to the standard.

**Governance and partners**

* Own guidelines, templates, the asset library and a review process that works at scale.
* Own creative direction and quality for brand, design and experience agencies.

**Team**

* Lead the brand manager, graphic designer and video team, and set the quality bar for their work.


Qualifications:
**WHO YOU ARE**

* 10 or more years in brand, design, or creative leadership, with at least 3 of those in a senior role managing a team
* Proven track record of owning and evolving a B2B brand, not just executing against someone else's framework
* Experience managing creative directors or senior designers, with a clear point of view on what good looks like
* Background in technology, aviation, or another complex industry sector is an advantage but not a requirement
* Experience working in a matrixed global organization, with the commercial sensitivity to navigate competing priorities
* Experience managing external agencies, from briefing through execution, ensuring high\-quality delivery, brand consistency, and alignment with strategic objectives.
* Strong brand strategist who can operate at both the strategic and detail level when required.
* Excellent written and verbal communicator, able to articulate the case for brand investment to senior leadership
* Confident creative director who can give clear, constructive feedback to designers and agencies
* Comfortable managing timelines, budgets, and agency relationships without losing sight of the strategic picture
* Publication\-ready written English; able to write a brand rationale, a creative brief, or a board\-level summary with equal confidence
* Direct, decisive and highly organized, with the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining the strategic picture.
* Resilient and comfortable operating in a dynamic and evolving environment.
* Collaborative leader who adapts communication and leadership style to engage effectively with senior executives, peers and junior team members.

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

  

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.  

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

  

**Flex\-Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.  

**Employee Wellbeing:** We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.  

**Professional Development:** At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world\-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** and **Airport Council International** \-available to all employees\-to specialized solutions like **Pluralsight** for technology upskilling, **Harvard Business Publishing** for people leadership, **Stanford** for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.  

**Competitive Benefits:** Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status. *SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*  


Compensation Note: Hidden (\-999\)

title: Head of Engineering
description:
**Lead engineering that powers how thousands of finance teams spend**
=====================================================================


Spendesk is the AI\-powered spend management and procurement platform trusted by thousands of finance teams across Europe. As our **Head of Engineering**, you'll lead a complete engineering group — several Engineering Managers, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers — reporting directly to our CTO. You'll set the technical and organisational direction for your area, build the leadership team that runs it, and be accountable for the economics, reliability, and pace of everything it ships.


You will work with 2 to 4 Engineering Managers, reporting directly to you. You will collaborate with the Head of Product and the Head of Design, and other Head of Engineering responsible for other groups.


Your will be responsible for a multi\-disciplinary engineering team of 20\-30 people, with different seniority and skillset, spread across Europe.


**What you'll own**
-------------------


**Technical \& organisational strategy**


* Define the multi\-quarter technical and organisational strategy for your group, aligned with Spendesk's company strategy.
* Drive architectural decisions and simplification across your domain — clear domain boundaries, “platformisation”, debt reduction.
* Make build vs. buy vs. partner calls, and own your group's AI/tooling strategy: what to standardise, what to pilot, and how you measure impact.
* Own your area's economics — cost\-to\-serve, infra efficiency, hiring ROI — with a clear quarterly view, and present the commercial rationale behind your investment decisions.

**Delivery \& operations**


* Be accountable for delivery and outcomes across your full portfolio of squads, balancing competing priorities without losing sight of quality.
* Establish group\-level KPIs, SLOs, and operating rhythms so your teams run well without you in every room.
* Champion end\-to\-end observability, sensible on\-call, and postmortems that actually change things — reducing incident frequency and MTTR over time.
* Sequence hiring and headcount to maximise impact, and defend that plan to stakeholders with data.

**Building your leadership team**


* Hire, develop, and retain a strong, balanced leadership team of EMs, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers.
* Coach your managers through their hardest calls: performance conversations, hiring decisions, prioritisation trade\-offs.
* Lead performance calibration for your group and make the final call on promotions and compensation.
* Build succession plans for your key leadership roles, so no single departure puts your group at risk.
* Actively invest in retaining your best people, and keep a genuine pulse on team sentiment.

**Influence beyond your team**


* Represent Engineering in company\-wide forums, partnering closely with Product, Design, Data, and customer\-facing teams.
* Communicate your strategy and trade\-offs clearly to both engineers and executives — you're as comfortable defending a roadmap to the leadership team as you are challenging an incident response plan.
* Champion diversity and inclusion in how you hire, develop, and run your organisation.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------


* 8\+ years in software engineering with increasing scope, including 3\+ years managing managers (Team Leads/EMs).
* A track record of delivering complex, multi\-stakeholder programmes in product\-led SaaS on time, on budget, with measurable results. Fintech, payments, or compliance experience is a strong plus.
* Hands\-on experience operating distributed systems at scale in production, and enough technical depth to earn credibility with ICs and Team Leads, not just manage around them.
* Comfort with our stack (TypeScript, Node, React, AWS…). You don't need to write code daily, but you need to read it and question it.
* Real business acumen: you can talk unit economics, ROI, and trade\-offs as fluently as you talk architecture.
* A genuine track record of growing managers into better managers, not just engineers into better engineers.

**Why this role, why now**
==========================


You'll join at a moment where the group you lead has room to simplify, room to invest in AI\-augmented engineering, and a leadership team worth building further. You'll have a documented path behind you and ahead of you: Spendesk's Engineering Leadership Growth Journey maps the road from Engineering Manager through Head of Engineering to CTO, so you'll know exactly what's expected of you, and what growing further looks like once you're here.


You'll be based in one of our offices (Paris, London or Barcelona), with a flexible on\-site rhythm agreed with your team.


As we are an international team, please submit your application and CV in English.  

  



  

**About Spendesk**

Spendesk is the AI\-powered spend management and procurement platform that transforms company spending. **DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS has successfully launched the European Sovereign Cloud (ESC), marking a significant development in Utility Computing (UC). To spearhead this initiative, we are actively seeking experienced systems development engineers with a strong background in automation and operations. As part of the AWS Managed Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in building, operating and evolving operations and development teams dedicated to delivering high\-availability AWS services, including EC2, S3, Dynamo, Lambda, and Bedrock, exclusively for EU customers. For more information on ESC please check out our blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/in\-the\-works\-aws\-european\-sovereign\-cloud/
  

  

Your responsibilities will encompass overseeing the ongoing operations and expansion of the ESC, working closely with global AWS teams, and influencing the evolution of AWS services and technology. A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day\-to\-day operations, and ensuring continuous improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You will be required to occasionally participate in "on\-call" rotations to resolve incidents occurring out\-of\-hours.
  

  

The overarching goal is to deliver scalable services and ensure a high\-availability experience for EU customers. If you are an experienced professional ready for a challenging and impactful opportunity, we invite you to join our efforts in operating and scaling a best\-in\-class development engineering and operations team that aligns with AWS' commitment to customer satisfaction and continual innovation.
  

  

Utility Computing (UC)
  

European Sovereign Cloud (ESC) is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC).
  

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Managed Operations engineers engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.
  

  

A Day in the Life
  

A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day\-to\-day operations, and ensuring improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You’ll spend roughly 50% of your time operating production systems and 50% working with your team to make long\-term improvements to the reliability, availability, and performance of those software systems. Over the course of a week, you will root cause why some deployments recently failed, and fix those bugs. Later in the week you may execute a highly sensitive time\-critical change to production. You can round off the week by participating in design discussions by another team, writing code, and providing actionable feedback to your team’s code. You will be required to occasionally participate in “on\-call” rotations to resolve incidents occurring out\-of\-hours.
  

  

Eligibility requirement
  

Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
  

  

Candidate must be a national of an EU member state and residing in the EU to operate the AWS European Sovereign Cloud.
  

  

Amazon will provide relocation support for successful applicants relocating within the European Union.
  

  

Employees will participate in an On\-Call rota.

About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance

title: Market Analyst
description:
**About Modo Energy**
---------------------



The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.



We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.



Founded in 2019, we're 90\+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI\-native, and moving fast.



This is a rare chance to join a category\-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

**The Role**



We're hiring an Iberia Market Analyst to build Modo Energy's products for Spain and Portugal. Iberia is one of Europe's fastest\-moving storage markets, and our customers rely on us to understand how batteries earn revenue there.



This is a builder's role. You'll design the data workflows behind our Iberian coverage, build and ship benchmarks, and work with our European forecast team to shape the forecast product for both markets. You'll also help teach Ko, our AI analyst, to become the best source of answers on Iberia.



We're looking for a generalist. You should be as comfortable automating a data pipeline as explaining a market to a customer, and you should enjoy turning messy data into products people use.



Our coverage is battery energy storage, solar, wind and data centres, and we expect it to grow.



You'll be part of the Iberia team, reporting to the Iberia Regional Head and working closely with engineering and the European forecasting team.


**What You'll Be Doing**


* Build and automate the data workflows behind our Iberian coverage, from TSOs, NEMOs, and other sources.
* Build, maintain and ship Iberian benchmarks, working with engineering to deploy them to customers on the Modo Energy Terminal.
* Train Ko on Iberia: Improve how useful our AI model is to clients. Expose the right datasets, improve its answers, and deepen its market knowledge.
* Work with the European forecast team on the Spanish and Portuguese forecasts: fundamentals, market design, and how regulatory and market changes feed into the models.
* Maintain a grid\-scale asset and capacity register for Spain and Portugal.
* Use AI to build tools and workflows that help you and the team scale.
* Contribute market insight through research and customer calls.


**What We're Looking For**


*The Essentials*


* You like building things, and you use AI to build tools and workflows.
* 2\+ years of experience in power markets, energy analytics, data, or a technical analyst role.
* Strong programming skills. You can interrogate complex datasets and pick up new tools quickly.
* Familiarity with battery energy storage or wider energy transition themes.
* A generalist mindset: comfortable moving between data, product, and market questions.
* Clear written communication.
* Professional fluency in Spanish and English.
* You're comfortable building products for a region from the ground up.


*Nice To Have*


* Knowledge of Iberian electricity markets: OMIE day\-ahead and intraday, REE balancing services (aFRR, mFRR, RR), and the capacity mechanism.
* Experience with data pipelines or workflow orchestration (e.g. Airflow, Dagster, dbt).
* Experience building data products or modelling tools, such as revenue models or dispatch optimisation.
* A working knowledge of Portuguese.


**Please note we can only consider candidates who already have the right to work in Spain, as we can't offer visa sponsorship at this time.**

If you require assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at careers@modoenergy.com.

You'll have real ownership from day one, work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry, and be part of a company that's defining a new category in the global energy market. We're hybrid: everyone works Tuesday to Thursday in office, with Monday and Friday flexible. We offer top\-of\-market compensation, equity for every employee, and the space to take your career wherever you want it to go.



We're looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers. If that's you, we want to talk.

title: Project Manager (Video Ads)
description:
A freelance project manager to run video ad campaigns for B2B tech clients, from the first brief to the final file.

**About us**
------------


We're Camping, a brand storytelling and video agency in Barcelona. We help B2B tech companies go from 'boring' to heartfelt, through brand work and video.


Have we mentioned we have a 4\-day workweek?

**The role**
------------


We have more video ad campaigns coming in than our project team can run, and some of them could start in the next few weeks. So we're looking for one more project manager, as a freelancer.


A campaign for us is usually 6 to 12 ads, and then the cutdowns, resizes and language versions for every platform. More and more often the videos are made fully or partly with AI. You take the campaign from the kickoff call to the last file. You're the client's main contact, you send them scripts and cuts, collect their feedback and turn it into clear next steps for the team.


You'll work with our creative director, strategists, AI creatives, producers and freelance editors and motion designers. You won't be the director or the strategist. You'll be the person who knows where every ad stands and tells us early when something slips. Most of the work is in post\-production, the rest is pre\-production and shoots.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run several video ad campaigns at the same time, from kickoff to final delivery
* Be the client's day\-to\-day contact: send scripts, cuts and updates, and run the feedback rounds
* Plan pre\-production and shoots with our producers, directors and production partners
* Book and brief freelance editors, motion designers, color and sound, and track every revision round
* Keep Asana, Notion and Frame.io up to date, so anyone on the team can see where a project stands
* Check every ad before it goes to the client: formats, aspect ratios, subtitles, specs for each platform
* Flag changes to timeline, budget or scope to our Head of Production before you promise anything to the client

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3\+ years as a project manager, producer or post\-production coordinator on ads and campaigns, in an agency or a production company
* You know how post\-production works: edit, motion, color, sound and final deliveries
* You've handled campaigns with many versions of the same ad, and you don't lose track of which cut is the latest
* You've been the main contact for clients, and you can say no when a request doesn't fit the plan
* Fluent English and Spanish. Our clients work in English, and a lot of our team and suppliers work in Spanish
* You live in Barcelona. Shoots and part of the team are here

**Nice to have**
----------------

* B2B tech or SaaS clients
* You've worked on AI\-generated video and you know tools like Runway or Higgsfield
* Paid social: you know what Meta, LinkedIn and YouTube need from an ad file

**How we'll work together**
---------------------------


This is a freelance role at 2,500 EUR per month (plus VAT), invoiced as a freelancer or a company. We work with you full\-time on our 4\-day week, Monday to Thursday, with flexible hours and at least two days a week at our office in Poblenou.


We'd like to start as soon as possible.

**Diversity \& Inclusion**
--------------------------


At Camping, diverse teams drive better ideas and better work. We welcome collaborators from all backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, respectful environment for everyone we work with.

title: Client Advisor, Casa LOEWE Barcelona
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.
  

  

As **Client Advisor** , you will ensure that our client service expectations are exceeded in a personable, playful, and engaging way, enabling you to deliver your individual and team goals.


### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Achieve individual and store objectives.
* Connect with clients in an engaging emotional way to provide an exceptional and memorable client experience.
* Engage with all clients and develop long lasting relationships.
* Maintain relations with clients through regular communication and connection via email, phone, messages, or personalized notes.
* Master and transmit our brand history and heritage.
* Highlight our product categories through your product knowledge and storytelling.
* Develop and grow your client book, updating client information on the relevant company tools.
* Perform as a team player, participating and collaborating in all activities contributing to the overall objectives of the store.
* Actively participate in visual merchandising in accordance with LOEWE’s visual standards.
* Maintain products in an efficient, clean, secure, and organized manner; front and back of house.
* Support with inventory management and ad hoc back of house tasks.
* Follow the company’s policies and procedures including LOEWE’s standards in terms of grooming and behavior.
### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Proven experience in achieving individual goals and contributing to team results.
* Experience within a similar customer centric role.
* Deep interest in Fashion, Art, and Culture.
* Be naturally inclusive and open minded.
* Confident, service orientated, adaptable and empathetic in style and approach.
* Effective communication skills with the sensitivities to build and maintain a client portfolio.
* Results driven with a commercial mindset without compromising on the Team Player attitude.
* Fluent in English and Spanish; any other language will be considered a plus.
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Global Head of Operations Excellence
description:
Galderma is the emerging pure\-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science\-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast\-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ \- the skin \- meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.  



We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.  



At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.


Further supporting our growth and innovation momentum, we are establishing a new Global Capability Center in Barcelona to deploy new capabilities to effectively support its global commercial and functional teams. Located in the upscale Eixample District in the heart of Barcelona, Galderma’s Global Capability Center offers numerous possibilities for professional development such as exposure to global and cross\-functional projects and access to global career opportunities.


**Location: Barcelona or London**

  

**Summary**  

  

Galderma is seeking to reinforce its world\-class industrial capacities through the implementation of a global end\-to\-end lean supply and manufacturing program. Within this framework, we are seeing an experienced Global Head of Operations Excellence to develop, set the pace and accelerate our Operations transformational and continuous improvement strategy with sensitivity towards the organizational structure, culture, people and processes.  



Working with Operations functions, and their embedded excellence resources, including Supply Chain, Quality, External Supply, Industrial Development and Plant leadership, you will coordinate and prioritize the required support for the entire Industrial Operations organization and will ensure standardization, where appropriate, in liaison with the other leaders. Knowledge sharing and communication of best practices will also be a key component of this position across Galderma.  

  



**About The Role**

As Global Head of Operations Excellence, reporting to the Global Head of Operations, you will drive knowledge sharing across the organization by establishing key practitioner groups focused on continuous end to end improvements and convergence on identified best practices. By creating collaboration across departments and functions throughout the Operations organization you will ensure alignment of strategy and tactics for successful excellence implementation.  



You will be responsible for the design, development and implementation of our global lean supply and manufacturing program with the intent to establish linkage and flow, meet customer demand at lowest cost with perfect quality, consolidate rationalization and enhance organizational agility.  



You will be the primary architect and leader of our Operations Excellence Transformation and as such will work to establish programs, practices metrics and standards utilizing lean methodologies, analyze and recommend future state value stream design and also identify opportunities to improve existing practices, procedures and processes toward true north vision. You will lead and mentor leaders and multi\-functional teams to implement a standardized excellence methodology to ensure consistent and rigorous application across the business in line with best practice.  



Based in Barcelona or London, the position holder will be a member of our Operations Leadership Team, and partner closely with various department to collaborate on all aspects of the company's Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing/Procurement and Supply Chain strategies.  



**Core Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and implement Galderma’s end\-to\-end Operations Excellence transformation strategy and deploy a program for lean development across our global supply, industrial and manufacturing footprint including coordination of our drive to 85% Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE)
* Continuously structure, coordinate and update the Operations function annual strategy plan through a clear methodology based on the Hoshin process including dashboard accountability for all Operations functions.
* Conduct Extended Value Stream Baseline analysis, Supplier summit and Kaizen events with site and function leaders to improve performance in the identified areas requiring lean/kaizen support. Provide high level, lean master/sensei support to help build capability and ensure required event objectives are achieved. In addition to that, responsible for progressing lean continuous Improvement (CI) and lean culture penetration.
* Pilot Operations’ evaluation of performance, rationalization and agility through cross functional dashboard ownership and reporting.
* Utilize, drive and promote understanding of Lean and Six\-Sigma tools and principals to ensure the delivery of business objectives and a culture of continuous improvement; develop and implement improvement plans, facilitate daily visual management, lean conversion and root cause and corrective action (RCCA)
* Provide expertise, professional advice and guidance to the business in business improvement, drawing from proven industry practice and methodologies
* Work collaboratively, negotiate and engage with key stakeholders to facilitate delivery and compliance with the Lean strategy
* Communicate with stakeholders the impact of market change and potential effects on Lean methodologies. Recommend solutions without compromising quality or service while optimizing cost
* Effectively coach teams to manage for daily performance using visual controls
* Mentor using Gemba walks and other lead standard work toolkits.
* Coach employees to see abnormal conditions and problem solve systematically
* Lead kaizen events to bring Operations to standard, or improve work performance toward true north
* Ensure 5S/RCCA is taught, implemented and adhered throughout the organization.
Coordinate, schedule and facilitate as applicable Lean/Six Sigma activities to enhance cross\-functional problems solving; utilize Company tool champions as appropriate for more significant lean events  
* 

**About You**

* Solid experience in highly performing manufacturing structures operating at 85%\+ OEE.
* Involvement building and leading successful projects and programs with an understanding of the tactics needed for execution, including overall upskilling and upscaling of manufacturing performance.
* Ambitious, entrepreneurial approach to finding new growth levers for the business
* Outstanding executive presence and presentation skills, with the ability to inspire and engage executives
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple work streams at once
* Exceptional critical thinking and ability to professionally advance others’ understanding of lean metrics and goals
* Result and customer focused with a successful record of accomplishments through skilled use of influence, persuasion, negotiation and resolution
* Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate projects status needs across different levels of the organization and different operating environments
* Determined focused leader; ability to quickly establish credibility throughout the organization by effectively balancing strategic as well as on\-going operations \& execution levels
* Highly collaborative with ability to lead through influence in a matrixed environment
* Relationship builder and can hold people accountable while making them feel energized about the road ahead
* Anticipate the needs of teammates, give and get all the facts making it easy for all to make decisions
Mastery is expected but not limited to JIT, takt, flow, pull, standard work sheet, Jidoka, DMAIC, A3, policy deployment, Toyota production system, TPM, continuous flow, continuous improvement, error proofing, eliminating waste, 5 why’s, heijunka, Kanban, kaizen, linearity, pacemaker, pitch, replenishment system, SWIP, supermarket, standardized work, standard work combo sheet, value stream mapping, visual management.  
* 

**Requirements**

  

* Background in manufacturing, Supply Chain and/or engineering environments within a large global organization, including site manufacturing leadership experience
* Master Black Belt in Six Sigma or equivalent qualification
* Automotive or cost oriented company experience preferred
* Background in people management, project management and digital transformation
* Qualified Trainer certification and experience would be appreciated
* Membership of an industry\-related professional body would be advantageous

description:

**About This Role**




* First marketing hire: you will be the first person in marketing at Janus Digital, and we will build the team around you. * Strategy and execution in one seat: you own Janus Digital’s marketing strategy end to end, setting direction, priorities and budget, and then deliver it day to day, sleeves rolled up.
* This is not a delegate\-only director role: you will run campaigns, manage the MarTech stack and execute paid media personally while you build and shape the team around you.

 **Requirements**  



**What You’ll Do**




* Own and set Janus Digital’s marketing strategy: market prioritisation, positioning, channel mix, budget allocation and annual and quarterly plans, aligned with commercial leadership.
* Define and refine Janus Digital’s commercial narrative and our outcome\-based value proposition for C\-suite economic buyers (CEOs, COOs, CFOs).
* Architect and run Account\-Based Marketing across our launch markets, Singapore and the UK, extending as we scale.
* Pioneer paid Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and chatbot advertising, alongside hands\-on paid LinkedIn and Google SEM.
* Make sales enablement a core priority: build and maintain the sales and partner toolkit – ROI calculators, pitch decks, battlecards, case studies and objection\-handling scripts – and work closely with sales to keep it sharp and in use.
* Manage LinkedIn as our priority social channel, including ghostwriting for our Global CEO and Singapore CEO.
* Deploy and independently manage a lean, AI\-native MarTech stack (Attio, Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Koala, Supabase, Evidence.dev, a headless website, Cookiebot), orchestrated through Slack and Claude.

* 8–12 years of progressive B2B technology marketing experience, selling to C\-suite buyers through long, trust\-led cycles (not self\-serve or product\-led SaaS).

* Strong, practical AI capability: confident using generative AI tools, agents and automation (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, workflow automation) to plan, create and run marketing at scale.

* Prior exposure to paid and organic Answer Engine Optimisation.
* Exposure to partner\-led (B2B2B) go\-to\-market motions.

**What We Offer**




* Full ownership of marketing strategy and delivery, and the opportunity to build and lead the team, with a defined path to CMO as the business scales.

* Deep, hands\-on expertise in AI\-native growth methodologies, ahead of the market.

##### **About the role**


We’re looking for a **detail\-oriented and hands\-on Accounts Payable Specialist** to join our Finance team.


Reporting to the Head of Finance, you’ll play a key role in keeping our accounts payable operations accurate, organized, and running smoothly. You’ll be responsible for validating supplier invoices, reconciling accounts, resolving discrepancies, and executing payment batches while working closely with both internal teams and external suppliers.

In this role, you will be a senior technical and strategic lead to help us leverage the power of AI to the fullest, alongside our other computational, statistical, and machine learning tools. You will work across the enterprise to define and deliver on AstraZeneca’s most pressing clinical development questions. You will proactively collaborate in cross\-functional teams spanning AstraZeneca’s key Oncology foci of hematology, cell therapy, antibody\-drug conjugates, small molecules, and biologics. This is an unprecedented, high visibility opportunity to invent new ways to leverage data, models, and learnings across the spectrum of cancer biology and drug modalities – and importantly, you and the team will apply these new methods to measurably advance the late\-stage drug pipeline and our group’s ambition.


**Responsibilities**


* Define and drive the AI strategy and roadmap for Oncology early and late phase clinical development, and align AI/ML priorities with clinical and business objectives
* Lead, by matrix influence and scientific authority, delivery of complex, high\-stakes AI projects
* Evaluate, develop, and champion cutting\-edge AI methods, end\-to\-end, including problem definition, data considerations, governance, algorithm development, validation, and adoption
* Build cross\-functional relationships with clinical development, biometrics, regulatory, and study teams to embed AI strategy and validated solutions into clinical study design, execution, strategy, and decision\-making
* Establish and maintain external collaborations with academic institutions, technology partners, and industry consortia to access novel capabilities and advance the AI roadmap
* Represent AstraZeneca at scientific conferences, standards bodies, and peer\-reviewed venues; contribute first\- or last\-author publications in leading ML and clinical AI journals
* Establish best practices; help shape and promote team culture
* Mentor and support more junior level scientists within the team

**Required qualifications**


* PhD in a quantitative discipline such as computer science, bioinformatics, computational biology, mathematics, physics, biophysics, computational neuroscience, biostatistics
* 4\-8 years’ work experience outside of PhD with measurable impact (e.g. models delivered, patents, SaMD filings, first\-author publications, open\-source projects, standards\-body participation)

**Technical requirements**


* Exceptional software development and coding skills, leveraging frontier coding agent frameworks; knowledge of computing hardware a plus
* Deep experience, knowledge, and understanding of one or more fields of biology
* Deep understanding of machine learning fundamentals, with domain expertise in one or more of the following
* Training and tuning foundation models
* Bayesian inference
* Temporal modeling
* Multimodal integration and modeling
* Model calibration and domain adaptation
* Data\-centric AI: acquiring, creating, and curating datasets for model training / post\-training / benchmarking / evals
* Model and data evaluations and benchmarking
* Model interpretability
* Model post\-training and alignment

**Preferred skills**


* Deep expertise in cancer biology
* Experience working with biological data such as molecular (e.g. DNA, RNA, protein), imaging (radiology, microscopy), or clinical text (e.g. EHR, clinical notes)
* Experience in drug development including but not limited to clinical trial design, biomarker discovery, companion diagnostics, dosing, safety, endpoints, and regulatory
* Experience in a matrixed global organization spanning multiple sites and therapy areas

**Soft skills**


* Strong proficiency in augmenting but not supplanting daily knowledge work with agentic tools
* Team\-oriented mindset
