* Change Execution
* Madrid, Spain
* ING Bank


  
**At ING we are looking for Business Lead Insurance**

  

  

**Your role and work environment**

  

  

We are looking for a **talented and enthusiastic Business Lead to join our Insurance Tribe**.


The Insurance Tribe has a clear mission: to **make ING the go\-to place for our customers' protection needs**. We are building a different way of doing insurance, creating propositions that are simple, transparent and truly valuable for our customers while contributing to ING's sustainable growth and distributed through best\-in\-class digital experiences.


As Business Lead Insurance, you will be responsible for shaping, growing and transforming our core insurance business, including Home, Life and Payment Protection Insurance (PPI).


Beyond managing and optimizing the current portfolio, you will play a key role in defining ING Spain's future insurance business strategy. This includes identifying new protection opportunities and product categories, designing customer value propositions, leading insurer selection and Request for Proposal (RfP) processes, negotiating partnerships, and overseeing the end\-to\-end setup and launch of new products and business models. You will be expected to combine strategic vision with flawless execution, helping ING continuously evolve its protection offering while delivering sustainable growth and customer value.

  

  

You will own both **today's performance and tomorrow's growth agenda**, balancing portfolio management with the development of the next generation of insurance propositions for ING customers.


This is not a traditional insurance role. You will combine strategy, commercial development, partnership management, product innovation and execution. You will **work across the entire value chain,** connecting customers, insurers, distribution channels, analytics, operations and technology teams to accelerate growth and build the next generation of protection propositions.


You will act as the **senior representative of your products** across the organization and externally, managing relationships with insurance partners, ING Headquarters and senior stakeholders across the bank. You will be expected to influence decision\-making, align multiple interests and build strong partnerships that accelerate business growth.


In addition, you will **lead and develop a team of business strategy professionals**, creating an environment where talent can thrive, fostering accountability, collaboration and high performance, while ensuring the team contributes effectively to the Tribe's strategic objectives.


You will also be responsible for defining and **achieving the commercial objectives** of the insurance portfolio, including production and portfolio targets measured through units sold, Annual Premium Equivalent (APE), Gross Written Premium (GWP) and other relevant business performance indicators.


You will help define where the business goes next while ensuring outstanding execution of today's portfolio.


You'll **report directly to Tribe Lead** and work alongside senior stakeholders across Business, Technology, Operations, Risk, Finance and Marketing.


**What you'll be doing**


**Drive the insurance business strategy**


* Define and execute the strategic roadmap for ING's core insurance portfolio.


* Identify growth opportunities across Home, Life and PPI products.


* Identify future protection opportunities and define ING's long\-term insurance growth agenda.


* Translate market trends, customer needs and business priorities into actionable initiatives.


* Build and maintain business cases for new propositions, partnerships and investments.


* Define commercial ambitions and portfolio targets across sales, APE, GWP and profitability metrics.


**Grow and evolve our insurance portfolio**


* Lead the evolution of existing products to improve commercial performance, customer value and competitiveness.


* Identify gaps in the portfolio and define future protection propositions.


* Design customer\-centric value propositions for new insurance products and services.


* Explore new business models, distribution opportunities and value\-added services.


* Drive product profitability and sustainable growth.


* Lead the end\-to\-end setup and launch of new insurance products.


**Build and manage strategic partnerships**


* Lead relationships with insurance partners and providers.


* Act as ING's senior representative towards insurance companies and key external stakeholders.


* Build strong relationships with ING Headquarters and international insurance stakeholders.


* Ensure partnerships create long\-term value for customers and ING.


* Challenge existing agreements and explore new market opportunities.


* Lead partner selection processes, RfPs, negotiations and commercial agreements.


**Accelerate commercial growth**


* Define actions to improve acquisition, conversion, retention and customer lifetime value.


* Unlock growth opportunities through segmentation, cross\-sell, upsell and bundled propositions.


* Coordinate multiple commercial levers to maximize business performance.


* Own portfolio growth plans and commercial performance targets.


* Work closely with Marketing, Analytics and Customer Journey teams to optimize customer outcomes.


**Lead business transformation**


* Drive end\-to\-end initiatives from idea to implementation.


* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to turn strategic opportunities into tangible results.


* Remove obstacles, align stakeholders and secure execution.


* Help shape the future operating model of the insurance business.


* Lead the implementation of new partnerships, products and capabilities.


**Lead and develop talent**


* Lead, coach and inspire a team of business strategy professionals.


* Build talent, develop future leaders and foster a high\-performance culture.


* Create an environment of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning and innovation.


* Ensure alignment between team objectives and business outcomes.


**Be the voice of the customer and the business**


* Continuously understand customer needs, behaviors and expectations.


* Use data, customer insights and market intelligence to make informed decisions.


* Balance commercial objectives with customer value and long\-term sustainability.


* Act as a role model for customer\-centric thinking.


**What are we looking for?**


We are looking for someone who brings together business vision, execution power and the ability to make things happen in complex environments, with strong leadership capabilities to inspire teams, develop talent and help people grow beyond their own expectations.


**You have**


* At least 5 years of proven experience in the insurance industry, covering both Life and Non\-Life products.


* Strong knowledge of insurance products, distribution models, partnerships and commercial dynamics.


* Experience defining and executing growth and business development strategies.


* Experience managing insurance providers, strategic partnerships and commercial negotiations.


* Experience leading Request for Proposal (RfP) processes and insurer selection projects.


* Experience leading high\-performing teams and developing talent.


* Proven ability to lead complex cross\-functional initiatives.


* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, including senior executive interactions.


* Strong commercial and business development capabilities.


* Strong analytical and strategic thinking.


* Experience working in agile and multidisciplinary environments.


* Fluent English.


**You are**


* Entrepreneurial and ambitious.


* Customer obsessed.


* Data driven.


* Curious and innovative.


* Passionate about transforming the insurance industry.


* Comfortable challenging the status quo.


* A natural connector across teams, disciplines and organizations.


* A strong negotiator and relationship builder.


* An inspiring leader who develops people and teams.


* Able to combine strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.


* Passionate about creating new business opportunities.


* Resilient and able to navigate ambiguity.


**What do we offer?**


The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.

  

  

Check out what is waiting for you!


**Balance That Works.**


We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.


**Meal allowance.**


Receive your meal allowance in the way that best suits you: through a meal card or directly in your payroll, giving you greater flexibility and convenience in managing your everyday needs.


**More than an office.**


In our offices you can find doctor’s office, hairdresser, gym, Employee Concierge (to help you with your errands) and much more!


**Health and life insurance.**


We help you protect what matters most to you, including you and your immediate family.


**Flexible remuneration.**


Enjoy access to services such as nursery vouchers, public transport and training support, as well as other benefits through our flexible remuneration model.


**Commuting made easier.**


Our free shuttle service connects different areas of Madrid with ING MAD, helping make your commute to the office more comfortable and convenient.


**Banking benefits.**


Loans with preferential banking conditions.


Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.


And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!


**More vitality and more belonging**


Our 360º wellbeing approach supports employees across Financial, Physical, Mental and Social Wellbeing.


On\-site physiotherapy service.


A strong wellbeing culture, including Wellhub access, sports communities and activities.


Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI\+), Leonas \& RIÑG.


International Remote work program.


**Get to know Us**


We are a team of more than 1900 people sharing one idea: **doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves**, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.


A **fully online bank** where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with **agile methodologies**.


And although we are based in Spain, we **are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 40 countries.**


We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of **Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging** to foster a culture of **collaboration and innovation** that represents all collectives in the society.


And even though we look orange on the outside, **we are green on the inside**. Our ambition in Sustainability is **Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey**. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.


**Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA.** If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!


*At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.*


**Job Application Safety Reminder**


We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:


* **Apply only via official ING platforms:** ING uses **Workday** and **LinkedIn** as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted **only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn**.
* **Check the sender’s email carefully:** Legitimate communication will always come from **@ing.com** and/or **@myworkday.com**.
* **No payments or banking details will ever be requested:** If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

  

  

**En ING buscamos un/a Business Lead Insurance**


**Tu función y entorno de trabajo**


Buscamos a una persona con talento y entusiasmo para incorporarse como **Business Lead en nuestra Insurance Tribe**.


La Insurance Tribe tiene una misión clara: **convertir a ING en el lugar de referencia para las necesidades de protección de nuestra clientela**. Estamos construyendo una forma diferente de hacer seguros, creando propuestas simples, transparentes y verdaderamente valiosas para nuestras personas clientes, al tiempo que contribuimos al crecimiento sostenible de ING y distribuyéndolas a través de experiencias digitales de primer nivel.


Como Business Lead Insurance, serás responsable de definir, impulsar el crecimiento y transformar nuestro negocio principal de seguros, incluyendo seguros de Hogar, Vida y Protección de Pagos (PPI).


Además de gestionar y optimizar la cartera actual, desempeñarás un papel clave en la definición de la futura estrategia de negocio de seguros de ING España. Esto incluye identificar nuevas oportunidades y categorías de productos de protección, diseñar propuestas de valor para clientes, liderar procesos de selección de aseguradoras y Request for Proposal (RfP), negociar acuerdos de colaboración y supervisar la configuración y el lanzamiento end\-to\-end de nuevos productos y modelos de negocio. Se espera que combines visión estratégica con una ejecución impecable, ayudando a ING a evolucionar continuamente su oferta de protección, al tiempo que generas crecimiento sostenible y valor para la clientela.

  

  

Serás responsable tanto del **rendimiento actual como de la agenda de crecimiento futura**, equilibrando la gestión de la cartera con el desarrollo de la próxima generación de propuestas de seguros para la clientela de ING.


Este no es un puesto tradicional dentro del sector asegurador. Combinarás estrategia, desarrollo comercial, gestión de partnerships, innovación de producto y ejecución. **Trabajarás en toda la cadena de valor**, conectando a clientes, aseguradoras, canales de distribución y equipos de analítica, operaciones y tecnología para acelerar el crecimiento y construir la próxima generación de propuestas de protección.


Actuarás como la **persona representante senior de tus productos** tanto dentro de la organización como externamente, gestionando las relaciones con partners aseguradores, ING Headquarters y stakeholders senior de toda la entidad. Se espera que influyas en la toma de decisiones, alinees múltiples intereses y construyas alianzas sólidas que aceleren el crecimiento del negocio.


Además, **liderarás y desarrollarás un equipo de profesionales de estrategia de negocio**, creando un entorno en el que el talento pueda desarrollarse, fomentando la responsabilidad, la colaboración y el alto rendimiento, y asegurando que el equipo contribuya de manera efectiva a los objetivos estratégicos de la Tribe.


También serás responsable de definir y **alcanzar los objetivos comerciales** de la cartera de seguros, incluyendo objetivos de producción y cartera medidos a través de unidades vendidas, Annual Premium Equivalent (APE), Gross Written Premium (GWP) y otros indicadores relevantes del rendimiento del negocio.


Ayudarás a definir el futuro del negocio mientras garantizas una ejecución excelente de la cartera actual.


**Reportarás directamente a la persona Tribe Lead** y trabajarás junto a stakeholders senior de las áreas de Business, Tecnología, Operaciones, Riesgos, Finanzas y Marketing.


**¿Qué harás?**


**Impulsar la estrategia del negocio de seguros**


* Definir y ejecutar la hoja de ruta estratégica de la cartera principal de seguros de ING.
* Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento en productos de Hogar, Vida y PPI.
* Identificar futuras oportunidades de protección y definir la agenda de crecimiento a largo plazo del negocio de seguros de ING.
* Transformar las tendencias del mercado, las necesidades de la clientela y las prioridades de negocio en iniciativas accionables.
* Elaborar y mantener business cases para nuevas propuestas, partnerships e inversiones.
* Definir ambiciones comerciales y objetivos de cartera en ventas, APE, GWP y métricas de rentabilidad.


**Hacer crecer y evolucionar nuestra cartera de seguros**


* Liderar la evolución de los productos existentes para mejorar el rendimiento comercial, el valor para la clientela y la competitividad.
* Identificar carencias en la cartera y definir futuras propuestas de protección.
* Diseñar propuestas de valor centradas en la clientela para nuevos productos y servicios de seguros.
* Explorar nuevos modelos de negocio, oportunidades de distribución y servicios de valor añadido.
* Impulsar la rentabilidad de los productos y el crecimiento sostenible.
* Liderar la configuración y el lanzamiento end\-to\-end de nuevos productos de seguros.


**Construir y gestionar partnerships estratégicos**


* Liderar las relaciones con partners y proveedores aseguradores.
* Actuar como representante senior de ING ante compañías aseguradoras y stakeholders externos clave.
* Construir relaciones sólidas con ING Headquarters y stakeholders internacionales del ámbito asegurador.
* Garantizar que los partnerships generen valor a largo plazo para la clientela y para ING.
* Cuestionar acuerdos existentes y explorar nuevas oportunidades de mercado.
* Liderar procesos de selección de partners, RfP, negociaciones y acuerdos comerciales.


**Acelerar el crecimiento comercial**


* Definir acciones para mejorar la captación, conversión, retención y customer lifetime value.
* Impulsar oportunidades de crecimiento mediante segmentación, cross\-sell, upsell y propuestas combinadas.
* Coordinar múltiples palancas comerciales para maximizar el rendimiento del negocio.
* Liderar los planes de crecimiento de la cartera y los objetivos de rendimiento comercial.
* Trabajar estrechamente con los equipos de Marketing, Analytics y Customer Journey para optimizar los resultados para la clientela.


**Liderar la transformación del negocio**


* Impulsar iniciativas end\-to\-end desde la idea hasta la implementación.
* Coordinar equipos multifuncionales para convertir oportunidades estratégicas en resultados tangibles.
* Eliminar obstáculos, alinear stakeholders y garantizar la ejecución.
* Ayudar a definir el futuro modelo operativo del negocio asegurador.
* Liderar la implantación de nuevos partnerships, productos y capacidades.


**Liderar y desarrollar el talento**


* Liderar, acompañar e inspirar a un equipo de profesionales de estrategia de negocio.
* Desarrollar el talento, impulsar futuras personas líderes y fomentar una cultura de alto rendimiento.
* Crear un entorno de responsabilidad, colaboración, aprendizaje continuo e innovación.
* Garantizar la alineación entre los objetivos del equipo y los resultados del negocio.


**Ser la voz de la clientela y del negocio**


* Comprender de manera continua las necesidades, comportamientos y expectativas de la clientela.
* Utilizar datos, insights de clientes e inteligencia de mercado para tomar decisiones fundamentadas.
* Equilibrar los objetivos comerciales con el valor para la clientela y la sostenibilidad a largo plazo.
* Actuar como referente de una mentalidad centrada en la clientela.


**¿Qué ofrecemos?**


El tiempo que pasas en el trabajo, los retos a los que te enfrentas o los aprendizajes que obtienes son muy importantes, pero… ¿qué hay de tu vida personal? En ING queremos que tu trabajo te llene en todos los sentidos, y por eso cuidamos hasta el más mínimo detalle.


¡Descubre lo que te está esperando!


**Balance That Works**


Ponemos el equilibrio en valor, para que tú también puedas hacerlo. Con las necesidades de nuestros/as clientes/as en primer lugar, el equipo y tú acordáis cuándo venir a ING MAD y cuándo trabajar mejor desde casa. Más tiempo juntos cuando importa, más libertad cuando la necesitas.


**Tarjeta restaurante.**


Recibe tu ayuda para comidas de la manera que mejor se adapte a ti: mediante una tarjeta de comida o directamente en tu nómina, ofreciéndote mayor flexibilidad y comodidad para gestionar tus necesidades diarias


**Más que una oficina**


En nuestras oficinas puedes encontrar servicio médico, peluquería, gimnasio, Employee Concierge (para ayudarte con tus gestiones) y mucho más.


**Seguro de salud y de vida.**


Te ayudamos a proteger lo que más te importa, incluyéndote a ti y a tu familia más cercana.


**Retribución flexible**


Disfruta de acceso a servicios como cheques guardería, transporte público y apoyo para formación, así como de otros beneficios a través de nuestro modelo de retribución flexible.


**Desplazamientos más fáciles.**


Nuestro servicio gratuito de lanzadera conecta distintas zonas de Madrid con ING MAD, ayudando a que tus desplazamientos a la oficina sean más cómodos y convenientes.


**Beneficios bancarios**


Préstamos especiales con condiciones más beneficiosas.


Condiciones especiales en hipotecas tras 6 meses trabajando en el banco.


¡Y podrás beneficiarte de nuestro plan de pensiones después de 1 mes con nosotras y nosotros!


**Más vitalidad y más sentimiento de pertenencia**


Nuestro enfoque de bienestar 360º apoya a las personas empleadas en las áreas de bienestar financiero, físico, mental y social.


Servicio de fisioterapia en las instalaciones.


Una sólida cultura de bienestar, que incluye acceso a Wellhub, comunidades deportivas y actividades.


Redes de personas empleadas: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI\+), Leonas y RIÑG.


Programa internacional de trabajo en remoto.


**Conócenos**


Somos un equipo de más de 1\.900 personas que compartimos una misma idea: **poner de nuestra parte para ayudar a nuestras personas clientas a crear un futuro mejor para sí mismas**, proporcionándoles las herramientas que necesitan para llegar donde quieren.


Un **banco 100 % digital**, donde la tecnología, la innovación, la simplicidad y la transparencia son los principales ingredientes, y el primero en trabajar con **metodologías agile**.


Y aunque estamos en España, **tenemos la suerte de trabajar en un banco internacional con presencia en más de 40 países.**


Estamos orgullosas y orgullosos de contar con un equipo diverso, y estamos comprometidas y comprometidos a seguir desarrollando una cultura de **Diversidad, Inclusión y Pertenencia** para fomentar una cultura de **colaboración e innovación** que represente a todos los colectivos de la sociedad.

  

  

Y aunque por fuera seamos naranjas, **por dentro somos verdes**. Nuestra ambición en Sostenibilidad es **Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey**. Estamos recorriendo este camino para nosotras y nosotros, pero también acompañamos a nuestras personas clientas cuando deciden emprenderlo.


**Hacer que las cosas sucedan, ayudar a que otras personas tengan éxito, ir siempre un paso por delante: ese es nuestro ADN.** Si te miras al espejo y tu reflejo encaja con nuestra forma de ser y de trabajar… ¡estamos deseando conocerte!


*En ING, perteneces tal y como eres. Contratamos y apoyamos a las personas por su talento y potencial — y sabemos que cuando puedes mostrarte tal y como eres, haces tu mejor trabajo.*


**Job Application Safety Reminder**


Estamos detectando un aumento de ofertas de empleo fraudulentas. Para protegerte, sigue estas pautas clave al aplicar en posiciones de ING:


* **Inscríbete solo a través de plataformas oficiales de ING**: ING utiliza **Workday** y **LinkedIn** como su sistema interno de reclutamiento. Las candidaturas deben enviarse **únicamente a través de nuestro sitio oficial de carreras o mediante ofertas de empleo de ING en LinkedIn.**
* **Revisa cuidadosamente el remitente del correo electrónico:** Las comunicaciones legítimas siempre procederán de **@ing.com** y/o **@myworkday.com**.
* **Nunca se solicitarán pagos ni datos bancarios**: Si alguien te pide esta información, se trata de un fraude.

Santander ( www.santander.com ) is evolving from **a global, high\-impact brand** into a **technology\-driven organization** , and our people are at the heart of this journey. **Together** , we are driving a **customer\-centric transformation** that values bold **thinking, innovation** , and the **courage to challenge** what’s possible.

**Open Digital Services** is looking for an **Functional Product Owner** based out of Madrid.


Own the functional definition and evolution of global capabilities within the Assisted Channels platform, translating business, operational, and market needs into scalable and reusable product solutions. * Translate business and operational needs into functional definitions, user stories, servicing requirements, workflows, business rules and acceptance criteria for IT teams.
* Coordinate with technical teams and participate actively in backlog prioritization, release planning, functional validation and stakeholder management.

* Master's **(Preferred)**

**Hard Skills**

* Proven experience in Product Ownership, Functional Analysis, or digital banking and Assisted Channels solutions. (required)
* Strong understanding of customer journeys, servicing processes, and business needs across branch, remote, and commercial channels. (required)
* Experience translating business requirements into user stories, product backlogs, and functional specifications. (required)

* We know **family is everything** . That’s why we offer parental leave, childcare support and family\-friendly programmes tailored to each life stage.
* We’re **enable our teams to go beyond** through global opportunities and broad career paths.
* We believe in **the power of helping** . You can dedicate part of your working hours to volunteering.
* We’re here to **keep you motivated** , help you reach your goals, and celebrate your progress, every step of the way.

If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.

We are looking for an exceptional business analyst to help us develop new ways to build trust and loyalty with sellers, a crucial component of our flywheel  

  

Sellers’ trust in Amazon is our top priority and in this role, you will be tasked with building that trust over time by diving deep into how we measure our progress and helping to identify and prioritize key areas of focus. Amazon’s growth requires leaders who move fast, have an entrepreneurial spirit to create new solutions, have an unrelenting tenacity to get things done, and are capable of breaking down and solving complex problems.  

  

The successful candidate will be a self\-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and be able to create and maintain efficient \& automated processes. They know and love working with business intelligence tools, can model multidimensional datasets, and can partner effectively with business leaders to answer key business questions. They are analytical and creative, and don’t quit. This is a role with high visibility to senior leadership and with high opportunity for impact for those willing to roll up their sleeves and dive deep to achieve results.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Work with team leadership to understand the customer needs and concerns as well as define solutions.
* Translate basic business problem statements into analysis requirements. Work with internal customers to define best output based on expressed stakeholder needs.
* Use analytical and statistical rigor to solve complex problems and drive business decisions.
* Develop queries and visualizations for ad\-hoc requests and projects, as well as ongoing reporting.
* Write queries and output efficiently, and have in\-depth knowledge of the data available in area of expertise.
* Pull the data needed with standard query syntax; periodically identify more advanced methods of query optimization. Convert data to make it analysis\-ready.
* Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation.
* Monitor and troubleshoot operational or data issues in the data pipelines
* Review and audit existing ETL jobs and SQL queries.
* Good communication and writing. Effectively communicates with both business and technical teams.

  

A day in the life  

* Partner with Business Stakeholders to automate metrics and dive data to drive decisions that will support Sellers on the Amazon Platform
* Surface opportunities to drive process improvement, looking beyond the surface to understand what the data means for the team
* Participate in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews with Global leadership spanning our six operations sites, from Arizona to Singapore.
* Provide data insights to Operations Managers to help them understand root cause of defect drivers for the programs and specialists.

  

About the team  

Account Health Support exists to educate sellers on how to maintain there Account Health while selling on the Amazon platform. We provide support to these sellers to ensure they understand Amazon's policy and provide a delightful experience for our customers. The team creates a trustworthy selling experience to ensure that Selling Partners perceive Amazon as the safest and most effective store in which to sell their products worldwide.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
* 3\+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience with SQL
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
* Be self\-driven, and show ability to deliver on ambiguous projects with incomplete data.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non\-technical leaders

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Retention Specialist, Copy & Content
description:
**About Darkroom**
==================

**Darkroom** is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by **Shadow**, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: **billions in attributable revenue** driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**Location:** Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only \- supporting a team in the EST time zone.

**About the role**
==================


We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand\-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high\-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.


You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first\-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or Customer.io.


This is a copy\-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

**You should apply if this sounds like you**
============================================


You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.

* 3–5\+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years.
* You write excellent short\-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number.
* You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected\-device brand is a strong plus.
* You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt\-in copy, welcome series, first\-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging.
* You have written loyalty, rewards, and win\-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long\-term value is a core outcome of this role.
* You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone.
* You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy.
* You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight.
* You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high\-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule.
* You are detail\-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you.
* You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client.
* Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Customer.io, or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible.

**A day in the life**
=====================

* Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase.
* Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems.
* Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do.
* Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final.
* Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions.
* Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build.
* Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering.
* Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests.

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**
======================================


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

 **Equal Opportunity Statement**


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: IT Manager
description:
**About the role**


We’re opening a delivery centre in Valencia. We are looking for an IT Manager to take operational ownership of the projects delivered there and to work as the direct deputy of the person running the site.


This is a launch role. The centre is being set up now, the team is being hired now, and the way it works has not been decided yet. Our site lead stays close to the clients and to business development. You take the operational side: framing the projects, running delivery, coordinating the teams, and helping build the structure as it grows. You will be introduced to clients as his counterpart, so the role is visible from day one. The scope is deliberately broad. It sits across project management, product ownership and business analysis, and the balance shifts from one project to the next. Generative AI is a real part of how they works.


The role does not require deep technical AI expertise, no agent development, no RAG, no MCP. It requires genuine curiosity and handson practice with AI tools, enough to hold a conversation with the engineering teams, spot the use cases worth pursuing, and bring them into the product roadmap.


Contract type Permanent or freelance to start, depending on what suits you.


If starting freelance, permanent contract required after a few months.


**Your responsibilities**


1\. **Project framing** Gather and formalize business requirements with stakeholders. Define scope, deliverables, milestones and success criteria. Write the requirement documents, functional specifications and technical specifications.


2\. **Product roadmap** Build and prioritize the product roadmap against business value and technical constraints. Arbitrate between business needs, technical reality and deadlines. Own the timeline and keep stakeholders informed.


3\. **Technical delivery** Write user stories, specifications and acceptance criteria. Prioritise and manage the backlog. Validate deliverables with both the technical and the business side. Coordinate across teams: development, design, data and external providers.


4\. **Budget Estimate** and track project effort and budget. Report regularly to management and sponsors. Optimize the balance between internal resources and external providers.


5\. **Risk and trade\-offs** Identify and manage project risks. Arbitrate between technical constraints and business objectives. Escalate blockers to the right level at the right time.


6\. **Governance** Run project committees and agile ceremonies, from sprint reviews through to planning sessions. Prepare progress reporting materials. Report to sponsors and management.


7\. **Stakeholder management** Act as the interface between the creative, technical, business and client sides. Adapt your communication to each audience and manage expectations. Hold the position of facilitator and arbitrator between parties.


8\. **Team coordination** Lead or coordinate technical teams, internal and external. Distribute workload, follow performance, keep the team engaged.


9\. **Quality and acceptance** Define acceptance criteria. Validate that deliverables meet them before they go to production.


10\. **Release and post\-launch** Coordinate deployments and production releases. Track performance indicators after launch.


11\. **Methodology** Work in Agile and Scrum, or in a V\-cycle where the context calls for it. Adapt the methodological framework to the maturity of the organisation you are working with.


12\. **Bringing AI into the work** Keep an active watch on generative AI tools and how they are actually being used. Identify where AI genuinely saves time in the product and project process, whether that is drafting specifications, generating summaries or automating repetitive work. Hold a credible conversation with the engineering teams on AI topics without needing to implement them yourself

**Your profile**


Education Bachelor's or Master's level in engineering, project management, computer science or equivalent.


Experience 5 to 15 years in IT project management, product ownership or business analysis, ideally a mix of the three.


**Languages**


* French is required. Several of our clients work in French and you’re working closely with the president and director.
* English is required. The engineering team works in English.
* Spanish is not required. Location
* Based in Valencia, or ready to relocate there. This role is not open to full remote. Proximity matters more here than in any other role in the team, because the job is built around working side by side with the site lead.
* Trips to Paris every month needed to visit the rest of the team there.

title: FinOps Specialist
description:
**Why Join dLocal?**  

dLocal is the financial infrastructure powering global commerce in the world's fastest\-growing markets. The biggest companies in the world trust us to unlock growth in 60\+ countries across emerging markets—moving money where others see complexity. We don't just process payments; we are architects of payment ecosystems and partners in our customers' expansion. You'll work alongside 1,300\+ teammates from 40\+ nationalities and tackle global challenges from day one.

  

As our **FinOps Specialist**, you will be responsible for safeguarding business integrity, operational resilience, and financial precision. Acting as a strategic subject matter expert, you will oversee high\-risk transactional flows and collaborate cross\-functionally to proactively identify, mitigate, and resolve operational risks related to merchants, FX, and financial processes.  

  

You will play a key role in elevating the FinOps Specialist function into a highly standardized, automated, and data\-driven discipline. You will design and execute an assurance roadmap that leverages technology, robust control frameworks, and best practices to drive operational excellence, scalability, and governance.
### **What will you be doing?**



* **Oversight \& Assurance:** Serving as a senior regional authority to establish, monitor, and enforce robust business assurance frameworks across regional markets and operations.
* **Process \& Control Transformation:** Designing and executing a process transformation roadmap to simplify, standardize, and automate complex fx reconciliations, controls, and risk\-monitoring mechanisms.
* **Digitalization \& Automation:** Identifying operational gaps and manual vulnerabilities (e.g., in reconciliations, FX monitoring, merchant settlements) and partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Finance teams to implement sustainable, automated, and scalable solutions.
* **Issue Governance \& Structural Fixes:** Driving root\-cause analysis on operational differences, control deficiencies, and transactional anomalies; ensuring cross\-functional execution of corrective and preventive action plans to achieve long\-term structural fixes.
* **Cross\-Functional Influence \& Alignment:** Collaborating strategically with regional and global stakeholders (Finance, Treasury, Commercial, Product, Tech, and Compliance) to align priorities, mitigate operational exposure, and streamline workflows.
* **Continuous Improvement \& Risk Analytics:** Establishing continuous monitoring mechanisms through key metrics, automated dashboards, and regular assurance reviews to provide visibility to executive leadership.
### **What skills do I need?**


* High attention to detail, well organize and excellent analytical skills.
* 2\+ years of experience in Projects, QA testing, internal/external auditing, reconciliations, or multinational companies.
* Ability to manipulate large amounts of data. Experience with Simetrik would be a plus
* Ability to adapt to change quickly and multi\-task.
* Enthusiastic, self\-motivated, and confident.
* **Fluent written and spoken English.**
* Solid experience with **SQL and BI tools** (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, Looker) to query, analyze, and build automated assurance dashboards.
* **Applied AI \& Automation Skills:** Practical experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., LLMs, Generative AI, or machine learning frameworks) and prompt engineering to accelerate data analysis, automate anomaly detection, enhance risk identification, and streamline core assurance workflows.


**What do we offer?**  

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:  

* **Flexibility in how you work:** We focus on impact and productivity over fixed hours. This means our teams have flexible schedules and, depending on your role and location, you will combine self‑managed focus time with moments of in‑person connection in our collaboration hubs.
* **Fintech industry:** work in a dynamic and ever\-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.


\- **Referral bonus program:** our internal talents are the best recruiters \- refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.  

* **Work From Anywhere:** Team members can work while traveling for up to 3 months every year.
  



**What happens after you apply?**
Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin and Youtube for more about dLocal!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
**Nebius Academy** (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies \& individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.


Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech\-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.


We are looking for an **Application Security Engineer** to own product security end to end — from threat modelling and secure design reviews to vulnerability management and security controls embedded into CI/CD.


You will work closely with product and platform teams to make security part of the engineering process, building secure defaults and helping prevent vulnerabilities from reaching production without slowing development down.

  

Requirements:
  

* 5\+ years of engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on Application Security or Product Security.
* Strong software engineering background with the ability to read, review, and write production code; Python experience is highly preferred.
* Deep practical knowledge of web application security, including OWASP Top 10, ASVS, authentication and session management, OAuth2 / OIDC / SAML, and authorization issues such as IDOR and broken access control.
* Experience securing multitenant or B2B SaaS products, including tenant isolation, RBAC / ABAC, and access control models.
* Hands\-on experience embedding security into CI/CD, including SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container scanning, and IaC scanning.
* Strong experience with threat modelling, secure design reviews, and secure code reviews in collaboration with product and engineering teams.
* Experience managing vulnerabilities based on risk, criticality, and exploitability, including remediation prioritisation and escalation when needed.
* Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes security, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and auditors.
* Fluent Russian and English at B2 level or above.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience building a DevSecOps practice from scratch.
* Experience running or participating in a Security Champions programme.
* Hands\-on penetration testing experience.
* Experience securing LLM\-powered or AI products.
* Experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 from an engineering perspective.
* Knowledge of software supply chain security, including SBOMs, SLSA, image signing, or similar practices.

  

Brand:
  

Nebius Academy  

  

What you will do:
  

* Own application and product security end to end, from design reviews and threat modelling to vulnerability remediation and follow\-up.
* Partner with product and platform teams to embed security into the development lifecycle rather than treat it as a final review step.
* Build and improve security controls in CI/CD, including SAST, dependency, secrets, container, and IaC scanning.
* Review application designs and code where security risk is meaningful, and turn recurring findings into secure defaults, shared libraries, lint rules, and CI gates.

* Help translate GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 requirements into practical engineering controls and system properties.
* Develop and support a security champions programme to help engineering teams adopt secure practices in their day\-to\-day work.
* Address security risks specific to AI and LLM\-powered features, including prompt injection, data leakage, and untrusted model output.

  

What we can offer you:
  

* A supportive and proactive work environment.
* Competitive compensation: 4000\-6000 EUR Gross per month
* Fully remote and full\-time collaboration.
* Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
* Tangible results measured by student success.

title: Blue Yonder TMS Analyst IB
description:
Accenture, recognized as a Great Place To Work®, is a leading global professional services company that helps major businesses, public administrations, and other organizations around the world develop their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and improve services for citizens, creating tangible value at speed and scale.  



  

At Accenture, we believe technology is the engine of total business reinvention. We work with the world's leading platforms and ecosystem partners to help our clients transform supply chain operations through digitalization, data, AI, and cloud\-based technologies. If you want to join a team of more than 801,000 professionals worldwide, keep reading.  



  

This role is based in Madrid under a hybrid working model, combining remote work with on\-site collaboration at our offices.


Candidates must reside in Spain and have valid work authorization in Spain.

### **Job Description**


We are looking for a Blue Yonder TMS Analyst IB to support the implementation, configuration, enhancement, and support of Blue Yonder Transportation Management solutions. The role focuses on transportation planning, carrier collaboration, freight execution, shipment optimization, and integration with enterprise supply chain platforms.


The successful candidate will participate in transportation transformation programs, working closely with business stakeholders, functional consultants, integration teams, and supply chain operations to deliver scalable Blue Yonder TMS solutions.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Configure and maintain Blue Yonder TMS modules including Transportation Planning, Load Building, Carrier Selection, Tender Management, Routing Guide, Shipment Execution, Freight Settlement, and Appointment Scheduling.
* Design and configure transportation business rules, rate structures, accessorial charges, carrier contracts, transportation calendars, service levels, routing constraints, and optimization parameters.
* Configure and support transportation lifecycle processes including order release management, shipment creation, consolidation, tendering, carrier acceptance, execution tracking, proof of delivery, and freight payment.

* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on transportation cost reduction, service\-level improvements, carrier utilization, shipment consolidation, and network optimization

  

### **Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 1 year of professional experience working with Transportation Management Systems.
* Minimum 1 year of experience configuring, supporting, implementing, or enhancing Blue Yonder TMS or a comparable Transportation Management platform.
* Advanced proficiency in Transportation Management Systems.
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems, Logistics, or a related field.
* English proficiency at B2 level or higher.
* Minimum 1 year of experience supporting transportation processes such as shipment planning, carrier management, freight execution, transportation optimization, or freight settlement.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced proficiency in Fulfillment Operations.
* Advanced proficiency in Functional Requirements Analysis.
* Advanced proficiency in Transportation Management.
* Intermediate proficiency in Process Improvement.
* Intermediate proficiency in Data Analysis.

* Experience integrating Blue Yonder TMS with SAP, Oracle, WMS platforms, or supply chain planning solutions.
* Experience with transportation rate management, freight audit, carrier onboarding, and transportation visibility solutions.

It is required to have knowledge and experience in the use of generative artificial intelligence and AI tools applied to the workplace, in line with Accenture’s commitment to the responsible and effective use of AI.

title: Senior Cybersecurity Analyst - (Cyber Defense Operations)

* Strong knowledge of **SIEM and EDR technologies**.

* It would be a plus if you have:
* Experience working in an **Incident Response team**, particularly Tier I/II.
* Experience monitoring **AWS environments**, including IaaS, PaaS and SaaS.
* Scripting experience with **Python, PowerShell, Bash, Ruby or similar**.
* Cybersecurity certifications such as **SC\-200, GCIH, CEH, GCFA, GIAC, CCNA or MCSE**.

**Additional Information** **What do we offer you?**

* Remote location in Spain or any other European country.

description:
**Join Ferrovial: Where Innovation Meets Opportunity**
======================================================

Are you ready to elevate your career with a global leader in infrastructure solving complex problems and generating a positive outcome on people’s lives? At **Ferrovial** , we are not just a company; we are a community of innovators and trailblazers. Ferrovial is also leading the development of the New Terminal One at JFK International Airport. Ferrovial shares trade under the ticker symbol FER on two stock markets: Nasdaq in the U.S. (Nasdaq100 Index) and the Spanish Stock Exchanges (IBEX 35\). Ferrovial is included in globally recognized sustainability indices such as the Dow Jones Best\-in\-Class Index. We operate in more than 15 countries and have a workforce of over 22,000 professionals worldwide. Ferrovial’s activity is carried out through our business units, including Highways, Airports, Construction, and Energy.  



  

Our **Corporate** organization oversees business activities, providing strategic planning, communication, legal, finance and human resources services to the business units. As a member of our corporate organization, you will have a broad view of our company, further supporting your career development.  



  

**Why Ferrovial?**

* **Global presence, local impact** : Be part of a company that is shaping the future of infrastructure worldwide, with challenging roles and projects that make a real difference.
* **Collaborative excellence** : Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions are valued.
* **Inclusive Culture:** Thrive in an innovative and respectful workplace that values every voice, celebrates what makes us unique and turns differences into innovation.
* **Career growth** : Benefit from global and cross\-business unit mobility, with development processes designed to ensure your professional growth.
* **Compelling benefits and employee wellbeing** : Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that rewards your hard work and dedication and take advantage of initiatives designed to support your physical and psychological health.
* **Productivity tools** : Utilize cutting\-edge tools like Microsoft Copilot to enhance your productivity and efficiency.

  

**Job Description:**
====================

**About The Role**

  

*What if your next project didn't end up as a slide in a deck, but as technology actually running in an airport, a highway, a solar or wind power plant, or a data center?*

  

We are looking for a hands\-on technical innovation leader who can work where energy strategy becomes real infrastructure: storage, grid connection, microgrids, electrification, critical power, resilience and renewable generation. You will assess emerging technologies with rigor, shape practical use cases and lead them through testing and validation, building the evidence the business needs to decide whether to invest, scale or stop.  



  

You will join Corporate Innovation and work across Ferrovial’s businesses: Airports, Cintra, Ferrovial Energy and Digital Infrastructure. Success in the role requires strong engineering judgement, the ability to distinguish genuine breakthroughs from incremental improvements, and the credibility to engage technical and business stakeholders alike—translating complex challenges into well\-structured pilots, clear investment decisions and scalable business opportunities.  



  

This is a unique opportunity to influence the future of infrastructure by bringing cutting\-edge technologies from concept to real\-world deployment across a global leader in the sector. Experience in mission\-critical environments, including data centers, is a plus, but not essential.  



  

**Key Responsibilitie** s


* Lead energy, sustainability and resilience projects from technology identification through pilot, business case and scale\-up recommendation
* Design and run proofs of concept with business units, OEMs, engineering partners, research centers and startups — setting your own KPIs and decision gates
* Bring real engineering judgment to grid connection, electrification, storage, microgrids, critical power, energy management and renewable generation infrastructure (solar and wind plants)
* Translate complex technical options and uncertainty into clear business cases for senior leadership
* Explore emerging low\-carbon technologies — carbon capture and utilization, green molecules, hydrogen, e\-fuels, biogenic routes — and assess their real potential
Optionally contribute to projects on low\-carbon materials, embodied carbon and circularity  
* 

  

**Qualification** s


* Hold an engineering or equivalent technical degree, ideally in electrical, energy, mechanical, industrial, civil or building\-services engineering
* 8–12 years of experience in corporate innovation, technical office roles, or critical asset operations (energy, renewables, infrastructure, data centers)
* Real engineering judgment, not just strategic vision — you can defend a technical decision, not just frame one
* Relevant knowledge of energy and infrastructure systems—including grid connection, electrification, efficiency, storage, microgrids, controls, critical power or energy management—and how they interact with thermal, water and resilience requirements
* Familiarity with low\-carbon materials, carbon technologies, embodied carbon, circularity and lifecycle value, with sound judgement on when to involve Ferrovial’s specialist teams
* Ability to build effective relationships across business units and with operators, OEMs, engineering partners, startups, universities and investors, acting as a connector rather than an operational owner
* Ability to move across asset classes: what you learn on a wind farm should be useful on an airport, a highway or a data center
* A drive to see things through: you don't stop at validation — you want to see the technology scale
* Comfort working with uncertainty and with very different stakeholders — from an OEM engineer to a business director

We are not looking for a purely strategic profile without hands\-on engineering. Someone who prefers staying in day\-to\-day operations rather than pushing change forward. Someone who wants to specialize in a single asset class.


**Seize the challenge. Move the world together!** Innovative, creative, respectful, and diverse are some of the ways we describe ourselves. We are motivated by challenges, and we collaborate across our business units to move the world together. Your journey to a fulfilling career starts here!

title: Senior CRM Lifecycle + Journeys Manager
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**



Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer\-to\-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.



What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross\-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.


**OUR CULTURE**



Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.


* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long\-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade\-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member \- no matter their level \- has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.


If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug\-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**THE ROLE**



The **Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle \+ Journeys** owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in\-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will build the automation engine that runs Quince's retention programme: from the welcome series a UK customer sees the day we launch, to the win\-back flow that recovers a French customer six months later.



This is a builder role. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. The Director, CRM owns the retention strategy and the campaign calendar. You own the triggered flow programme that runs alongside it.



Two constraints shape this job. UK and EU privacy rules mean the US lifecycle playbook does not transfer unchanged: you will rebuild the identity\-resolution layer and shift weight toward logged\-in and app behaviour. Channel economics also differ across markets, with SMS in particular materially more expensive in Europe than in the US, so the sequencing of email, SMS, push, and in\-app per flow per market is not the same as the US default.



You will be joining a team that values speed, candor, and rigour. This role is for you if you like building things, you can hold a roadmap in one hand and a SQL query in the other, and you have an opinion on how AI changes lifecycle work over the next 18 months.


**Responsibilities**


* Build, launch, and own every triggered lifecycle flow for UK (July 2026\), DE (October 2026\), and FR (November 2026\): welcome, browse abandon, cart abandon, post\-purchase, low stock, back in stock, win\-back, replenishment, care instructions.
* Partner with MarTech to Ship AI agents and tooling that take work out of flow build, copy, segmentation, and QA. Target at least one end\-to\-end CRM agent in production by EoY1 and a 50% reduction in flow concept\-to\-deployment time within 90 days.
* Partner with the Data team to run the triggered\-flow testing roadmap with statistically sound design. Minimum 6 A/B tests per quarter per flow per market.
* Build channel\-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in\-app per flow per market.
* Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged\-in routing for non\-consenting users.
* Stand up and run the localisation pipeline with freelance copywriters for EN\-UK, DE, and FR. Localised flow content live before each market launch.
* Partner with tech team to maintain CDP quality across UK/EU: data model, integrations (Iterable, Attentive, app SDK, site events), data hygiene, latency, and identity\-resolution accuracy.


**Qualifications**


**Required:**

* 6\+ years lifecycle/CRM marketing in DTC or ecommerce, including at least 3 years owning automated/triggered flows end to end (not campaign/blast).
* Hands\-on with Iterable (preferred), or comparable ESP (Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC). Must have built flows in the tool, not just briefed them.
* Hands\-on with a CDP: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census, or similar. Must understand identity resolution and data hygiene.
* Has built or deployed AI agents or LLM workflows in a marketing context (copy, segmentation, flow logic, QA). If you have not shipped one yet, you can describe the one you would ship in your first 90 days here.
* SQL proficient. Can self\-serve in Looker, Lookr, or BigQuery without waiting for an analyst.
* A/B testing rigour. Knows what statistical significance means and where it breaks in lifecycle (sample size, primary metric selection, novelty effects).
* Working knowledge of UK/EU privacy law (GDPR, PECR) and consent management. Understands what changes operationally when fingerprinting is restricted.
* Detail\-oriented. Triggered flows live or die on edge cases (locale, currency, time zone, opt\-in state, suppression rules).
* Strong cross\-functional operator. Will work daily with creative, brand, data science, tech, and US CRM counterparts.


**Preferred:**


* Multi\-market lifecycle experience (UK \+ DE or FR), fashion or home goods background, app\-native lifecycle experience, fluency in DE or FR.

**WHY QUINCE?**



Joining Quince means being part of a mission\-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY \& HIRING INTEGRITY**



Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.



Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case\-by\-case basis.



Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.


*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*



At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. * Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in multicultural and cross\-functional teams.

**Our commitment to you: your benefits**

At Liebherr, we believe people are at the heart of our success. As part of our international team, you’ll enjoy a secure role in a family\-owned company that values innovation, collaboration, and long\-term career growth:

Liebherr is a family\-run technology company that is not only one of the largest construction machinery manufacturers in the world, but also offers high\-quality, user\-oriented products and services in many other areas.
