title: Hardware Industrialization Specialist
description:
### **Position**

Being part of LOEWE means learning every day alongside passionate teams in a fast\-paced, ambitious and creative environment.


As **Hardware Industrialization Specialist** , you will drive the end\-to\-end industrialization of new hardware components from design validation through series production, ensuring optimal balance between aesthetic excellence, strict timelines, cost efficiency, and technical reliability.  



### **Job responsibilities**

* Drive time\-to\-production targets and manage launch schedules
* Review and validate aesthetics with Design in alignment with industrialization constraints
* Manage testing processes (request, follow\-up, and validation) alongside suppliers and quality teams
* Conduct price negotiations, capacity analysis, and tooling/mould investments for production
* Optimize manufacturing methods for each launch to drive cost improvements
* Oversee pre\-series control, final approvals, master management, and PLM documentation
* Ensure system price updates and manage production risk analysis
* Provide technical expertise for root cause analysis and quality issue resolution
* Define, improve, and deploy technical standards across projects
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and countertyping analysis
* Build and maintain relationships with industry experts, staying abreast of new technologies, laboratories, and manufacturing advancements
### **Profile**

* 3 to 4 years of experience in a similar role managing development and/or purchasing for leather goods accessories, jewelry, or trimmings
* Degree in Industrial Engineering or Materials Engineering
* Strong negotiation and communication skills
* Proficiency in 3D modeling, rendering, and animation is a plus
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel), familiarity with AI tools, and fluency in various ERP systems
* Knowledge of PLM (Centric) software is a plus
* English proficiency (C1 or C2\) is mandatory; French, Chinese, or Italian is a plus
* Flexibility to travel to Europe and Asia
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Senior Coordinator, PASS Housing
description:
About CEA CAPA

  

At CEA CAPA, we believe studying and interning abroad is a transformative experience. By immersing themselves in new cultures, our students gain valuable skills and perspectives that shape their futures.

  

We’re proud to be a recognized sector leader, known for our delivery of impactful academic, professional and cultural experiences. This is achieved through our dedicated global team who provide comprehensive guidance, instruction, support and resources to maximize the benefit of our students’ time abroad.

  

A sense of belonging is central to CEA CAPA’s mission. We foster a work environment that values diversity and is free from bias. Our hiring practices are based on professional qualifications, skills and competence.

  

With a footprint that spans 53 cities in 20 countries across Europe, Latin America and Australia our 450 strong global workforce deliver exceptional cultural experiences abroad to over 7,000 students per annum.

  

Position Summary  

The Senior Coordinator, Housing and Student Services plays a key operational role in the delivery of student housing and student services in Madrid. The role combines hands\-on student support with responsibility for coordinating the day\-to\-day work of the Housing team, organizing workflows and priorities, overseeing housing operations, and supporting the PASS Director with budget management and semester planning. The Senior Coordinator serves as a senior point of reference for housing\-related matters, helps ensure consistent service standards, and coordinates effectively with students, colleagues, landlords, residences, vendors, and other external partners.
The role supports students throughout their programs, from logistics to cultural integration, ensuring a seamless and enriching experience. It also involves administrative tasks such as managing program materials and handling student accommodation issues.  

Responsibilities  

* Serve as a senior point of contact for students, providing guidance, information, resources, and support throughout their program.
* Coordinate the day\-to\-day work of the Housing team, organizing workloads, priorities, schedules, coverage, and operational deadlines.
* Support, guide, and coordinate team members, ensuring clear allocation of responsibilities, effective communication, and consistent service delivery.
* Oversee core student housing operations, including placements, arrivals, departures, room changes, maintenance, inspections, inventories, and accommodation\-related incidents.
* Coordinate housing readiness before each semester, ensuring apartments and other accommodation options meet operational and student\-service requirements.
* Manage relationships and day\-to\-day coordination with landlords, residences, maintenance providers, cleaning services, and other housing vendors.
* Monitor housing issues and escalations, identify appropriate solutions, and escalate significant operational, contractual, financial, or student welfare concerns to the PASS Director as required.
* Support the Center Director / PASS Director in managing the Housing budget, monitoring expenditure, reviewing invoices and costs, and maintaining accurate financial records.
* Prepare and maintain semester housing budget forecasts, anticipated occupancy and capacity needs, and projected operational expenses, identifying potential variances and cost pressures in advance.
* Track housing capacity, availability, and utilization to support semester planning and informed accommodation decisions.

* Identify opportunities to improve housing processes, service quality, operational efficiency, vendor performance, and cost effectiveness.
* Maintain accurate housing and student records in Salesforce and other relevant systems, ensuring information is current and appropriately documented.
* Coordinate and support student arrivals, orientations, departures, activities, and other PASS operations as required.
* Collaborate closely with Student Services, Academics, Health \& Safety, Custom Programs, Global Operations, and other internal teams to ensure coordinated student support.
* Participate in regular staff and planning meetings and provide operational updates, risks, budget information, and recommendations to the PASS Director.
* Support the onboarding, training, and day\-to\-day development of Housing team members and contribute to maintaining clear procedures and shared working standards.
* Be part of the emergency phone rotation and support the response to urgent student and housing situations in accordance with CEA CAPA procedures.
* Provide operational coverage and decision\-making support in the Housing area when required, particularly during peak periods, arrivals, departures, and staff absences.

  

Person Specification* Resilient and adaptable.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to coordinate people, competing priorities, schedules, and deadlines.
* Demonstrated leadership and team coordination skills, with the ability to guide colleagues and promote accountability and collaboration.
* Strong budget management, financial tracking, forecasting, and cost\-control skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong relationship\-management and negotiation skills with internal and external stakeholders.
* Able to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and contribute effectively to a wider team.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities and a practical, flexible, and creative approach to operational challenges.
* High attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records and follow through on complex operational matters.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and other digital tools.
  

Qualifications and Experience* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Fluency in English and Spanish.
* Significant experience working with students, particularly international students.
* Demonstrated experience in student housing, accommodation operations, property coordination, or a closely related area.
* Experience coordinating or supervising team members, workflows, or operational projects.
* Experience managing budgets, monitoring expenditure, and preparing forecasts or financial projections.
* Experience working with external vendors, landlords, service providers, and other operational partners.
* Ability to work effectively with diverse identities and backgrounds.
* Experience living or working abroad, with strong knowledge of the local culture, housing environment, business practices, and academic context.
* Knowledge of the U.S. higher education system is desirable.
* Authorization to work in the location of the role.
  

NB. This role profile is intended to provide an overview of the key responsibilities and qualifications for the position. It is not exhaustive, and the role holder may be required to perform additional tasks and duties as directed by leadership. Consequently, CEA CAPA reserves the right to modify this role profile at any time in accordance with evolving business needs and local legislation.

title: Sr. Manager, Global Packaging
description:
**Job Description:**

At NextPower, we lead the energy transition, providing intelligent solar trackers, power conversion, and control software solutions, together with strategic services that help our customers capture the full value of their solar power plants.  



  

As a company driving the clean energy transition, sustainability is central to our business and operations. Our worldwide teams are creative, collaborative and passionate problem\-solvers, driven by our mission to provide smarter energy solutions and support the transition to a more sustainable future.  



  

We are looking for a **Sr. Manager, Global Packaging Engineering** , based in **Madrid, Spain** , reporting to the **Sr. Director, Logistics Operations \& Packaging** .  



  

This role will lead our **Global Packaging Engineering function** , defining and implementing packaging strategy, standards and technical solutions across our global product portfolio. We are looking for someone who combines **strong technical packaging expertise with proven people leadership** and who is comfortable working both strategically and hands\-on.  



  

The position will work globally across Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, and our supplier network, with a particular focus on NPI, returnable packaging, standardization, sustainability, cost optimization, **and product protection** .  



  

### **What you will do**

* Develop and own the **Global Packaging Engineering strategy** , aligned with business priorities and focused on standardization, quality, sustainability, safety and cost optimization.
* Lead, develop and grow the **global Packaging Engineering team** , including capability development, resource allocation, performance management and common ways of working across regions.
* Represent Packaging Engineering in **NPI and new product development** , ensuring packaging requirements are considered from the early design stages through industrialization and launch.
* Lead the development and implementation of **returnable packaging programs** , including technical solutions, business cases, supplier implementation and operational deployment.
* Establish and maintain global **packaging standards, specifications, guidelines and validation requirements** across products, suppliers and regions.
* Drive packaging solutions for the full NextPower portfolio, including existing products, **new technologies and business verticals** , ensuring scalability as the company continues to grow.
* Work closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders to develop and validate packaging solutions, challenging existing designs and identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Drive **value engineering and cost\-reduction initiatives** , considering not only packaging cost but also container utilization, transportation, handling, warehousing, product damage and total landed cost.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics and Operations to ensure packaging solutions meet technical, operational and customer requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement in packaging processes and technologies, identifying opportunities for **automation, standardization and sustainability** .
* Establish appropriate **KPIs and governance** to measure packaging performance, compliance, cost improvements, quality and returnable packaging effectiveness.
* Support packaging integration for **new products, technologies and acquired businesses** , establishing common standards and ways of working across the organization.
Maintain a hands\-on approach, including regular engagement with suppliers, manufacturing locations and project/customer sites globally.  
* 

  

### **What you'll need**

* **15\+ years of experience** in industrial Packaging Engineering, either within a manufacturing organization or packaging solutions provider.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Packaging Engineering** , Mechanical/Industrial Engineering with significant packaging specialization, or equivalent relevant technical background.
* Strong technical knowledge of **industrial packaging materials, design, specifications and validation** , including returnable and expendable/one\-way packaging solutions.
* Proven experience developing and implementing **returnable packaging programs** .
* Demonstrated **people\-management experience** , including leading and developing technical teams across different locations and time zones.
* Experience working in a **global manufacturing, automotive, energy or similar industrial environment** .
* Strong experience working cross\-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Logistics and suppliers.
* Ability to combine **strategic thinking with hands\-on execution** — we are looking for someone who can define the strategy but is also comfortable getting into the technical details when needed.
* Strong change\-management and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to challenge existing approaches and drive implementation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Fluent English.
* **Based in Madrid, Spain** , with willingness to travel globally to suppliers, manufacturing locations and project sites as required.

  

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

The successful candidate will help us build a stronger, more scalable Global Packaging Engineering organization, moving Packaging further upstream into product development while improving standardization, returnable solutions, quality, sustainability, and total landed cost across NextPower's global operations.  



  

This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to shape how Packaging Engineering supports NextPower's continued growth, new products and business verticals.

Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data\-driven insights, and advanced automation. title: Video Producer
description:
**About Frontiers**


At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.


We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open\-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer\-reviewed and quality\-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real\-world impact of science without barriers.


Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission\-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

**About the role**


We're looking for a **Video Producer** to join our Visual Design team and work closely with the Senior Video Producer to expand and accelerate Frontiers' video storytelling. In this role, you'll take ownership of video productions from planning and filming through to post\-production, creating interviews, talking\-head content, b\-roll, and studio shoots for company\-wide communications and campaigns.


As a second videographer, you'll have the opportunity to lead independent shoots while also supporting larger productions led by the Senior Video Producer. You'll combine strong technical video skills with excellent organization, ensuring that shoots run smoothly, footage meets Frontiers' creative and technical standards, and media assets are efficiently managed throughout the production process.


You'll work closely with colleagues across Communications and Visual Design, as well as researchers, authors, employees, external contributors, and production partners. If you enjoy working both behind the camera and behind the scenes, solving problems on the go, and creating high\-quality visual content in a fast\-paced environment, you'll thrive in this role.


You'll also contribute to improving video production workflows by using technology, AI\-powered tools, and consistent production practices to streamline scheduling, media management, transcription, subtitling, and post\-production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate video shoots end\-to\-end, including scheduling interviews, talking\-head sessions, b\-roll, and studio productions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare and distribute call sheets, coordinate shoot logistics, and ensure crews and on\-camera participants have clear information about locations, timings, requirements, and expectations.
* Scout and book filming locations, studios, and meeting spaces, coordinating travel arrangements and equipment transportation for shoots outside Lausanne.
* Prepare, test, organize, and maintain camera, lighting, audio, and studio equipment, ensuring all production kits are ready for each assignment.
* Independently film interviews, talking\-heads, b\-roll, and studio content, operating professional camera, lighting, and audio equipment to a consistently high standard.
* Work as a second camera operator and provide technical support on larger and multi\-camera productions led by the Senior Video Producer.
* Welcome and brief on\-camera participants, helping guests feel comfortable and confident throughout the filming process while ensuring required release forms and consent documentation are completed.
* Ingest, back up, organize, and archive raw footage following established folder structures, file\-naming conventions, and media management practices.
* Support post\-production by cutting and editing footage, applying colour grading and established brand guidelines, creating and using motion graphics, and preparing subtitles and AI\-assisted transcriptions.
* Work with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, and other relevant production tools to support high\-quality video delivery.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external production partners, including freelance crew, studios, equipment suppliers, editors, and post\-production specialists.
* Identify and resolve technical, logistical, and production challenges independently while maintaining quality, schedules, and production standards.
* Contribute to improving video production workflows, playbooks, and best practices, helping the team increase production capacity and deliver content efficiently.

  

**Requirements**  

* 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in video production, videography, or a similar role, with experience taking video projects from production planning and filming through to post\-production.
* Strong technical video production skills, including professional camera operation, lighting, and audio recording, with the ability to independently deliver high\-quality footage.
* A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating relevant camera, lighting, sound, editing, and/or studio production experience.
* Proficiency in video editing and post\-production tools, particularly Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, with experience in editing, colour grading, and Adobe After Effects/motion graphics.
* Strong production coordination and organizational skills, with experience managing shoot schedules, call sheets, locations, equipment, travel, production documentation, and digital media organization, including footage ingestion, file naming, folder structures, and backups.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 and project collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
* Fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal teams, external production partners, and on\-camera participants.
* A proactive and solutions\-oriented approach, with the ability to troubleshoot technical and logistical challenges calmly and independently while maintaining production and brand standards.
* Familiarity with AI\-powered tools for transcription, subtitling, or production workflows is an advantage.
* Willingness and ability to travel for filming assignments and flexibility to accommodate changing production schedules.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Media Production, Film, Communications, or a related field is preferred, although relevant practical experience will also be considered.
* Experience in corporate communications, science communication, or event filming is an advantage.

  

**Benefits**  

* We prioritise office presence and emphasise in\-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
* Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
* Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
* 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal \& financial support)
* Learning \& development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub

***Equal opportunity statement***

***Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination – including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.***

title: Client Director - Private Client & Wealth structures
description:
**Client Director – Private Client \& Wealth structures**

**Solance** is building a tech\-enabled payments company. We are here for businesses that operate across multiple entities, jurisdictions and currencies, and for sectors that traditional banks generally overlook. Think family offices, internationally operating companies, corporate service providers and the clients they serve. We are going through the authorisation process with the Central Bank of Ireland, one of the most respected financial jurisdictions in Europe, and we are only getting started.

**Solance Private Clients** is one of our niches, built specifically for family offices and the parties that work closely with them. We begin with where we are strongest: payments and cards, giving clients a reliable financial partner for their day\-to\-day business. But that’s only the start. From there, we become the single point of contact for everything else a private client and their advisers need, from borrowing solutions and estate planning to investment advisory and wealth management. We do not provide those services ourselves. But we do solve them, drawing on a vast network of (private) banks, wealth managers, tax advisors and trusted partners who can facilitate almost any request a client brings. For every client need we will find the right party to accommodate such need.


**Your role, in plain terms**


This is a pure sales/BD seat. As Client Director for Solance you open doors, build trust, and turn relationships into a real pipeline. You will work the market you already know: the CSPs, the fiduciaries, the (multi) family offices, the wealth managers and the advisers who orbit private wealth. You bring them to Solance, and you own the relationship from there. Think of it as your own shop within Solance. You own the niche, you shape the brand of the Private Client business, and you run it with the freedom of a founder and with a tech\-enabled licensed EMI behind you. Nobody hands you a script or confines you to a certain territory. You determine where the business is and you go and build it.

**Who we are looking for:**

* You are about eight to ten years into your career, you have spent most of it in the world that revolves around private wealth: CSPs, international tax advisory, fiduciary firms, private banking, or any position where your days were spent across the table from private clients and their advisors.
* Ideally you have worked at more than one firm, so you understand how the PC industry really works, and you have a network that runs across that industry.
* People with a background in PC advisory and corporate services know two things you cannot teach overnight: a network, and the lingo.
* You already know a lot of CSPs, the introducers and the advisers.
* You understand what it takes to work with private banks and wealth managers, how and why corporate structures are actually created, what substance really means in practice, and how to talk to clients who expect to be taken seriously. That head\-start is exactly what Solance is built on.
* You add value to your clients.
* You are credible, discreet, and easy to trust in a room full of advisers and/or principals.
* You have energy, you get things done.
* You know where the business is, and you go and get it.

We need a builder, not a maintainer. Someone who runs, who is genuinely hungry, who gets a kick out of chasing a deal and closing it.  
* 

  

  

**Requirements**  

* Eight to ten years’ experience in a Private Client environment (CSP, advisory, banking), ideally across more than one firm.
* A genuine specialisation in, or strong exposure to, private clients and wealth.
* An active network of CSPs, fiduciaries, introducers, advisers and bankers.
* Skilled in structuring, substance and how international private wealth is organised.
* A builder's mentality: hungry, self\-starting, eager to run your own shop.
* International, and preferably multilingual. (English is a must)

**What is in it for you**


You will work very close with the CEO of Solance, not three layers down. You get real ownership of your client book, room to grow a team as your sales justify it, and the freedom to build the Private Client business, and its brand, from the ground up as if it were your own company. This comes with a competitive package, bonuses tied to what you actually bring in, and the chance to become a recognised name in a market you already care about. It is a builder's seat above all.

**Where you come from**

* We already have a good network in Luxembourg, Switzerland and Malta, if that’s your world, we’d love to hear from you too. But we are mostly interested in someone who opens new ground: The Netherlands, Cyprus, Iberia, the Nordics, wherever your relationships run deepest.
* Languages and a genuinely international footprint are a real advantage.
* Where you are based does not matter to us. You will be on the road constantly, in front of clients and partners wherever the business is, so base yourself wherever suits you. What matters is your reach, your network and your appetite for travel. That said, we do want you in our Dublin office on a regular basis, to stay close to the team and to feed what you are hearing from clients back into the business.
* You will be our ears in the market, and the product gets better because of what you bring home.

**Let us talk**


If this reads like you, get in touch. And if it reads like someone you rate, send them our way, or send us the introduction.

AI Project Manager
description:
At Sanoma Learning, we all share a deep\-rooted passion for education and are committed to support teachers to help all students to reach their potential, so they can be at their best in class. We are proud of the impact we make together across Europe, local as well as international. As our teams and the scope of our impact grows, so do the opportunities for us to learn from each other – across country borders and areas of expertise. With over 3\.000 colleagues, we work on seamlessly integrated print, digital and blended learning solutions to help teachers and schools develop the talents of every child. Our people are passionate and committed and always willing to go the extra mile for students, teachers, schools, our shareholders and each other.


We believe that Data and AI can uncover multiple opportunities for education, including both internal efficiencies and new product opportunities; currently AI is a priority theme for Sanoma Learning.  



**AI Project Manager**

The AI Project Manager is part of the AI Enablement team – the small central team that makes AI work at Sanoma Learning possible: setting direction, building the foundations, and connecting the many parties involved. The team works as a flexible unit: members take ownership of the initiatives that matter most at a given moment, and capacity is redirected as priorities shift.  



Within that team, this role carries a clear centre of gravity: it is the connection point between AI at Sanoma Learning and the outside world, and between the AI team and the functions that own communication and strategy. The role does not replace those functions. It makes sure they have the AI substance, the right experts and the right coordination to do their work well – and it turns what the AI teams do into something that colleagues, customers, partners and the wider education community can understand and engage with.  



Reporting to the Senior Director, Head of Data and AI, the AI Project Manager works across operating companies and central functions – Communications, Strategy, M\&A, Legal and the product and experimentation teams – and represents the AI agenda in those forums. This role also assumes matrix reporting into the Competence Lead of Project Management.  



**Key Responsibilities**

**AI communication – internal and external**

Acting as the AI team’s counterpart to the Communications function: bringing the content, the context and the experts, and coordinating the AI side of delivery.


* **Own the editorial cycle of the AI update newsletter** – collect input from AI initiatives and opcos, shape the story, manage the calendar and the review loop with Communications.
* **Run the AI webinar and event series** – programme, speakers, preparation of presenters, logistics with the relevant functions, and follow\-up.
* **Curate and maintain the AI Hub** – keep it current and usable, agree the content structure with contributing teams, and chase the contributions that make it worth visiting.
* **Coordinate AI content for the external website and corporate channels** – gather and quality\-assure input from the AI teams, propose what should be told publicly, and work with Communications, who own publication.
* **Sync a shared communication calendar for AI with communications** – so that announcements, launches, webinars and external moments are sequenced rather than colliding.

**Thought leadership and external presence**

Working with the Strategy function, which owns Sanoma Learning’s thought leadership agenda, to ensure AI is represented with credible substance.


* **Build and manage a pipeline of external speaking opportunities** – identify the conferences and forums worth being at, manage submissions and deadlines, and match the right internal speaker to each.
* **Prepare speakers and material** – coordinate narrative, evidence and rehearsal so that colleagues representing Sanoma Learning externally are well equipped.
* **Drive the production of white papers and publications on AI in education** – coordinate authors, source the evidence from our own initiatives, and run the process to publication with Strategy and Communications.
* **Manage relationships with research institutions and academic partners** – keep the contacts warm, track joint work, and identify where research collaboration strengthens our position.
* **Track the external conversation on AI in education** – what peers, policymakers and researchers are saying – and feed that back into the AI agenda.

**AI partnership and M\&A funnel**

Owning the front end of the AI partnership pipeline, feeding the teams that own the decisions and the transactions.


* **Build and maintain the funnel of AI\-related partnership and acquisition opportunities** – sourcing, structured overview, status and next steps.
* **Run first\-pass screening of candidates** – what they do, how it relates to our AI direction, what a fit would look like – and prepare the material that lets leadership decide what to pursue.
* **Organise the AI\-side assessment** – pull in the technical, product, privacy and compliance expertise needed to evaluate an opportunity properly, and consolidate the view.
* **Coordinate with Strategy and M\&A** , and with the business owners who would take on the partnership.
* **Maintain the relationship layer with active AI partners and vendors** – cadence, follow\-up and internal visibility of what each partnership is delivering.

**Leading AI initiatives and projects**

As a member of a small, flexible team, taking direct ownership of initiatives where capacity and momentum are needed.


* **Lead assigned AI initiatives and projects end to end** – scope, plan, stakeholders, delivery and closure – across the full breadth of the AI agenda.
* **Step into initiatives that need to move** – taking over, unblocking or accelerating work as priorities shift, including topics outside the communication and partnership scope.
* **Bring structure to ambiguous work** – turn broad intentions into a plan with owners, milestones and a decision path.
* **Prepare and facilitate the forums that move decisions forward** – working sessions, steering updates and executive material.
* **Represent the AI Enablement team in cross\-functional programmes** where AI is one of several contributing tracks.

**How this role works with others**

Communication and thought leadership are owned by dedicated functions at Sanoma Learning, and this role does not duplicate them. Its value lies in being the AI team’s connection into those functions: supplying substance and expertise, coordinating the AI\-side contributors, keeping the AI agenda sequenced and visible, and making sure opportunities are not lost because no one on the AI side was joining the dots. The success measure is that Communications and Strategy are consistently well served by AI – not that AI does their work.  



  

**A successful candidate will have the following:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
* Project management certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) are a strong advantage.

Additional coursework or certification in AI/ML, communications, or digital transformation is a plus.  

* 

**Experience**

* 4\+ years of professional experience in project, programme or initiative management in a digital, technology or innovation context, with at least 2 years connected to AI, data or digital transformation topics.
* Demonstrated experience in corporate or B2B communication – for example newsletters, webinars, content platforms, website content or campaign coordination – working with or within a communications function.
* Experience preparing executive\-level and external\-facing material, and supporting senior colleagues in representing the organisation publicly.
* Exposure to partnership management, vendor evaluation, corporate development or M\&A support activities.
* Experience working across multiple stakeholders and business units, preferably in multi\-country or federated environments.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and the current AI landscape, sufficient to translate technical work into language a business or public audience understands.
* Hands\-on experience with collaboration and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, SharePoint) and with content or intranet platforms.

Experience in education, publishing or EdTech, or with research institutions, is a plus.  

* 

**Skills**

* Excellent written communication in English – able to turn technical and strategic material into clear, engaging content for different audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management, comfortable working as a connector between a specialist team and central functions without owning either side.
* Solid project management skills, able to run several parallel tracks with clarity on ownership, deadlines and status.
* Sound understanding of AI and data concepts, and the curiosity to keep that understanding current.
* Ability to structure ambiguous problems, facilitate alignment and drive decisions across teams.
* Strong sense for what is worth telling externally, and the judgement to know what is not.
* Comfortable with documentation, editorial process and governance that keep recurring communication running reliably.

Collaborative and proactive mindset, with an ability to connect the dots across organisational silos.  

* 

**Personal Attributes**

* Proactive and positive “can\-do” attitude, demonstrating initiative and resilience.
* Comfortable operating without formal authority, building influence through reliability and usefulness to others.
* Strong organisational skills, adept at managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Flexible and pragmatic – willing to pick up what the team needs at a given moment.
* Data\-driven decision\-making approach.
* Self\-motivated, consistently seeking opportunities for improvement and innovation.

Passionate about the opportunities in the Data and AI space, and about education.  

* 

**About Sanoma Learning**

  

How do you prepare students for the world, engage their curiosity and inspire them to grow? That is the main question of teachers all around the world. At Sanoma Learning, it has always been our mission to help to find and develop best\-in\-class answers to this question. If you join us, it means that you embark on an exciting journey to help shape the future of learning for primary, secondary and vocational education. We believe that your journey is our success as a company.
  

  

Sanoma Learning is a leading K12 European learning company, operating in 12 countries. Our learning products and services enable and support teachers and schools to develop the talents of every child to reach their potential. By offering printed and digital learning content, as well as digital learning and teaching platforms for primary, secondary and vocational education, we want to grow our positive impact on learning across Europe. With over 3000 employees, we help shape the future of education for 25\+ million of students.
  

  

So, are you ready to start your journey to help shape the future of learning and help teachers to support all students to reach their potential?

**Senior Expert Factory engineer**
==================================

**Who we are**  

  

You’ll be joining a diverse and ambitious team, spread across Germany, Canada, and Spain, all working together to shape the future of sustainable energy. At PowerCo we celebrate collaboration, progress and that spark that turns bold ideas into real impact. From our new gigafactory in Sagunto (Valencia), we’re driving a project that’s transforming both the region and the future of clean mobility in Europe — and you can be part of it.

  

  

**Your role and key responsibilities**  

  

The Expert Factory Engineer is responsible for leading the design, optimization, and continuous improvement of complex manufacturing systems that integrate people, technology, materials, information, and processes.  

The role provides advanced expertise in process engineering, Lean methodologies, operational excellence, and data\-driven improvement to increase productivity, quality, flexibility, and cost efficiency across the plant. The Expert Factory Engineer also drives the standardization and replication of best practices within the PowerCo plant network.

  


Key Responsibilities  

1\. Process Optimization \& Operational Excellence  

* Lead Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives to eliminate waste, improve process stability, and increase operational performance.
* Drive the application and continuous improvement of PowerCo Excellence System tools, including 5S, Problem Solving, Quick Setup, Shopfloor Management, and related methodologies.
* Conduct process mapping, value stream analysis, bottleneck analysis, and workflow redesign to optimize end\-to\-end processes.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve productivity, quality, lead time, flexibility, and overall equipment and resource utilization.
  

2\. Production \& Industrial Engineering  

* Design and optimize production systems, plant layouts, workflows, and capacity models to ensure the effective use of space, equipment, and workforce.
* Perform time studies, motion studies, and process analysis to establish standards and identify productivity improvements.
* Develop and maintain standard work, standard worksheets, SOPs, and other process documentation.
* Support the industrialization and ramp\-up of new processes and ensure their integration into stable and efficient production systems.
  

3\. Systems Design \& Strategic Planning  

* Design and optimize integrated manufacturing systems across production, maintenance, quality, logistics, and supply chain interfaces.
* Translate operational and business requirements into sustainable engineering solutions aligned with long\-term plant objectives.
* Assess future capacity, process requirements, and operational scenarios to support strategic production planning.
* Identify opportunities for standardization and replication of successful solutions across the PowerCo plant network.
  

4\. Data Analytics \& Performance Management  

* Collect, analyze, and interpret operational data to identify trends, deviations, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
* Define, monitor, and report relevant KPIs to support data\-driven decision\-making and performance management.
* Develop and utilize digital Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and other analytical tools to visualize processes, identify bottlenecks, and evaluate improvement scenarios.
* Establish performance baselines and quantify the impact and sustainability of improvement initiatives.
  

5\. Cost \& Resource Optimization  

* Identify and implement cost\-reduction opportunities while maintaining safety, quality, compliance, and operational requirements.
* Optimize workforce allocation, equipment utilization, material flow, and other operational resources.
* Evaluate the business impact of engineering solutions and provide data\-driven recommendations to management.
  

6\. Collaboration, Knowledge Sharing \& Stakeholder Management  

* Work closely with Production, Maintenance, Quality, Logistics, Supply Chain, and other relevant functions to develop and implement sustainable solutions.
* Act as a technical expert and advisor for operational excellence and industrial engineering topics.
* Coach and support teams in the application of Lean, problem\-solving, standardization, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Coordinate closely with PowerCo Headquarters in Salzgitter and other plants within the PowerCo network, including St. Thomas, to exchange knowledge, benchmark performance, and implement best practices.
  

  

**What you bring to the team**  

  

* 6\+ years of proven experience in Industrial/Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, or Operational Excellence, with strong expertise in the areas described above.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree Electrical Engineering,IT Engineering, or a related field.
* Fluent in English.
* Willingness to travel internationally.

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Looking for a HVAC Maintenance Technician opportunity at a place you can make a difference every day? Discover this great opportunity in our Diego Garcia location. Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact towards our military defense and safety of our sailors by discovering your new role supporting this critical mission.  

**This position is contingent upon your ability to obtain/maintain/transfer your Secret clearance.**
As the HVAC Maintenance Technician in Diego Garcia, Serco\-NA, in conjunction with the United States Space Force (USSF) are responsible for tracking all man\-made objects in orbit. This mission is vital to keeping existing satellites safe and to provide critical information to organizations launching new satellites in the future. One of the assets USSF uses to accomplish this mission is the Ground\-Based Electro\-Optical Deep Space Surveillance (GEODSS) System.


This optical sensor is employed at three (3\) different locations around the world (White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico; Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory; and Maui, Hawaii) and helps track the objects in deep space orbit (altitude of 10,000 to 45,000 km).


Come join the team that provides this service to United States. You will help operate and maintain three (3\), one\-meter telescopes equipped with highly sensitive digital cameras. You’ll respond to Government tasking to obtain metric observations of specific objects daily and help maintain the sensors, support equipment, and the facility that houses it at Detachment 2, Naval Support Facility in Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory (BIOT).


This is a unique work\-site, so being a part of the Serco\-NA GEODSS Team, you will be offered Special Incentives:


* Free Internet,
* Meal allowances,
* Competitive salaries,
* Retention Bonus,
* Paid Time\-Off, and many more.

* Provide, as required, local purchase support.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 30 pounds.

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:


* The ability to obtain/maintain an Active DoD Secret Security clearance.
* A High School Diploma or GED equivalent.
* 3 years related experience in the operation, maintenance and repair of electrical systems, refrigeration, ventilation, and air conditioning systems.
	+ If performing the duties of the heating/plumbing mechanic, must have 3 years experience in the operation, maintenance, and repair of heating and plumbing systems.

* Completion of accredited trade school in heating/plumbing mechanic.
* Must be able to work shift duty due to 24/7 operations environment.

description:
TomTom is a global leader in navigation, mapping, and traffic information. Join our dynamic team and vibrant culture to contribute to shaping the future of location technology.  


We are looking for an Applied Scientist to shape how AI understands and uses TomTom's location data. You'll develop machine learning models and design the systems that let LLMs reason accurately over maps, traffic, points of interest and routing. You'll turn open\-ended product questions into well\-defined scientific problems, validate solutions with rigorous evaluation, and work with AI and software engineers to bring them to production.
### **What you'll do:**

* **LLM–data interfaces:** Research and design how LLMs access and reason over TomTom's data. This covers retrieval strategies for structured and geospatial data, tool and API designs that LLMs can use reliably, text\-to\-query approaches, and grounding techniques.
* **Data representation:** Develop representations that make location data usable by AI, such as embeddings for geospatial entities, knowledge graphs and structured context formats.
* **Evaluation science:** Define how we measure whether LLM\-powered systems are right. Build benchmarks, factuality and hallucination metrics, and evaluation datasets for location\-grounded tasks, and work with engineers to automate them.
* **Model research and development:** Design, train and fine\-tune ML and deep learning models, including LLMs, computer vision, time\-series and graph\-based methods, using large\-scale, multi\-modal data.
* **Problem framing:** Work with product managers and stakeholders to identify high\-impact opportunities and turn them into well\-defined scientific problems with clear success metrics.
* **Research to production:** Write production\-quality code and work with AI and software engineers to take solutions from prototype to production, balancing accuracy, latency, cost and scalability.
* **State of the art:** Keep up with the latest research in LLMs, retrieval and agentic systems, and adapt promising techniques to TomTom's problems.
* **Knowledge sharing:** Communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, and help build a strong scientific culture. External publications and patents are encouraged.
### **What you'll need:**


* Bachelor’s, Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics or a related quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong foundations in machine learning, deep learning, statistics and optimization.
* Hands\-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX, and with the Python scientific stack (NumPy, pandas, scikit\-learn).
* Experience with one or more of: LLMs and generative AI, computer vision, time\-series forecasting, graph neural networks, or reinforcement learning.
* Proven ability to design experiments, define meaningful metrics and draw sound conclusions from data.
* Experience working with large\-scale datasets and distributed computing (e.g., Spark, Databricks, or cloud ML platforms on Azure, AWS or GCP).
* Ability to write clean, maintainable code and to work with engineers toward production deployment.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas to diverse audiences.
* A track record of publications at top\-tier venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, KDD) is a plus.
* Experience with geospatial, mapping, mobility or sensor data is a plus, but not required.
**What we offer**  

A competitive compensation package, of course.  

Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e\-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning.  

Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.  

  

Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.  

Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance.  

Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.  

Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday.  

Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world.  

Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom!  

Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. **Meet your team**  

We're the Navigation SDK team. We work on complex code to develop TomTom's Navigation Software Development Kit, integrating technologies provided by other Product Units and enabling our customers to easily build competitive navigation applications. Your code will also be at the heart of TomTom's navigation products like AmiGO, helping millions of people find their way in the world. **At TomTom...**  

You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first\-ever real\-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.  

Work with a team of 3,300\+ unique, curious and passionate problem\-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them. **After you apply**  

Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow\-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs. **TomTom is an equal opportunity employer**  

TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, *you*. No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. If you can relate to this, please know that we’d love to hear from you.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. **About the role:**

As a Technical Advisor, you will serve as SailPoint's principal\-level identity security strategist for the enterprise. Your mission is to own the multi\-year platform adoption roadmap, architecting unified governance across human, machine, and AI agent identities. You will ensure that every deployment of SailPoint's Identity Security Cloud, Agentic Fabric, and adjacent capabilities translates into measurable business value—quantified as breach risk reduction, compliance efficiency, and operational cost avoidance.


You are a trusted technical strategist and a peer to customer CISOs, CIOs, and VP\-level engineering leaders. You possess an innate ability to translate complex technical realities into strategic business risk language that drives executive decision\-making. As a thought leader in the identity security space, you are driven by professional growth and learning agility. You demonstrate a continuous commitment to expanding your domain mastery, exploring emerging technologies, and engaging with industry developments across identity governance, AI agent security, and enterprise architecture. You are an authoritative voice whose insights shape customer decisions, product strategies, and industry standards.


In this principal\-level role, you will bridge the gap between technical architecture and business value. You will guide strategic enterprise accounts through complex identity governance transformations, addressing modern challenges that span human identities, machine identities, and emerging AI agents. You will partner closely with Customer Success Managers to align technical strategies with commercial outcomes, providing the architectural evidence and value quantification necessary to support renewals and expansions. Furthermore, you will identify cross\-account patterns and synthesize these into actionable frameworks that influence SailPoint's product roadmap and engineering efforts.  



**Responsibilities:**

* Platform Adoption Roadmap Ownership: Design and maintain multi\-year platform adoption roadmaps for strategic accounts, sequencing deployments across Identity Security Cloud, Agentic Fabric, Machine Identity Security, Data Access Security, and Harbor Pilot based on customer maturity and business priorities.
* Unified Identity Governance Architecture: Architect comprehensive identity governance models spanning human, machine, and AI agent identities, ensuring cohesive policy frameworks, consistent lifecycle management, and integrated access controls.
* Executive Technical Advisory: Act as the trusted technical advisor for C\-suite and VP\-level engineering leaders, engaging on identity security strategy, regulatory architecture, and technology investment prioritization.
* Value Realization Quantification: Define, implement, and maintain value measurement frameworks. Quantify identity security outcomes (breach risk reduction, compliance gains, cost avoidance) and present these in quarterly executive reviews.
* Agentic Identity Governance Advisory: Guide customers through the design and deployment of AI agent identity governance using SailPoint Agentic Fabric, including agent discovery, risk\-tier classification, and least\-privilege enforcement.
* Regulatory Compliance Translation: Translate regulatory requirements (DORA, NIS2, SEC cyber disclosure, SOX, HIPAA) into actionable identity governance architectures, ensuring compliance through platform capabilities.
* Cross\-Account Pattern Synthesis: Identify recurring governance challenges and architectural anti\-patterns across enterprise customers, distilling them into reusable frameworks and strategic intelligence for Product Management and Engineering.
* CSM Strategic Partnership: Partner with Customer Value Partners to align technical strategy with commercial outcomes, providing data that supports renewal justification and expansion business cases.
* Thought Leadership \& Knowledge Contribution: Author technical strategy content, present at customer advisory boards, contribute to SailPoint's body of knowledge, and mentor less senior advisors.

**Roadmap for success**

Dive deep into SailPoint’s core identity security portfolio—including Identity Security Cloud (ISC), and emerging solutions like NERM and DAS—and the Atlas extensibility platform. You will shadow active customer engagements, learn organizational consulting best practices, and build strong foundational knowledge of our products, architectures, and internal cross\-functional team structures.

Collaborate closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Technical Leads to support initial customer engagements, joint Executive Business Reviews, and Business Value Realization touchpoints. You will begin performing initial maturity assessments, aligning customer business drivers with the SailPoint identity strategy, and designing integration roadmaps across technology alliances such as ServiceNow, SAP, AWS, ad Workday etc, where you could also work along with a technical advisor for initial engagements.  



**90 days:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Extensive experience in identity and access management (IAM), identity governance and administration (IGA), and enterprise security architecture.
* Industry\-recognized cybersecurity and architecture certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, TOGAF, CISA) are highly preferred.

title: Head of Operations — Switching, Billing & Cash Collection / energy retail experience
description:
Company Description
  
MET Retail is a new chapter for the group: bringing energy directly to households. We're building a technology\-driven retail platform for power and gas, with a digital, customer\-first model. One model, built to scale across Europe.


We're a small international team, and there's a lot to build. Join us on this exciting journey and you'll help shape how this company works, with real ownership from day one.


  
Job Description
  
We are building a digital retail platform for residential customers. The Head of Operations brings practical operational knowledge into digital delivery: understanding market, regulatory, commercial and process needs, designing the way we work, and making sure the operational engine behind the customer journey is accurate, compliant, scalable and AI\-enabled by design rather than by retrofit.


The role covers the transactional backbone of the end\-to\-end customer journey (from contracting to switching, first bill, invoicing and collection) across our billing, CRM and operational tooling. Spain at launch, followed by other markets such as France, Germany and Italy. The person in this role will own switching, billing and invoicing, and cash collection end to end, from process and procedure design through business ownership of the supporting tooling, team build\-up and day\-to\-day performance.


This is a build role, and an AI\-first one. The processes, the controls, the procedures and the team do not exist yet; you will create them. We expect the operating model to be designed around automation and AI from the first process map, with the manual path treated as the exception rather than the starting point.


**Key responsibilities**

* Act as the business reference point for switching, billing, invoicing and cash collection across the Spanish operation and, subsequently, the markets that follow.
* Design and own the end\-to\-end switching process (cambio de comercializadora), including ATR request management, SIPS data validation, contract activation and exception handling
* Define the operational interface with the distribution system operators (e\-distribución, i\-DE, UFD, e\-redes, Viesgo and regional DSOs)
* Manage the operational side of customer exits and win\-back, including debt\-related switching constraints
* Design the billing cycle end to end: meter data acquisition and validation, estimation logic, tariff application across residential structures (2\.0TD for electricity, RL and TUR bands for gas), rebilling and corrections. Cash Collection \& Credit Risk
* Design and run the collections’ function: SEPA Core direct debit cycles (Cuaderno 19 / 19\-14\), bank reconciliation (Cuaderno 43\), returns and unpaid handling, and alternative payment methods
* Write the operating model: process maps, standard operating procedures, RACI, control framework and an escalation model that holds up under regulatory and financial audit
* Hire, structure and lead the operations team
* Identify, prioritise and specify AI use cases across the meter\-to\-cash chain
* Set the target automation ratio per process and raise it every quarter
* Collaborate across Offering, Growth, Customer Service and Finance on the business side, and Product, Architecture, Engineering and Data on the delivery side.

  
Qualifications
  
* University degree
* At least 5 years of **experience in energy retail operations** , with direct, hands\-on ownership of switching, billing or cash collection in the Spanish market
* Solid command of the Spanish regulatory framework for residential electricity and/or gas retail: ATR processes, tariff structure, regulated charges, supply\-interruption rules and consumer protection obligations
* Proven experience setting up processes, procedures and teams from scratch
* Strong practical understanding of the meter\-to\-cash chain and of the operational, commercial and regulatory constraints that shape it in a B2C environment
* Demonstrable, practical understanding of AI and automation applied to operational problems
* Comfortable with SQL, data models, APIs and file\-based integrations
* Experience acting as business owner for a core operational platform — defining requirements, supporting vendor evaluation, driving UAT and business validation alongside an IT organisation
* Fluent Spanish and English, written and spoken. Italian, French or German language skills considered as a plus
* Experience in one or more other European retail energy markets — France, Germany or Italy in particular is highly appreciated
* Familiarity with a modern billing or CIS platform (SAP IS\-U or S/4HANA Utilities, Salesforce Energy \& Utilities Cloud, Gentrack, Hansen, Powercloud, Kraken or equivalent) is highly appreciated
* Experience in a start\-up or scale\-up environment, comfortable operating without an established playbook, is a plus
* Experience with collaboration and documentation tools such as Jira, Confluence, Miro, Visio, Signavio or BPMN tools is an advantage

ERP system knowledge (e.g. SAP) is preferential.

title: Chief Executive Officer H/F
description:
**Cabinet D\-JP.A** is conducting a search for a client operating in the **stock images and digital visual\-content industry**. The client is developing a new business platform designed to respond to the structural transformation of the global visual\-content market and is now seeking a Chief Executive Officer to lead its next phase of development.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Define and execute the company’s strategic roadmap in close collaboration with the consortium founders and shareholders.
* Translate the strategic vision into clear operational priorities and measurable objectives.
* Establish key milestones, performance indicators and management reporting.
* Identify new strategic opportunities and adapt priorities as the market evolves.
* Ensure the organisation remains focused on its core growth and value\-creation objectives.

**Commercial Development**

* Define and execute the company’s commercial and go\-to\-market strategy.
* Develop new revenue streams and identify scalable business opportunities.
* Build and strengthen relationships with customers, strategic accounts and commercial partners.
* Develop a scalable business model capable of supporting international growth.
* Establish the foundations for expansion into new markets.
* Build a strong, performance\-driven commercial culture across the organisation.

**Financial Management \& Fundraising**

* Take overall responsibility for financial performance, budgeting, forecasting and cash management.
* Establish robust financial reporting and management\-control processes.
* Prepare and regularly update the company’s business plan and financial projections.
* Lead fundraising initiatives in collaboration with founders and shareholders.
* Build credible relationships with investors, financial partners and other stakeholders.
* Prepare the company for future financing rounds and investor due diligence.
* Ensure capital is allocated efficiently and in line with strategic priorities.

**Technology \& Innovation**

* Work closely with technology leadership to define the product and technology roadmap.
* Translate commercial and strategic requirements into clear technology priorities.
* Maintain a strong understanding of developments in artificial intelligence, digital platforms and emerging technologies.
* Identify technologies capable of improving scalability, efficiency and customer experience.
* Ensure technology investments support the company’s long\-term competitive positioning.
* Encourage innovation while maintaining clear commercial and operational objectives.

**Building the Organisation**

* Build and lead a high\-performing, multidisciplinary organisation.
* Recruit key executives, managers and specialist talent as the company develops.
* Define clear roles, responsibilities and performance expectations.
* Establish effective management processes and appropriate corporate governance.
* Develop a culture combining entrepreneurial agility with professional execution.
* Create an organisation capable of scaling internationally without unnecessary bureaucracy.

**Strategic Partnerships**

* Develop senior\-level relationships across the digital media, technology, creative and cultural ecosystems.
* Identify and negotiate strategic commercial and technology partnerships.
* Explore opportunities for distribution, content, licensing and international collaboration.
* Build relationships capable of accelerating market access and business development.
* Represent the company with strategic partners and key industry stakeholders.

**What We Are Looking For**

The ideal candidate should have the ability to transform an ambitious strategic vision into a scalable international business :

* Significant experience as a **CEO, Managing Director, General Manager, Founder, senior COO** or comparable executive leader.
* Ideally **7\+ years of senior management or leadership experience**.
* Demonstrated responsibility for business strategy, financial performance and operational execution.
* Experience developing and implementing business plans and growth strategies.
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, cash management and financial reporting.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building organisations through periods of growth.
* Demonstrated commercial and business\-development capabilities.
* Experience working with founders, shareholders, boards and/or investors.
* Exposure to fundraising, financing rounds or investor relations would be particularly valuable.
* Experience with digital platforms, technology\-enabled businesses or international expansion.
* Professional fluency in **French and English**; additional languages would be an advantage.

Relevant industry backgrounds may include **digital media, technology, AI, SaaS, marketplaces, creative industries, photography, digital commerce, licensing, fintech or platform businesses**.

Experience in the visual\-content or stock\-image industry would be valuable, but it is **not a prerequisite**.

**Location \& International Scope**

The position is based in Lisbon, Portugal, with an international scope. The CEO will work with shareholders, partners and stakeholders across different markets and should be comfortable with international travel when required.

**Recruitment Process**

* Initial conversation with the recruitment team at Cabinet D\-JP.A.
* Executive interviews with the consortium founding members.
* Strategic discussion around the business plan and CEO mandate.
* Final offer and appointment.

Candidates may be asked to provide a perspective on how they would approach the first 12–18 months of execution for the round A shareholders. The identity of the client will be progressively disclosed to candidates who have been qualified and selected to advance in the process. If this opportunity corresponds to your experience and ambitions, please submit your CV together with a short executive introduction to Cabinet D\-JP.A. All enquiries will be handled confidentially.

Pay: 70,000\.00€ \- 80,000\.00€ per year

* Do you know the stock photography industry?
* Did you manage a company before?
* Are you based in Lisbon or willing to relocate in Portugal?

Language:

* French and English (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Lisboa

title: Director of Creative, Luxury Hospitality

**Luxury storyteller. Creative leader. Brand obsessive.**
 Luxury is felt long before it is booked. If you know how to create work that makes people stop, look twice and want to be there, this is a rare opportunity to do it on a global stage.
   

  

 Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Vignette Collection and Kimpton sit at the heart of the IHG Hotels \& Resorts Luxury \& Lifestyle portfolio. Each has its own character, its own following and its own sense of place. As the portfolio grows, and as our Upper Luxury brands take centre stage, we are creating dedicated creative leadership to protect what makes each one distinctive and push the work further.
   

  

 As Creative Director, you will set the creative vision for our luxury and lifestyle brands and be the senior creative partner to the people who lead them. Your thinking will shape campaigns, content, hotel openings and guest moments, from the first image someone sees to the detail they notice on arrival.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Global Creative Services and based in Windsor, you will work across global and regional teams, with international travel part of the rhythm of the role.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Set and champion the creative vision for the Luxury \& Lifestyle portfolio, keeping every brand true to its own voice.
* Partner closely with brand, marketing and commercial leaders, bringing a clear point of view to the decisions that shape how we show up.
* Lead global multi\-channel campaigns and content that build desire and deliver commercially, across owned, earned and paid.
* Raise the bar on craft, from photography and film to design systems, experiential moments and digital.
* Mentor creative talent and get the best from our studio and agency partners.
* Shape how creative works at IHG, including where new technology and AI tools genuinely add something, without losing the human judgement behind great work.


**What You'll Bring**
* A career built in creative leadership, within luxury hospitality, luxury retail, travel, lifestyle or premium consumer brands.
* A portfolio that speaks for itself, with storytelling and visual craft at a level our guests would expect.
* A genuine point of view on modern luxury and what makes it feel current rather than expected.
* Confidence with senior leaders, and the presence to take them with you.
* Proven success leading integrated global campaigns across multiple markets.
* The instinct to lead multidisciplinary teams and agencies well, and to build something that scales.
* Experience with ultra\-premium or Upper Luxury brands is a real advantage, as is time spent on both agency and client side.


 If you want your work to live in some of the most beautiful hotels in the world, and to lead the creative story of a luxury portfolio in its next chapter, we would love to see it. Apply now.
   

  

*Closing date for applications Friday 2nd October 2026*
 At IHG Hotels \& Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.
   

  

 Over recent years, we’ve transformed our company. We have bold ambitions to drive performance and maintain our relentless focus on growth in order to be the hotel company of choice that guests \& owners love.
   

  

 We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. That’s why here at IHG, we give our colleagues flexibility and balance – working in a hybrid way, blending office and remote working collectively. We recognise that every role is different, that’s why leaders work with teams to determine how and when they collaborate.
   

  

 We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. These include impressive room discounts across our many properties, recharge days and volunteering days throughout the year. Through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.
