And while we have world\-class franchises, infrastructure and resources, our success comes from a passionate, talented and diverse team of people producing greatness together. So, if you’re interested in our biggest priority, it’s our people.

  

  

We’re currently driving the next era for our company and community by creating amazing experiences for fans and continuing to make Activision an inclusive place where everyone can thrive.

  

  

Join us, make history. To learn more, check us out at www.activision.com, www.activisiongamesblog.com or @Activision on Instagram, Twitter, Facebook and LinkedIn.

  

  

**Your Mission**


Activision Publishing is currently looking for an Executive Producer to join the Call of Duty franchise production team. We are looking for an individual who has a passion and proven track record of leading production initiatives.

  

  

As Executive Producer, you will manage production initiatives on one or multiple projects across various platforms from both a business and publishing perspective. You will partner with both internal and external studios in a wide range of areas to achieve franchise initiatives as well as attain financial and schedule goals. This entails day\-to\-day involvement with the development teams and key publishing stakeholders throughout all phases of development, including pre\-production, production, submission, and release. Specific duties include: working with teams to build out initiative requirements, goals, and roadmaps; ensure milestones are delivered on\-time and the game meets quality standards; help maintain creative vision; track overall development; and work closely with all developers and cross\-functional groups to deliver initiatives, activations, and digital content to meet all project and franchise goals. You will guide and advance Call of Duty as you work with all Studios and Business Partners. This role will continuously iterate on best practices across all the franchise games, adapting with the business.  



  

You will be a project leader, and work in with multiple cross\-functional groups, ranging from Activision executive leadership to development studios, and use your experience on the front lines to improve production and organizational processes, as well as drive key franchise initiatives with both developers and internal department leads.  



  

This position is based in our **Santa Monica, California** office and follows an in\-office work model of four days per week. Working arrangements may evolve based on business needs.  



  

**Your responsibilities will include**


* Manage and track game development with internal / external studios across all SKUs of production initiatives tied to a mainline product and its digital life\-cycle.
* Support the creation, development, and execution of production initiatives, projects, pathways, and overall plan; continue to provide supervision and support through full operations life\-cycle
* Collaborate with business partners and studios to provide players with a steady stream of compelling features, content, and events
* Partner with monetization and analytics teams to understand the game’s status and plan updates accordingly
* Act as primary point of contact with Game Development Studios, 1st Parties, Marketing, PR, Operations, Sales, Supply Chain, Licensors, and external contractors across project initiatives
* Partner with Marketing to execute plans for the product lines, brands, and lines of business
* Partner with Developers to ensure specific game features are tied to overall title positioning and goals
* Be an internal and external advocate for the product and support as needed at trade shows and PR events.
* Coach and develop staff to ensure growth and expand the talent base
* Create a culture that promotes collaboration, continuous feedback, support and empowerment. Set clear goals for the team and hold employees accountable for deliverables; recognize and reward employees for strong performance
* Establish model behavior that supports Activision’s standards of professionalism, integrity, and ethics
* Provide creative and executional direction to development studios to improve product quality and drive franchise innovation. Ensure the titles and franchise maintain or exceed creative and technical objectives with each release

  

**What you bring to the table**


* Proven Executive Producer with either internal development or publishing experience who delivers projects to quality, on time and budget.
* 10\+ years of experience in the gaming industry (in a production role); experience with First Person Shooters or Online FPS preferred with 3\+ years of experience at Senior Producer level or above.
* The ability to identify risks early and often and suggest mitigation strategies that are thought through and take into account multiple paths to a solution.
* A Leader of People. Be prepared to lead, mentor and develop future leaders.
* You are knowledgeable about games and trends in the industry ranging from other competitive FPS titles, Monetization, E\-Sports and other ways games are expanding beyond the core mainline experience.

  

*Collaborator \& Communicator*


* You speak other languages; specifically, the languages of marketing, PR, Sales, QA, Customer Service, Localizations, Tech, Monetization, CRM, etc. Producing the game is only part of the job. You’ll collaborate with a wide variety of groups and people.
* Experience effectively collaborating with internal teams and development studios within the video game industry. You will only be as successful as your relationship with the development teams allows.
* You will be the main point of contact for one of the biggest entertainment franchises in the world and requires best in class and timely communications across all mediums (emails, phone, meetings, presentations, etc.)

  

*Gamer Who Knows How to Make a Game Great*


* You are passionate about making video games.
* Ability to evaluate and judge gameplay in its current state and its trajectory towards close. Can identify what plays and looks good and how to drive improvements toward greatness by leveraging qualitative assessments.
* Experience identifying the strengths and weakness in a game and knowing when to marshal resources to lean into strengths or address weaknesses.

  

*Strategist with the Skills to Execute*


* Strong business/financial acumen and understanding of current business models in gaming
* Never afraid to roll up your sleeves to get the job done
* Facilitator who clear roadblocks in front of your team or the development team
* Able to juggle competing priorities and timelines
* Able to break down impossible tasks and make them possible through ingenuity, creativity, and effort.

  

*The Skills \& Experience we’re looking for:*


* Bachelor’s Degree or higher education degree preferred
* 10\+ years of experience in the gaming industry (in a production role)
* 3\+ years of experience at Sr. Producer level or above
* Experience shipping 3\+ high quality titles
* Experience shipping on Xbox, PlayStation, and PC platforms.
* Experience with online FPS games preferred.

  

**Our World**


At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences.

  

  

We’re not just looking back at our decades\-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization.  



  

We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up.  

  



**Ready to Activate Your Future?**

  



We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under\-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.

  

  

We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to candidate\-accommodations@activisionblizzard.com. General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest.  



  

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, among other characteristics.


**Rewards**


We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well\-being for ‘Every World’ \- we’ve got our employees covered! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:

Founded in 2009, Beyond Meat’s core products are designed to have the same taste and texture as animal\-based meat while being better for people and the planet.
   

  

 The Company’s brand promise, Eat What You Love®, represents a strong belief that there is a better way to feed our future and that the positive choices we all make, no matter how small, can have a great impact on our personal health and the health of our planet. By shifting from animal\-based protein to plant\-based protein, we can positively impact four growing global issues: human health, climate change, constraints on natural resources and animal welfare.

 The
 ***Director, Brand Marketing***

 ***Director, Brand Marketing***

title: Regional Director, Human Resources
description:
**Location Address:**


9521 San Mateo NE Albuquerque, NM 87113\-2237
**Summary:**


Regional Director, Human Resources  

  

Presbyterian Healthcare Services (PHS) seeks a strategic, collaborative, and influential Human Resources leader to serve as its next Regional Director, Human Resources. This highly visible leadership role serves as the senior HR partner for the Regional Delivery System and is responsible for delivering comprehensive human resources strategy, employee relations support, workforce planning, leadership development, and organizational effectiveness initiatives across multiple facilities and service locations.  

  

As healthcare organizations continue to navigate workforce shortages, labor market pressures, leadership development needs, employee engagement challenges, and increasing regulatory complexity, Presbyterian is seeking an HR executive who can balance strategic business partnership with operational excellence.  

  

The Regional Director serves as a trusted advisor to Regional Executive Leadership and plays a critical role in ensuring the successful execution of human capital strategies that support organizational growth, workforce stability, employee engagement, and exceptional patient care. This leader will oversee regional HR operations while partnering closely with Centers of Excellence across Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits, Employee Relations, Learning \& Development, and Human Resources Operations.  

  

The ideal candidate is an experienced healthcare HR leader who excels at building relationships, coaching leaders, navigating complex employee relations matters, and creating people strategies that drive business outcomes.**Job Description:**


Strategic Human Resources Leadership

* Serve as the senior HR advisor to Regional Executive Leadership.
* Develop and execute workforce strategies that support organizational objectives and operational performance.
* Partner with leaders to address talent, organizational design, succession planning, workforce engagement, and leadership development needs.
* Translate business priorities into actionable people strategies.
* Ensure alignment between regional workforce initiatives and enterprise human capital objectives.


Employee Relations \& Workforce Risk Management

* Lead employee relations strategy and provide oversight for complex and sensitive workforce matters.
* Ensure timely and effective resolution of employee concerns, complaints, workplace investigations, and organizational issues.
* Oversee complex employee relations investigations involving workplace conduct, performance, discrimination, harassment, retaliation, workplace violence, and other sensitive matters.
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, and senior leadership on employment\-related risk mitigation strategies.
* Serve as a key organizational resource regarding employment law, policy interpretation, and employee relations best practices.


Leadership Coaching \& Organizational Effectiveness

* Provide executive coaching and consultation to leaders at all levels.
* Support leadership effectiveness, organizational development, team performance, and succession planning initiatives.
* Partner with operational leaders to strengthen engagement, accountability, and workforce performance.
* Lead change management efforts associated with organizational initiatives and strategic priorities.
* Foster a culture of inclusion, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement.


Human Resources Operations

* Ensure effective delivery of HR services across recruitment, onboarding, performance management, employee relations, benefits administration, compliance, and workforce planning.
* Lead and develop regional HR teams to ensure consistent service delivery and operational excellence.
* Collaborate with enterprise HR functions to implement system\-wide policies, programs, and initiatives.
* Monitor HR service levels and continuously improve operational effectiveness and customer satisfaction.


Compliance, Regulatory \& Policy Oversight

* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and applicable federal, state, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain adherence to employment laws, Joint Commission standards, state licensure requirements, and healthcare workforce regulations.
* Monitor HR practices to ensure consistency, compliance, and risk mitigation.
* Support audits, regulatory reviews, accreditation surveys, and compliance initiatives.


Workforce Analytics \& Data\-Driven Decision Making

* Monitor and analyze key workforce metrics, trends, and organizational performance indicators.
* Utilize employee relations, engagement, turnover, retention, and workforce planning data to identify opportunities and risks.
* Provide executive leaders with actionable workforce insights and strategic recommendations.
* Support organizational decision\-making through meaningful HR reporting and analytics.


Compensation, Benefits \& Employee Support

* Partner with Compensation and Benefits teams to support workforce planning and employee experience initiatives.
* Coordinate employee health and workforce support activities related to workers' compensation, leave management, ADA, FMLA, and disability programs.
* Ensure employees and managers receive effective guidance and support regarding benefits, leave, and employment programs.


Financial Management

* Develop and manage departmental operating budgets.
* Monitor financial performance and resource utilization.
* Ensure efficient use of organizational resources while maintaining service excellence.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational effectiveness and reduce costs.


Team Leadership \& Talent Development

* Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain high\-performing HR professionals.
* Establish performance expectations and accountability measures.
* Build organizational capabilities within the HR team to support evolving business needs.
* Foster a culture focused on service excellence, partnership, innovation, and continuous learning.


Success Measures


Within the first 12–24 months, the Regional Director will be expected to:

* Establish trusted advisor relationships with regional executives and operational leaders.
* Improve leadership capability through coaching, succession planning, and workforce development initiatives.
* Reduce employee relations risk through proactive consultation, effective investigations, and workforce engagement strategies.
* Improve employee engagement, retention, and workforce stability metrics.
* Strengthen HR service delivery and customer satisfaction across assigned facilities.
* Enhance compliance with employment laws, regulatory standards, and organizational policies.
* Develop meaningful workforce dashboards and reporting that support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Build a high\-performing HR team capable of supporting complex healthcare operations.
* Successfully lead organizational change initiatives and workforce transformation efforts.

**Additional Job Description:**

**Required**

* Minimum of 8 years of progressive Human Resources experience.
* Significant employee relations experience within a complex organization.
* Experience advising senior leaders on workforce, organizational, and employee relations matters.
* Experience leading HR teams and managing multiple HR functions.
* Proven ability to coach leaders and influence organizational outcomes.

**Preferred**

* Healthcare, hospital, or integrated delivery system experience.
* Previous HR Director, Senior HR Business Partner, Regional HR Leader, or HR Operations leadership experience.
* Experience managing complex workforce investigations and employment\-related litigation support.
* Experience with workforce analytics, organizational development, and succession planning initiatives.

**Benefits**  

Benefits are effective day\-one (for .45 FTE and above) and include:

* Competitive salaries
* Full medical, dental and vision insurance
* Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
* Free wellness programs
* Paid time off (PTO)
* Retirement plans, including matching employer contributions
* Continuing education and career development opportunities
* Life insurance and short/long term disability programs

**About Us**  

Presbyterian Healthcare Services is a locally owned, not\-for\-profit healthcare system of nine hospitals, a statewide health plan and a growing multi\-specialty medical group. Founded in New Mexico in 1908, it is the state's largest private employer with approximately 11,000 employees.  

  

Presbyterian's story is really the story of the remarkable people who have chosen to work here. Starting with Reverend Cooper who began our journey in 1908, the hard work of thousands of physicians, employees, board members, and other volunteers brought Presbyterian from a tiny tuberculosis sanatorium to a statewide healthcare system, serving more than 700,000 New Mexicans.  

  

We are part of New Mexico's history \- and committed to its future. That is why we will continue to work just as hard and care just as deeply to serve New Mexico for years to come.

**About New Mexico**  

New Mexico's unique blend of Spanish, Mexican and Native American influences contribute to a culturally rich lifestyle. Add in Albuquerque's International Balloon Fiesta, Los Alamos' nuclear scientists, Roswell's visitors from outer space, and Santa Fe's artists, and you get an eclectic mix of people, places and experiences that make this state great.  

  

Cities in New Mexico are continually ranked among the nation's best places to work and live by Forbes magazine, Kiplinger's Personal Finance, and other corporate and government relocation managers like Worldwide ERC.  

  

New Mexico offers endless recreational opportunities to explore, and enjoy an active lifestyle. Venture off the beaten path, challenge your body in the elements, or open yourself up to the expansive sky. From hiking, golfing and biking to skiing, snowboarding and boating, it's all available among our beautiful wonders of the west.  

  

AA/EOE/VET/DISABLED. PHS is a drug\-free and tobacco\-free employer with smoke free campuses.

title: Technology Lead
description:
At Horizontal Digital, we hold ourselves to one key belief: You’re only as good as your worst customer experience. This mantra is what drives our digital consultancy to think beyond the easy answers and instead create websites, apps, portals and other experiences that solve customer needs for Fortune 500 companies in intuitive and empathetic ways. And we make this lofty standard a reality by fusing strategy, data, design and technology together to arrive at solutions that set the bar higher for everyone.

**We use these values to fuel superior results:**

**Lock arms**  

We forge relationships that make our impact 1,000x stronger. This means working across departments and engaging both our clients and our communities to deliver the greatest good.

**Show hustle**  

We’re not ones to sit on our hands and wait. Instead, we anticipate opportunities, collectively roll up our sleeves and find ways to execute the exceptional.

**Embrace change**  

From new technologies to workplace philosophies, we welcome the unexpected and constantly anticipate what’s next.

**Elevate empathy**  

We listen before we take action. This means understanding a variety of perspectives and holding ourselves to a higher standard of accountability.

**Never settle**  

We motivate each other to push past the easy answers and collectively arrive at bigger, more inspiring ideas.  

  

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.


As a **Technology Lead** in our Sitecore Practice, you own the technical implementation of client programs end to end — from discovery and solution definition through build, QA and release. Your measure of success is simple: satisfied clients, successful project delivery, and healthy project margins.


We're looking for a hands\-on player/coach who has shipped modern, composable Sitecore solutions on SitecoreAI (formerly XM Cloud) with headless Next.js front ends hosted on Vercel or Netlify. You'll lead a blended team of front\-end and back\-end developers, partner closely with project management, strategy and UX/creative, and bring a pragmatic, AI\-assisted approach to how we design, build and deliver.

**What You'll Do**


Solution Leadership \& Delivery

* **Own technical delivery:** accountable for quality, timeline and budget of the technical solution across one or more client engagements, in partnership with the Project Manager.
* **Lead technical discovery:** run discovery sessions, technical assessments and audits, and translate business goals and creative/UX artifacts into functional and technical specifications.
* **Define the architecture:** shape headless solutions on SitecoreAI — content modeling, component design, rendering strategy (SSG/ISR/SSR), integrations, search, personalization, and the hosting, CI/CD and environment strategy on Vercel or Netlify.
* **Plan the work:** lead sprint breakdown and estimation, identify technical dependencies and risks, and define the technology approach and toolset.
* **Guard quality:** perform solution and code reviews, enforce Helix\-aligned and front\-end best practices, and approve features for hand\-off to QA. Ensure solutions meet performance (Core Web Vitals), accessibility (WCAG), SEO and security standards.
* **Drive QA and release:** partner with the QA lead on test plans and UAT, triage defects, own deployment run\-books and rollback plans, and oversee production releases.
* **Be the technical face to the client:** support technical decision\-making, handle escalations, and communicate status, risks and opportunities clearly to client and internal stakeholders.


People \& Team

* **Lead and grow the team:** assign and oversee daily work, clear blockers, and act as the technical escalation point.
* **Coach and mentor:** support developers' career growth through feedback, performance reviews and training, and partner with Talent Acquisition on interviewing and hiring.
* **Champion AI\-assisted engineering:** help the team adopt AI development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) responsibly to improve velocity and quality.


Practice \& Growth

* **Support business development:** contribute to solution proposals, estimates and client presentations as requested by the Group Technology Director.
* **Grow accounts:** identify ongoing client needs and engage the right internal resources for new opportunities.
* **Strengthen the practice:** contribute to internal standards, accelerators, reusable components and thought leadership, and stay current on Sitecore, headless and AI trends.

**What You Bring**

* 7\+ years of hands\-on web development experience, including 5\+ years delivering enterprise Sitecore solutions.
* **Recent, hands\-on SitecoreAI / XM Cloud experience:** headless architecture, Content SDK (or JSS), Experience Edge and GraphQL, Pages/component builder, SXA headless, and serialization\-based DevOps.
* Strong Next.js, React and TypeScript skills, including App Router, rendering strategies (SSG/ISR/SSR), middleware, and performance optimization.
* Experience deploying and operating headless front ends on Vercel and/or Netlify: environments, preview deployments, edge/serverless functions, caching and CI/CD with Git.
* Working knowledge of .NET / C\# for Sitecore back\-end customization and integrations, plus REST/GraphQL API integration experience.
* 3\+ years leading development teams using Agile/Scrum, including estimation, sprint planning and code review.
* Solid grounding in accessibility, SEO, web performance and security best practices.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders and present solutions to clients.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Some travel required.

**Bonus Points For**

* Practical use of AI\-based development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code or similar) and familiarity with Sitecore's AI capabilities (e.g., Sitecore Stream / agentic workflows).
* Experience with other DXP / headless CMS platforms such as Optimizely, or Contentstack.
* **Experience with the broader Sitecore composable stack:** Sitecore Search, Personalize/CDP, Content Hub.
* Migration experience moving Sitecore XP/XM (MVC) solutions to SitecoreAI headless.
* Current Sitecore certifications (e.g., SitecoreAI / XM Cloud Developer) and/or Vercel, Azure or AWS certifications.
* Agency or consulting experience.


Keywords: Tech Lead, Technical Lead, Sitecore, Sitecore AI, Technology Lead, Sitecore Technology Lead, Senior Sitecore Developer, Sitecore Architect, Sitecore Technical Lead, Sitecore XM Cloud, SitecoreAI, Sitecore headless, Sitecore composable, Sitecore development, Sitecore implementation, Enterprise Sitecore, Sitecore architecture, Headless CMS, Headless architecture, Next.js, React, TypeScript, .NET, C\#

title: Executive Medical Director of Market Operations
description:
Accompany Health is on a mission to give patients with complex needs the dignified, high\-quality care they deserve but rarely receive. A primary, behavioral, and social care provider, Accompany Health walks alongside patients for their entire care journey, offering at\-home and virtual care, as well as 24/7 support. Partnering with innovative payors, Accompany Health is powered by remarkable care teams, elegant technology, and a commitment to evidence\-based practice.  

  

We build long\-term relationships with our patients so they know, without question, that our team is here for them day or night, year after year. We focus on the health outcomes most important to our patients to make it clear that they lead the way.  

  

To achieve our mission, we collaborate with community\-based organizations, local providers, and health plans. Led by our empathetic care teams, guided by proven care models, and powered by our own technology, we deliver a level of service that our communities rightfully deserve but rarely receive.  

  

While our headquarters is in Bethesda, MD, our teams are distributed across the country. If you're eager to make a tangible difference in people's lives, to help correct long\-standing disparities in health care, join us.

***About the role:***



As an Executive Medical Director, you will serve as a senior clinical leader at Accompany Health, reporting directly to the Chief Medical Officer. Working in close partnership with the Head of Market Operations, VBC leadership team, and Product teams, you will hold dyad operational accountability for building, leading, and refining market\-based clinical care systems. You will directly drive high\-quality clinical care, total cost of care performance, quality metrics, and exceptional employee engagement across clinical pods.


***Responsibilities will include:***


**Operational \& Clinical Performance Management:**


* In dyad partnership with the Head of Market Operations, design and execute operational systems to deliver excellent, compassionate, patient\-centered clinical care
* Accountability includes driving key market KPIs, accurate clinical documentation, total cost of care reduction, 4\+ STARs on HEDIS measures, and strong patient engagement and experience


**Clinical People Leadership \& Talent Development:**


* Directly manage Market Medical Directors and Clinical Directors/Managers to lead market\-based physicians and APCs. Support and coach clinical leadership on managing care pod panels, refine ongoing competencies, establish coaching/remediation plans, and partner with the People Team to build clear career growth pathways


**Strategic Leader for Clinical Innovation:**


* Act as a key clinical leader for strategic clinical innovation, including technology and AI enablement, in order to design and implement care model innovations and programming targeted at reducing avoidable medical expense, improving quality and preventative care, ensuring appropriate diagnosis, and driving strong patient engagement and experience


**Quality, Safety, and Culture:**


* Ensure adherence to evidence\-based clinical guidelines, Accompany Health standards, clinical policies, safety protocols, and company procedures while actively upholding company cultural values and norms


**Market Implementation \& Expansion:**


* Partner with Market Operations to lead timely and successful new payor/market implementations
* Oversee clinician hiring, recruiting, and adaptation of operational systems tailored to specific market and contract requirements


**Growth and Payor Relationships:**


* Represent Accompany Health externally to advance partnerships with payors, health systems, and provider groups in order to drive success of market implementation and future growth


**Direct Clinical Care \& On\-Call Coverage:**


* Dedicate up to \~10% of time to direct clinical care (virtual urgent care, in\-person urgent care, or overflow care)
* Participate in rotating on\-call schedules and clinician supervision coverage as needed


**Travel:**


* Travel will be variable around monthly to existing markets and/or offsite although may increase as needed to support market / payor launches


***What makes you a fit for the team:***


* **Mission Driven:** Passionate about caring for complex, historically underserved patients with co\-occurring chronic and behavioral health conditions in an integrated, multi\-disciplinary model anchored in home\-based and tech\-enabled virtual care
* **People Leader:** Excellent communicator; able to clearly articulate, motivate, and lead multidisciplinary teams towards common goals
* + Loves coaching and mentoring clinicians and non\-clinicians in their skill development and career growth
	+ Exceptional at change management and organizational transformation
* **Team Player and Collaborator:** Willing to roll up sleeves and effectively work across multiple functions and team members
* **Creative and Efficient Problem\-Solver:** Thrives in fast\-paced environments requiring out\-of\-the\-box problem\-solving and flexibility in approach, as well as ability to multitask and prioritize across competing goals
* **Enthusiastic Innovator:** Excited about being a part of the leading edge of fast\-paced innovation in care delivery models for vulnerable populations in AI, virtual and tech\-enabled models


***Desired skills and experience:***



Required:


* M.D. or D.O. degree from an accredited medical school with active, unencumbered medical licensure (and willingness to obtain multi\-state licensure)
* Board Certification in a primary care discipline (Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Geriatrics) or related specialty
* 8\+ years of clinical practice experience, with 5\+ years in senior clinical leadership roles overseeing physicians, APCs, and clinical managers within value\-based care (VBC) organizations
* Proven track record of managing total cost of care (TCOC), HEDIS/STARs performance, risk\-adjustment documentation, and patient satisfaction KPIs
* Demonstrated expertise in managing dyad operational models, market launches, clinician coaching/performance remediation, and multidisciplinary care pod management
* Active willingness to participate in direct patient care (\~10%), rotating call schedules, and required market travel


Preferred:


* Experience and fluency in using AI tools in daily practice as well as AI enablement of workforce
* Experience working within high\-growth, venture\-backed/Series B healthcare startups or innovative home\-based primary care models
* Deep familiarity with Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care, and Dual\-Eligible (D\-SNP) populations
* Experience partnering closely with Product, Tech, and Strategic Ops teams to iterate and scale tech\-enabled clinical care models

Salary ranges are based on role, level, and location, and reflect the minimum to maximum target for new hire pay in each position. Depending on the role, you may also be eligible for bonus, equity, and benefits. Where you fall within the range depends on factors such as your location, skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our talent team is happy to share more details on the specific range for your location during the hiring process.

title: Associate Director of Admissions
description:
**About the Institute for Nonprofit Practice**  

The Institute for Nonproﬁt Practice (INP) works to ensure that the nation’s nonproﬁt, public sector, and social impact leaders have the skills, knowledge, networks, and conﬁdence to boldly advance their organizations and missions and build a more equitable future for all.  

  

INP serves social impact leaders who are driving solutions to some of the most pressing issues of our time. Nonprofits constitute the third\-largest sector of the U.S. workforce – nearly 1 in 10 workers – yet the sector continues to face a chronic deficit of investment in the people who power it. The types of peer\-to\-peer learning and exchanges that INP offers are needed more than ever as the sector wrestles with a set of challenges that have mounted over the past few years – including workforce shortages, high burnout and turnover rates, and a rising demand for services – that can significantly undermine organizational effectiveness. With an 19\-year track record of delivering programs that measurably increase leaders’ key leadership skills, confidence, and networks, INP is committed to meeting this moment by continuing to empower social impact leaders to adapt and thrive amidst these obstacles.  

  

**About the Role \- Associate Director of Admissions**  

The Associate Director of Admissions builds the partnerships and pipelines that bring exceptional social\-sector leaders into the Institute for Nonprofit Practice (INP). Reporting to the Director of Program Admissions \& Impact, you will manage an assigned portfolio of regional and national recruitment partnerships, connecting mission\-driven professionals to fully funded, transformative leadership development programs.  

  

This is a frontline, relationship\-driven role. You will spend up to 60% of your time engaging external partners, leading info sessions, and guiding prospective fellows through the admissions process. You balance that external focus with operational rigor—maintaining clean records in Salesforce, following established stewardship workflows, and keeping pipeline reporting accurate. You will serve as a key ambassador for INP, translating community relationships and pipeline data into full, diverse cohorts across our programs.  

  

**Your responsibilities will include:*** **Partnership Cultivation \& Funder Alignment**
	+ Cultivate, steward, and expand an assigned portfolio of recruitment partnerships with nonprofit, public sector, and social impact organizations to generate sustained applicant pipelines.
	+ Collaborate with the Advancement team to cultivate prospective applicants from funder grantee portfolios, ensuring outreach reliably fulfills foundation\-sponsored seat commitments.
	+ Serve as an informed ambassador in partner meetings, consulting organizational leaders on staff development needs and positioning INP programs as a vital retention and leadership pathway.
	+ Represent INP, where appropriate, at select community gatherings, conferences, and stakeholder convenings that directly support recruitment milestones.
* **Candidate Stewardship \& Lead Generation**
	+ Drive active recruitment campaigns across your portfolio—spending up to 60% of your time on direct outreach, 1\-on\-1 discovery calls, and relational follow\-up.
	+ Lead dynamic, engaging program information sessions that welcome prospective students and convey program value with warmth and clarity.
	+ Manage the recruitment email inbox and lead communications, offering prompt, high\-touch advising to guide prospective applicants toward the program best suited to their career stage.
	+ Participate actively in the admissions evaluation process, reviewing applications and conducting candidate interviews.
* **Pipeline Execution \& Data Integrity**
	+ Partner with the Director to establish and achieve clear recruitment targets across your portfolio.
	+ Maintain complete, real\-time records in Salesforce, ensuring accurate partner tracking, pipeline visibility, and clean data handoffs.
	+ Partner with Marketing \& Communications to coordinate targeted outreach campaigns, and collaborate with Program and Alumni teams to activate alumni and faculty referral networks.

  

**What You’ll Need*** 5\+ years of relevant professional experience in recruitment, admissions, executive search, relationship management, partnership cultivation, or community outreach.
* Demonstrated track record of meeting recruitment targets, building pipelines, and converting prospective leads into active applicants.
* Exceptional interpersonal and relationship\-building skills, with the poise and authenticity to engage senior nonprofit leaders, funders, and frontline community advocates.
* Strong candidate stewardship skills, with a commitment to providing a welcoming, responsive, and participant\-centered admissions experience.
* Experience using Salesforce or a comparable CRM to log outreach, manage pipeline data, and track conversion milestones.
* Comfort leveraging modern workplace tools and AI applications to streamline communications and day\-to\-day operations.
* Ability to work gracefully under pressure, manage competing priorities, and navigate ambiguity in a fast\-paced environment.

  

**Who You Are:*** **An Effective Collaborator.** You build trust quickly, navigate complex team dynamics with ease, and foster an environment where peers and partners succeed together. You communicate proactively and aren't afraid to ask questions.
* **An Exceptional Communicator.** You possess outstanding verbal and written communication skills. You can facilitate engaging presentations, lead thoughtful one\-on\-one discovery calls, and articulate the value of INP’s programs with precision and warmth.
* **Resourceful and Adaptable.** You are comfortable with ambiguity, stay grounded under shifting priorities, and bring creative problem\-solving to recruitment hurdles.
* **An Abundant Thinker.** You operate from the belief that the right coalition of partners can unlock transformative possibilities. You approach relationship building with relentless curiosity and genuine enthusiasm.
* **Committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion.** You consistently ask, "Whose voice is not at the table?" You possess deep cross\-cultural competence, value lived experience, and intentionally cultivate applicant pools that reflect the communities our sector serves.
* **Impact\-Driven.** You are motivated by social justice and energized by the opportunity to strengthen, connect, and elevate leaders across the social sector.

  

**Compensation \& Benefits**  

INP provides a competitive salary that is benchmarked annually against Boston\-area nonprofits. The hiring range for this position is an annual salary range of $75,000 to $85,000 per year. The ﬁnal salary within this range will be determined based on candidate's qualifications and relevant experience. New staff are rarely brought in at the top of the range to ensure internal equity and to leave room for salary growth during an employee’s tenure at the Institute for Nonprofit Practice.  

  

Our comprehensive benefits package includes:* Employer\-covered health, dental, and vision insurance
* Flexible Time Off (FTO) for all team members
* Eleven paid holidays and winter and summer breaks for collective rest and restoration.
* 401(k) with a 3% employer match of employee contributions.

  

**The Application Process**  

INP has engaged Equitable Hiring Group to support this hiring process. To apply, please complete the short form to the right.  

  

Please submit your application by **Tuesday, October 20th.** Our simple process makes it easy to apply early!  

  

To ensure an equitable review, we ask that you remove the names of the schools you attended (both undergraduate and graduate) from your resume. Please retain the degree itself. For example, instead of "Greendale Community College \- B.A. Economics," simply list "B.A. Economics."  

  

This evaluation process will follow practices shown to reduce bias in decision\-making and may be different from other application processes you have experienced.  

  

The overall evaluation process will look to follow this anticipated timeline:* Mid\-October: Selected candidates will be asked to complete a short\-answer questionnaire.
* Late October: Selected candidates will participate in a video interview with INP staff.
* Early November: Selected candidates will be asked to complete a paid, timed trial project.
* Mid\-November: Selected candidates will participate in a video panel interview with multiple team members.
* Late November: Offer extended.

  

If you have any questions about the opportunity, please email abe@equitablehiringgroup.com.

-------------------


**About this role**


**Managing Director, Public Policy**


**About this role**


BlackRock has a long history of service as a trusted, expert resource to governments and policymakers around the world. Since the Government Affairs \& Public Policy (GAPP) team was created in 2009, it has steadily grown, transformed, and established BlackRock as a respected advocate for investors and the millions of retirees we serve. In recent years, that work has extended to long\-term challenges such as the retirement crisis, energy security, and investment in critical infrastructure.


This role is for a Managing Director on GAPP to co\-lead BlackRock’s legislative advocacy at the federal level in the US. This individual will be responsible for developing, prioritizing, tracking, and communicating BlackRock’s public policy priorities with Congress and the White House.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Advance BlackRock’s US federal public policy priorities, collaborating closely with Legal \& Compliance, Communications, and other teams across BlackRock to ensure alignment of views.
* Lead engagement with federal policymakers, trade associations, and clients on BlackRock’s priority issues.
* Review key legislation and regulation and provide technical recommendations.
* Coordinate with global public policy colleagues to ensure a consistent approach across regions.
* Engage internal stakeholders to understand the interests of BlackRock and our clients as they relate to public policy developments; enlist subject matter experts as appropriate; assist with the development and management of internal working groups.
* Develop and review materials for engagement with policymakers.

Build and maintain relationships with key policymakers and staff.  
* 

**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree required; J.D. from a nationally recognized law school preferred
* 10\+ years of work experience in government relations, financial policy, or financial regulation.
* Excellent judgment and impeccable ethics; desire to succeed in a collaborative, demanding, innovative, entrepreneurial environment.
* Exceptional political acumen, thorough understanding of federal public policy and ability to be represent BlackRock with all policy makers.
* Excellent communication skills, both oral and written. Must be able to present complex concepts in a concise and understandable way.
* Strong skills in PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.
* Strong research and writing skills; strategic and creative thinking aptitude.
* Exceptional organizational skills and keen attention to detail.

For DC3\-Washington \- 1401 New York Avenue, N.W., 3rd Floor Only the salary range for this position is USD$250,000\.00 \- USD$325,000\.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay\-for\-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.
**Our benefits**
  

  

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.


**Our hybrid work model**


BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. title: Director/a Creativo/a – Agencia de Marketing y Comunicación
description:
Estamos en búsqueda de un/a **Chief Design Officer** para sumarse al equipo de nuestro cliente, una agencia creativa de marketing y comunicación de servicio integral, con posicionamiento premium.

Buscamos un perfil que combine visión estratégica con capacidad de ejecución, para consolidar a la agencia como un referente de diseño en el mercado y elevar el nivel del equipo creativo.

**OBJETIVO DEL PUESTO**

* Elevar el estándar de calidad visual de la agencia y consolidarla como un referente de diseño en el mercado.
* Liderar la dirección de arte de proyectos clave y de new business de alto valor.
* Fortalecer el liderazgo y el criterio del equipo creativo.

**RESPONSABILIDADES**

* Innovación y referente. Definir los estándares de calidad visual de la agencia y liderar la innovación en diseño, branding y comunicación visual, con análisis de mejores prácticas y benchmarks internacionales.
* New business y proyectos clave. Liderar la dirección de arte de prospectos y proyectos estratégicos para asegurar propuestas competitivas y de alto nivel, siendo el principal responsable de su ejecución directa.
* Liderazgo y desarrollo del equipo creativo. Fortalecer el criterio y el liderazgo del equipo, definir procesos y herramientas de tecnología que eficienten su forma de trabajar y ayudar a cumplir las entregas en tiempo y forma.
* Operación y satisfacción de cuentas existentes. Supervisar la calidad del trabajo entregado e intervenir en cuentas y momentos clave para asegurar la satisfacción del cliente.
* Materiales internos de la agencia. Definir, ejecutar y supervisar los estándares visuales de los materiales internos y de marca para garantizar consistencia y calidad.

**UN DÍA EN EL ROL**

* Dar seguimiento a los proyectos de new business y a las cuentas activas que requieran su intervención.
* Monitorear la calidad de los entregables de diseño audiovisual de las cuentas en operación.
* Sostener un touch point semanal con la Head de Diseño y su equipo para dar seguimiento y

feedback.

* Coordinarse con Estrategia, Content e Innovación desde las etapas tempranas del brief en proyectos clave.
* Tomar decisiones de diseño siempre que se cumplan los deadlines, y escalar cuando un deadline con cliente se vea afectado.
* Reportar a la Dirección General el estado de las cuentas, la operación y el desarrollo del equipo creativo.

**EXPERIENCIA Y SKILLS**

* 10\+ años de experiencia en diseño con enfoque digital, en agencias creativas, de publicidad o de marketing.
* Trayectoria comprobada hasta posiciones de liderazgo creativo (Director/a de Arte Senior o equivalente).
* Experiencia liderando proyectos de alto impacto, new business y equipos creativos, manteniendo altos estándares de calidad.
* Dominio de Adobe Creative Suite, Figma y After Effects, y uso cotidiano de herramientas de IA aplicadas al diseño.
* Liderazgo y mentoría: desarrolla talento, eleva el nivel del equipo y promueve una cultura de colaboración, aprendizaje y mejora continua.
* Perfil que combina visión estratégica con capacidad de ejecución, criterio creativo y orientación a resultados.

**PERFIL IDEAL**

* Referente en tendencias de diseño y entusiasta de la IA.
* Conocimiento profundo de marketing digital y redes sociales.

**EQUIPO Y REPORTE**

* Reporta a la Dirección General de la agencia.
* Trabaja de la mano con la Head de Diseño, quien tiene a cargo un equipo de 5 diseñadores.
* Interactúa con las áreas de Innovación, Estrategia, Cuentas y Content.

**CONDICIONES**

* Modalidad híbrida (3 oficina \+ 2 HO)
* Salario competitivo \+ beneficios coorporativos.

Sueldo: $50,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 al mes

Lugar de trabajo: remoto híbrido en Ciudad de México, CDMX

title: Senior Creative Video Producer
description:

 We are seeking an experienced Senior Creative Producer to join our team on a project\-by\-project basis with the potential of it leading to a full\-time role. We need someone to help lead the creative development and execution of live video projects. This role requires a strategic thinker who can translate client objectives into compelling creative direction while managing the production process from concept through delivery.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is equally comfortable shaping creative vision, collaborating with clients, and guiding production teams to ensure high\-quality work delivered on time. This role requires experience working across both live\-action and animation production workflows, with the ability to manage complex creative and operational processes.
 



  




* Key Responsibilities



 \-Creative Leadership \-Lead the development of creative concepts, treatments, and messaging aligned with client goals
 



 \-Translate brand strategy into compelling visual storytelling across live\-action and animated content
 



 \-Write or refine scripts, messaging frameworks, and narrative structures for video and animation projects
 



 \-Provide creative direction to writers, editors, designers, animators, and production teams
 



 \-Review scripts, storyboards, animatics, and rough cuts to ensure creative quality and alignment
 



 \-Casting \& Talent Direction
 



 \-Develop casting approaches that align with creative direction and brand positioning
 



 \-Post casting calls and review submissions to identify appropriate on\-camera talent
 



 \-Select talent in collaboration with internal stakeholders or clients
 



 \-Direct talent during production as needed to ensure natural, compelling on\-camera performances

 \-Support planning and coordination across pre\-production, production, and post\-production phases

 \-Contracts \& Production Documentation\- Prepare and execute talent agreements and releases aligned with project usage requirements
 



 \-Draft and manage crew deal memos, confirming day rates, scope of work, and production expectations
 



 \-Ensure appropriate documentation is in place prior to production, including releases and production agreements
 



 \-Work with production leadership to maintain organized project documentation and compliance
 



 \-Post\-Production Leadership\- Manage complex post\-production workflows across multiple deliverables, editors, and review cycles
 



 \-Oversee editorial timelines, ensuring projects stay on schedule while maintaining creative quality
 



 \-Provide clear creative feedback on cuts, graphics, animation, sound design, and finishing
 



 \-Coordinate closely with editors, motion designers, and animation teams to ensure consistency across assets
 



 \-Manage stakeholder feedback and consolidate notes to keep the editorial process efficient and focused
 



 \-Sales \& Project Scoping \-Support business development efforts by scoping potential projects across live\-action and animation production
 



 \-Collaborate with sales and leadership teams to develop creative concepts for client pitches and proposals
 



 \-Evaluate production requirements and provide guidance on scope, resources, and creative approaches
 



 \-Suggest creative solutions that align with client budgets, identifying opportunities to maximize impact while maintaining production feasibility
 



 \-Help translate early client conversations into clear creative directions and production plans
 



 Client Collaboration \=Participate in client meetings and presentations
 



 \-Interpret client feedback and translate it into clear creative direction for the team
 



 \-Help maintain alignment between creative vision and project scope
 



 \-Team Collaboration\-Work closely with producers, editors, designers, animators, and other creative team members
 



 \-Support efficient workflows and clear communication between creative and production teams
 



 \-Help resolve creative challenges quickly and collaboratively
 



  





 Qualifications
 



 7\+ years of experience in creative producing, creative direction, or content production
 



 Strong experience working across both live\-action and animation production pipelines
 



 Proven ability to write scripts and develop compelling creative narratives
 



 Experience managing complex post\-production workflows with multiple deliverables
 



 Experience with casting and directing on\-camera talent
 



 Experience preparing talent agreements, releases, and crew deal memos
 



 Ability to scope projects and develop creative solutions aligned with production budgets
 



 Strong understanding of production workflows from concept through final delivery
 



 Experience working directly with clients and internal creative teams
 



 Excellent communication and presentation skills
 



 Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
 



  





 Preferred Experience
 



 Experience working with agency or production company teams
 



 Familiarity with remote production workflows
 



 Experience supporting creative pitches and business development initiatives
 



 Experience overseeing branded video, commercial, and animated content pipelines
 



  





 Contract Details
 



 Hourly Rate: DOE and location
 



 Location: Latin America
 



 Hours: Project\-based, with availability during standard U.S. CST business hours preferred
 



 Start Date: As soon as possible
 



  





 About the Role
 



 This role is ideal for a senior\-level creative who enjoys both big\-picture thinking and hands\-on collaboration with production teams. You will play a critical role in shaping creative direction, leading casting and talent direction when needed, supporting sales efforts through project scoping and creative pitching, and managing post\-production execution to ensure the final work meets a high standard of storytelling and production quality.

title: Sr Brand Design Manager
location: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
description:
**About CookUnity**
 Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first\-of\-its\-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready\-to\-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.
   

  

 Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever\-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission:
 **empower Chefs to nourish the world.**
 If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.
   

  

**About The Team**
 At CookUnity, the Brand Marketing team is responsible for developing and executing world\-class marketing activations and experiences that drive brand awareness and earn loyalty beyond reason. This team sets the vision and strategy for the brand and brings it to life with strategic rigor, creative excellence, and cultural relevance. Through insight\-inspired, data\-informed brand storytelling and experiences, CookUnity’s Brand Marketing team will build a category\-defining brand loved by an entire generation of foodies.
   

  

**The Role**
 CookUnity is seeking a seasoned brand design manager to take our creative function to the next level — elevating design craft, modernizing design operations, and boldly differentiating the CookUnity brand. In this role you will oversee the development and expression of the brand visual identity across all consumer touch points, both online and offline, while managing and actively leveling up a team of talented, ambitious designers.
   

  

 Through your leadership and vision, you will build and scale a world\-class brand design function with customer obsession and creative excellence at its core. The ideal candidate brings not only a mastery of design craft honed at best\-in\-class consumer brands, but also the operational rigor to implement new standards of design process and team performance — and the forward\-thinking mindset to leverage AI tools as a high\-impact lever for quality and efficiency.
   

  

 This is a role for a leader who sets the bar high, builds the systems to meet it, and brings a team along for the journey. Reporting to the VP of Brand Marketing, this role is uniquely positioned to create an impact that helps CookUnity resonate emotionally and grow commercially in unprecedented ways.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Creative Vision \& Brand Stewardship**
* Develop and evangelize an inspiring creative vision for the future of CookUnity and help the organization make progress towards achieving its full potential
* Lead the Brand Design team to bring the essence of CookUnity to life through a differentiated design system and visual storytelling across website, app, social media, advertising, CRM, and a growing ecosystem of packaging
* Own, refine, and continue to build on the CookUnity brand identity and visual system as a living resource that evolves with new learnings and insights to better support the needs of the customer and company
* Bring the standards and instincts of best\-in\-class consumer brands to CookUnity — championing unwavering expectations for design craft, quality, and executional consistency


**Design Process \& Operational Excellence**
* Design and manage an ambitious, end\-to\-end creative process — including intake, internal creative reviews, stakeholder feedback cycles, and approval workflows — that ensures consistently on\-time delivery of high\-quality assets
* Lead regular creative reviews of all ongoing design work to provide timely feedback and coaching, and ensure pixel\-perfect execution across all design deliverables
* Lead the routing, feedback, and approval process for brand design deliverables to executive staff and Founder as needed for high\-visibility, high\-impact initiatives


**AI Integration \& Design Innovation**
* Champion the integration of AI\-based tools into the team's design workflows, identifying high\-impact opportunities to automate repeatable tasks, accelerate production, and free the team to focus on higher\-order creative work
* Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape and serve as an internal resource for best practices, responsible use, and practical application within a brand design context
* Foster a team culture that embraces experimentation with emerging tools while maintaining the quality standards and creative integrity the brand demands


**Team Leadership \& Talent Development**
* Mentor and motivate a small but mighty team of talented designers, actively leveling up individual skills through structured feedback, coaching, and growth\-oriented development conversations
* Build a culture of trust, openness, accountability, and a relentless pursuit of design excellence — where high standards are a shared value, not just a directive
* Lead by doing: maintain mastery of the tools the team uses daily (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Claude Design, and relevant AI design tools) and be willing to roll up your sleeves alongside the team when needed


**Cross\-Functional Partnership**
* Partner with teammates, peers, and key stakeholders to proactively identify opportunities or challenges, and take a leadership role in bringing tangible design solutions forward
* Partner directly with brand copy team to define visual storytelling approach, ensuring consistency and deep integration between these teams to maximize efficiency and effectiveness of all creative output
* Assume a strong company presence as an internal standard\-bearer of category\-defining creativity, building trust, alignment, and influence across the organization
* Bring principles of design thinking, a solution\-oriented mindset, and an entrepreneurial spirit to achieving impactful results without depending on significant resources


**Minimum Requirements**
* 8\+ years experience in brand design; experience in top consumer brands and/or agencies is a plus
* 4\+ years managing other designers
* A respected brand design leader with a track record of shipping excellent work and a portfolio demonstrating a mastery of design craft across multiple disciplines of design
* Proficiency in video and how to leverage design in this format is a plus
* Passion for insights and performance data in shaping creative work and a commitment to building a culture that embraces these essential inputs
* Experience operating in a fast\-paced growth environment, including dealing with ambiguity, shifting priorities \& rapid iteration
* Very detail oriented, well organized, and a proven ability to effectively manage multiple projects, work streams, or initiatives simultaneously
* Highly collaborative in nature with ability to partner across various functions throughout a company and demonstrate flexible decision\-making based on new insight or feedback
* A genuine passion for design and a love of the creative process
* Proficiency in English at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, or a related field is a plus


**Learn More About CookUnity**
 We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.
   

  

 We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!
   

  

**Benefits**
 💸 Get paid in USD
   

  

 🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want.
   

  

 ⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date.
   

  

 🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays.

title: Producer / Production Coordinator
description:
BENO is a Dubai\-based luxury lifestyle experiences company, expanding its in\-house media team across yacht and watersports, automotive, desert experiences, and lifestyle production. We're hiring a Producer / Production Coordinator to bridge the Head of Media's creative direction with on\-the\-ground execution.  

  

**Role Overview**  

This role plans and runs production logistics, including locations, scheduling, crew, and preparation, across everything from a simple single\-location asset shoot to a full campaign with talent and a larger crew. It also maintains vendor relationships and, over time, builds the client pipeline that supports BENO's move into outsourced production work.  

  

**Responsibilities*** Plan and coordinate pre\-production logistics, including locations, scheduling, crew, and other preparations, across video and photo shoots ranging from simple asset videos to full campaigns with talent and larger crews, working closely with the in\-house videographer, photographer, and social media team
* Arrange transport and logistics for crew, talent, and equipment on larger productions
* Hands\-on experience producing a range of shoot types with a small in\-house crew: automotive, watersports, yacht, desert buggy, events, lifestyle, and brand promotion content
* Comfortable adapting on the ground to changing conditions, staying solution\-oriented while protecting brand identity, safety, and efficient use of time and resources
* Execute standard\-format shoots (single\-subject assets, walkthroughs, simple brand pieces) independently with the in\-house videographer and photographer, briefed and guided by the Head of Media / Creative Director and using BENO's documented visual guide for framing, pacing, and shot selection
* Refer anything involving narrative direction, talent, or new visual concepts to the Head of Media / Creative Director
* Support the Head of Media in shaping and preparing new concepts and upcoming projects
* Brief in\-house and remote editors on delivery specs and follow up against the Creative Director's notes to keep post\-production on schedule
* Maintain and grow vendor and crew relationships as needed, including equipment rental, freelance crew, talent agencies, and drone operators, alongside BENO's existing network, keeping rates, reliability notes, and booking history up to date
* Maintain the production log and tracker, flagging missing deliverables or specs
* Continuously refine the production workflow from pre\- through post\-production, drawing on lessons from past shoots, personal experience, and team feedback to keep timelines and efficiency improving
* On weeks without a scheduled shoot, originate simple, repeatable content pieces using the visual guide and available assets or locations, keeping output continuous
* **Bonus:** Maintain working knowledge of Dubai's filming permit landscape, including Dubai Film \& TV Commission (DFTC) approvals, RTA road permits, and marina or private\-property access, and advise on feasibility before a shoot is booked
* **Bonus:** Knowledgeable in finding or suggesting filming locations suited to specific concepts
* Flexible to work outside standard hours or on weekends for specific shoots or events
* **Bonus:** Capture clean, on\-brand behind\-the\-scenes phone content during shoots, giving the marketing and social team ready\-to\-use footage without pulling focus from logistics or crew management.

  

**Qualifications*** Minimum 5 years of production coordination or producing experience in the UAE, particularly Dubai
* Knowledgeable in standard production tools and platforms (Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Google Meet, Trello, and other tools relevant to the role)
* Familiar with core media production software (Adobe Creative Suite, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve), enough to understand the team's workload and help streamline it
* Strong AI literacy: comfortable using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Higgsfield to support production planning and enhance department efficiency. This is a core requirement, not a bonus skill
* Familiar with social media platforms and their content requirements (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn)
* Comfortable working in physically demanding conditions when required, for example aboard boats or in the desert, given the range of environments across BENO's productions
* Comfortable running a small shoot independently within a defined creative framework
* Organized, calm under logistics pressure, confident communicating with talent, crew, and vendors
* Presentable, professional, and clear in communication with the in\-house team, partners, and anyone else involved in the department's productions
* Fluent in English, written and spoken, able to communicate and understand everything related to the scope of the work
* Experience in luxury lifestyle, automotive, maritime, brand promotional, or documentary\-style content
* Understanding of visual storytelling, shot composition, and Dubai's visual identity
* Comfortable working under tight deadlines across multiple assignments
* A relevant academic degree in media, art, marketing, or a related field

  

**Preferred Qualifications*** Existing vendor and crew network in Dubai
* Prior exposure to business development, client services, or partnerships
* UAE driving license, with driving experience (owning a car is a plus)

  

**Working Hours**  

9:00 to 18:00 (Dubai time), in\-office; flexible on shoot days.

**Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!**
---------------------------------------------


Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.


As a remote co\-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.


We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the \#1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.


### **About the Role**


We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end\-to\-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.


As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re\-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.


You’ll be a true player\-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high\-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.


As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.


As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long\-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature\-level design challenges \- exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.

* Lead and scale a high\-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross\-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high\-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post\-purchase experiences.

* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company\-wide priorities.

* A player\-coach mindset\-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands\-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer\-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user\-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e\-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy.
