title: Director, Roofing & Building Envelope Design
description:
**About Mantis**



We help organizations improve how their buildings perform by bringing together energy, facility operations, and sustainability into one connected approach. At Mantis, our teams work across the full lifecycle of a facility—from planning and design to field execution and long\-term asset management—across commercial and industrial portfolios, data centers, and complex mechanical systems.



Our work spans four core areas: Building Controls, Energy Efficiency, Energy Advisory, and Facility Management—covering HVAC/mechanical optimization, BMS/BAS and EPMS controls, lighting system upgrades, energy brokerage, roofing and building envelope assessments, construction management, and more.



Whether you’re in sales, engineering, construction/project management, field operations, corporate, or technology, you’ll play a role in delivering these solutions and helping clients improve facility performance.

  

### **SUMMARY**



Mantis Innovation is seeking a strategic and technically proficient Director of Roofing \& Building Envelope Design to lead and grow our national Roofing \& Building Envelope consulting practice. This role is responsible for overseeing technical excellence, project delivery, people leadership, quality assurance, talent development, and market growth across our Commercial \& Industrial (C\&I), MUSH (Municipal, University, School, and Healthcare), Food \& Beverage, Banking, and Corporate Real Estate client sectors.



The Director will provide leadership and direction for a multidisciplinary team of roofing consultants, building envelope specialists, architects, designers, specification writers, and CAD professionals. The successful candidate will serve as the operational leader of the practice, ensuring consistent execution, profitability, quality standards, and client satisfaction while advancing Mantis' position as a trusted advisor in roof asset management, building envelope consulting, design services, and capital project planning.



This position is intended for an experienced roofing and building envelope professional and does not require an architectural license.



### **OUTCOMES (SCORECARD FOR SUCCESS)**


* Grow Roofing \& Building Envelope consulting revenue in line with annual practice targets.
* Maintain strong client retention and satisfaction across strategic accounts.
* Deliver projects on time, within budget, and in accordance with contract requirements.
* Meet project profitability and margin expectations for the practice.
* Reduce quality\-related issues through consistent QA/QC standards and technical review.
* Improve team engagement, retention, and development through coaching, staffing discipline, and succession planning.
* Demonstrate general attitude, collaborative spirit, and availability consistent with Mantis leadership expectations.
### **Practice Leadership**


* Lead and manage the Roofing \& Building Envelope Design practice across all regions.
* Establish and execute the strategic vision, goals, processes, and performance standards for the group.
* Create scalable delivery models and standard operating procedures to support growth.
* Develop staffing plans and organizational structures to support current and future workload demands.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.
* Build a high\-performing team through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and
### **Technical Leadership**


* Serve as the senior technical authority for roofing and building envelope design projects.
* Oversee preparation and review of roof replacement designs, repair specifications, bid documents, construction details, and building envelope assessments.
* Ensure consistency and quality across all design deliverables.
* Guide technical approaches for complex roofing, waterproofing, façade, and enclosure projects.
* Promote adoption of industry best practices, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions.
* Maintain awareness of evolving roofing systems, building enclosure technologies, codes, and industry standards.
### **Project Delivery \& Quality Assurance**


* Oversee a portfolio of design and consulting projects from assessment through closeout.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with contract requirements.
* Implement and maintain robust QA/QC processes across all deliverables.
* Participate in project reviews, risk management discussions, and constructability evaluations.
* Monitor resource utilization and project performance metrics.
### **Client Leadership**


* Serve as a trusted advisor to key clients and strategic accounts.
* Participate in executive\-level client meetings, presentations, and planning discussions.
* Support roof asset management programs and capital planning initiatives.
* Develop long\-term client relationships that drive recurring revenue and expanded service offerings.
* Partner with Operations and Sales teams to ensure successful project execution and client satisfaction.
### **Business Development \& Growth**


* Support business development efforts through proposal development, interviews, scope development, and technical presentations.
* Identify opportunities to expand roofing and building envelope services into existing accounts.
* Collaborate with Market Leaders to grow service offerings within C\&I, MUSH, Food \& Beverage, Banking, and Corporate real estate sectors.
* Support strategic initiatives, acquisitions, and integration efforts related to consulting and design services.
* Assist in developing annual growth, revenue, and margin objectives for the practice.
### **Team Development**


* Recruit, develop, and retain top consulting and design talent.
* Conduct performance management, career development, and succession planning activities.
* Support professional certifications and industry involvement.
* Build a team environment focused on collaboration, accountability, and customer service.
### **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**


* 15\+ years of progressive experience in commercial roofing, roof consulting, building envelope consulting, design, architecture, engineering, or related disciplines.
* 7\+ years of leadership experience managing technical consulting, design, engineering, or professional services teams.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi\-location teams and complex project portfolios.
* Strong expertise in:
	+ Commercial roofing systems
	+ Building envelope and façade systems
	+ Waterproofing systems
	+ Building assessments
	+ Construction administration
	+ Design specifications
	+ Capital planning and asset management
* Experience serving large portfolio clients across multiple facilities and geographic locations.
* Proven ability to manage financial performance, resource planning, and operational execution.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and client relationship management skills.

* Registered Exterior Wall Observer (REWO)

### **WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**


* Work environment: Office, remote, client\-site, and field environments, including commercial facilities and active construction settings.
* Physical requirements: Regular computer work, meetings, travel, site walks, climbing stairs or ladders where permitted, and occasional exposure to outdoor conditions.

title: Account Specialist, Influencer Marketing
description:
**Position: Account Specialist, Influencer Marketing**


**The Account Specialist, Influencer Marketing** position is a remote, work\-from\-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events.


**The Role:**



As an **Account Specialist, Influencer Marketing** you will provide white glove service to diverse brands investing in influencer marketing campaigns. This role is particularly focused on campaign execution, including but not limited to driving influencer recruitment, managing influencer partnerships, and owning campaign deliverables, tracking, and reporting. The Account Specialist will also drive strategy by analyzing campaign performance, identifying success areas and/or challenge areas, and proactively implementing strategic measures to continuously optimize programs towards goals and objectives.



The successful candidate will have strong experience in developing and managing successful, KPI\-driven influencer marketing campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies. They will have working knowledge of the overall partner marketing landscape, including affiliate, and the ability to both develop comprehensive strategy as well as capably execute. The successful candidate will be a self\-starter that can confidently plug in to any challenging situation with ease and can balance competing priorities well. The Account Specialist must be flexible, willing and able to pivot quickly, and excited to operate successfully in an “intrapreneurial” situation. This person will also have a history of working well with their peers, quickly establishing relationships easily and leading through influence.



You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth.  

  

**Top 5 Responsibilities:**


* **INFLUENCER RECRUITMENT, NEGOTIATING \& ONBOARDING –**Sources new partnership opportunities and creates influencer casting lists. Diligently vets opportunities to ensure brand alignment, authenticity and relevancy prior to presenting to client for approval. Conducts outreach to approved partners and skillfully garners their engagement and participation in the campaign, negotiating when necessary. Supports influencers through campaign onboarding by developing and providing resources to streamline processes.
* **INFLUENCER PARTNERSHIPS MANAGEMENT** – Crafts program\-wide influencer communications and vital creator resources. Guides influencers on content strategy and creation. Works with influencers to develop content timelines and ensures influencers stay on track with the schedules discussed. Collects content drafts and leads the content review process, including screening to ensure FTC guidelines are met. Closely works with influencers to adjust content strategy as needed, troubleshooting any signs of poor performance to optimize campaign towards goals and objectives.
* **AUDITING, REPORTING \& ANALYSIS** – Accountable for auditing program content to ensure compliance with FTC regulations and brand guidelines. Ensures content is tracked accurately and regularly shared with client, along with placement insights, partner insights, and campaign pace towards KPI goals. Performs robust analysis of influencer campaigns using both social analytics and conversion metrics to identify performance trends and areas of opportunity. Proactively provides actionable recommendations to client backed by data and continuously refines strategy to drive growth at scale. Supports team in creation of customized strategy plans, detailed campaign performance summaries and comprehensive hindsight presentations that are delivered to clients.
* **CLIENT SERVICE \& COMMUNICATION**\- Consistently provides superior client service and escalates issues or key risks as appropriate. Works to ensure client develops trust in our team by delivering client outputs and communications in the AP way, consistently maintaining quality, accuracy, and precision. Develops and nurtures excellent relationships, supports team in promoting very high client satisfaction and retention rates, and an average 8\.5 client rating.
* **PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT**\- Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Manages multiple campaigns with solid organizational skills and the ability to focus on and prioritize tasks based on client objectives, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Has full grasp of each client’s scope of work, delivering what is due under terms; maintains ability to identify new opportunities to drive client success while conjunctively identifying possible goal misalignments, getting to the root of an issue, and working with their team to bring solutions to resolve.

  


**What Success Looks Like:**


**BY 3 MONTHS:**


* The Account Specialist is contributing across a portfolio of influencer programs, collaborating with their team closely to ensure strong alignment with the campaign strategy in place.
* You are working with key client contacts to ensure brand alignment with recruitment efforts and content creation.
* You have become familiar with AP’s tools and solutions and are equipped to conduct casting for prospective influencers, execute content timelines with influencers, audit content, and ensure performance is tracked and measured.


**By 6 MONTHS:**


* You are owning execution of the day\-to\-day operations of multiple influencer programs with little guidance from your team, including reporting, processing applications, recruiting and casting creators, and crafting partner communications.
* Challenging client or team situations are being managed with guidance from managers and directors collaborating closely to bring a solutions\-oriented approach to these situations proactively.
* You are regularly analyzing client data and strategically leveraging insights to optimize campaigns.
* Client accounts are being handled effectively and strategically, without dropping any balls, and clients are aware of and pleased with this outcome. Clients are being serviced profitably with AP targets, client KPI’s being met, and an average 8\.5 client rating is being upheld across campaigns.
* You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance


**By 1 YEAR:**


* You will troubleshoot and resolve account and creator issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams.
* You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies.
* You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship\-building and firm development.


**Qualities of the Ideal Candidate**


* Has a strong internal motivation to get the job done and done well
* Only provides superior results and unsurpassed customer service
* Exhilarated by managing change and comfortable with ambiguity and moving targets
* Passionate about the digital marketing industry and how influencer relates to the greater digital landscape
* Ensures that influencer strategies and tactics have measurable results
* Has incredible attention to detail and is capable of multi\-tasking and coordinating several projects at once
* Translates data and insights into actionable next steps for clients
* Strong with data analysis, is easily able to pinpoint issues and opportunities within a data set
* Prioritizes competing objectives and manages time with skill
* Displays accountability, always meeting deadlines and keeping commitments
* Thrives in a fast\-paced environment and enjoys bringing order to chaos
* Likes to share and collaborate with peers in a remote environment
* Possesses superior written and verbal communication skills
* Possesses mature and measured judgment, and the ability to solve problems on their own
* Works independently with minimal supervision
* Has confidence, poise, and eloquence in client meetings and difficult situations
* Hears and incorporates feedback from other team members, clients and partners


**Qualifications \& Skills:**


* 2\+ years working for an influencer marketing agency and experience executing influencer campaigns and managing both client and influencer relationships
* Solid understanding of omni\-channel and digital marketing, with a track record of successfully running influencer campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies
* Excellent at communicating, presenting and approval from clients on new campaign strategies and initiatives
* Working knowledge of attribution in digital marketing
* Strong understanding of how influencer and affiliate marketing can work together
* Tools (CreatorIQ, Grin, Izea, etc.) experience preferred, not required
* Knowledge of Affiliate Networks or SaaS platforms (Impact, ShareASale, Commission Junction, etc.) experience preferred, not required
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
* Ability to travel up to 15%
* Advanced Excel capabilities and comfortable with formatting, formulas, customizing reports, etc.
* A genuine interest in AI tools, including hands\-on experience integrating AI into your work and an appetite to keep improving.

  


**WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?**



Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first\-to\-market Partnership and Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40\+ countries, their global team of 300\+ focuses on data\-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content and B2B partnership marketing. Serving over 200 brands with household names like Amazon, Target, Google, Warby Parker, Crocs, Reebok (to name a few) their diversified staff is creating what’s next in the industry by building balanced portfolios of high\-performing partnerships. As the only truly integrated global partnerships agency, Acceleration Partners prides themselves on being on the cutting edge of new industry developments, and leveraging their proven expertise to bring unique solutions to the most complex challenges for brands who aim for growth.
  

  

**AP PERKS \& BENEFITS \- WHAT WE OFFER**


* 100% remote work for everyone

* Summer \& Holiday company\-wide shut\-down weeks in July and December

This role is responsible for leading the development and execution of integrated brand marketing initiatives that strengthen brand equity, drive traffic and sales, and bring the Jack in the Box brand strategy to life across all consumer touchpoints. This role partners closely with Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, Strategic Insights, Creative Services, Media, and agency partners to develop breakthrough campaigns, launch new products and promotions, and ensure a consistent, distinctive brand experience. * Maintains a deep understanding of consumer behavior, category dynamics, cultural trends, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities.
* Supports the development of campaign strategies, messaging frameworks, and integrated marketing programs.

* Oversees campaign calendars and ensures marketing initiatives are delivered on time, on budget, and with operational excellence.
* Supports seasonal, promotional, menu innovation, and brand\-building initiatives throughout the year.

* Serves as day\-to\-day lead for agency partners, providing strategic direction, clear feedback, and effective project management.
* Collaborates with agency partners on creative development, campaign ideation, production, and execution.
* Evaluates creative concepts, messaging, and communications materials to ensure alignment with brand strategy and business objectives.
* Ensures all creative work reflects Jack in the Box's distinct brand voice, personality, and standards.
* Supports production processes including photo shoots, content creation, broadcast production, social content development, and related brand assets.



**Product Launch \& Commercialization Support** 



* Partners closely with Product Marketing teams to develop launch strategies and marketing support plans for menu innovation and promotional initiatives.
* Ensures product launches are supported by clear consumer insights, compelling communication strategies, and effective activation plans.
* Coordinates cross\-functional efforts to ensure alignment across marketing, operations, culinary, supply chain, and franchise stakeholders.
* Supports go\-to\-market planning and execution for key brand initiatives.

* Partners closely with Product Marketing and Culinary teams to establish innovation priorities and platform strategies.

* Helps evolve and maintain brand assets, messaging frameworks, and communication principles.
* Identifies opportunities to strengthen brand distinctiveness and consumer relevance.

* Monitors campaign performance and business results, identifying opportunities for optimization and improvement.

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------



As Director of Engineering, Database Excellence, you will lead the Database Excellence stage and report to the Vice President of Data Engineering. You will set the direction for the databases that support GitLab.com, self\-managed GitLab, and GitLab Dedicated. Your organization owns the reliability, capacity, health, and sustainability of GitLab's application datastores, with PostgreSQL as the primary focus alongside Redis, OpenSearch, ClickHouse, and object storage.



You will be accountable for database capacity and availability on GitLab.com. You will guide long\-range platform decisions while partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps. The work includes reducing infrastructure costs, improving data growth controls and saturation detection, standardizing database services, rebuilding the self\-managed upgrade experience, and contributing to GitLab's company\-wide datastore strategy, including Cells partitioning. Learn more in the Database Excellence handbook.


**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Set direction and long\-range plans for the database platform in line with company strategy.
* Own database capacity and availability outcomes for GitLab.com, and communicate database risk to senior leadership.
* Lead and coach three Engineering Managers and develop Staff\-plus engineers into leaders.
* Drive cross\-division technical decisions using data, partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps.
* Partner with Product to prioritize database platform investments and make infrastructure tradeoffs in the context of product outcomes.
* Own the hiring plan, organization design, retention, and performance management for teams across regions.
* Set quarterly objectives and key results and engineering key performance indicators for the stage, and manage the database infrastructure budget with FinOps.
* Serve as an escalation point for database incidents, standardize effective processes, and keep the handbook current.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------


* Experience leading managers of managers, including coaching newer managers.
* Experience working hands\-on with PostgreSQL at scale, including capacity planning, upgrades, replication, performance, and large production clusters.
* Experience using data to make strategic technical decisions and connect database platform investments and tradeoffs with product outcomes.
* Experience supporting software that customers run themselves, or working through the self\-managed upgrade challenge.
* Experience leading backend engineering teams that own production infrastructure, applying site reliability engineering practices including service level objectives, on\-call operations, incident management, cost management, and automation.
* Experience communicating clearly in writing in an asynchronous, handbook\-first company.
* Experience leading globally distributed remote teams.
* Experience with Redis, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, object storage, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Terraform, Chef, managed database services, FinOps, AI\-assisted engineering workflows, or platform and infrastructure organizations is a plus.

Database Excellence includes Database Architecture, Database Automation, and Self Managed Database. Three Engineering Managers lead these teams, alongside an Operations Manager. Our teams work across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and India. Database Architecture provides datastore guidance, data growth controls, and the database review process. Database Automation builds PostgreSQL fleet automation, upgrades, provisioning, health monitoring, and an internal managed PostgreSQL offering. Self Managed Database is rebuilding the upgrade and migration experience for self\-managed GitLab. Together, we make database services more reliable, sustainable, and easier to operate across GitLab's deployment models.
